note: NCI initiative assembling tumour cohorts of children with hard-to-treat cancers (the pan-cancer paper analyses 1,699 paediatric B-ALL, T-ALL, AML, neuroblastoma, Wilms tumour and osteosarcoma cases); an aggregation of patient cohorts, with no exposure basis.

label: TRACERx
quote: TRACERx (TRAcking Cancer Evolution through therapy (Rx)) is a prospective cohort study designed to investigate intratumor heterogeneity (ITH) in relation to clinical outcome, and to determine the clonal nature of driver events and evolutionary processes in early stage non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC).
note: Prospective UK cohort of patients with early-stage non-small cell lung cancer sampled through therapy for tumour evolution; patients are recruited for the cancer, not for smoking or another exposure.

label: TransplantLines
diseases: end-stage organ disease (solid organ transplant recipients)
quote: TransplantLines is designed as a single-center, prospective cohort study and biobank including all different types of solid organ transplant recipients as well as living organ donors.
note: Single-centre clinical cohort and biobank of solid organ transplant recipients (plus healthy living donors) at UMCG; recipients are patients treated for organ failure, so this is a patient cohort although the source names the transplant rather than an underlying disease. Transplantation is a medical procedure, not an environmental exposure.

label: TrypanoGEN
quote: The samples included 182 controls, 97 cases, 17 latent infections and 3 suspect cases.
note: H3Africa case-control collection of sleeping sickness cases, latent infections and controls from endemic areas of six countries for host-susceptibility genetics; defined by the disease rather than by exposure to the parasite.

label: Tumor Profiler
diseases: acute myeloid leukaemia | metastatic melanoma | metastatic epithelial ovarian cancer
quote: The dataset contains bulk transcriptomics data from 23 patients with Acute Myeloid Leukemia (AML).
note: Swiss observational multi-omic tumour-profiling study of patients with AML, metastatic melanoma and metastatic ovarian cancer; the EGA page read covers the AML arm, the other two cancers come from the definition.

label: Type 2 Diabetes Genetic Exploration by Next-generation sequencing in multi-Ethnic Samples
quote: The T2D-GENES/GoT2D 13K exome sequencing study includes ~13,000 samples, half T2D cases and half T2D controls, from five ancestries (~5K Europeans, ~2K each of African-American, East-Asian, South-Asian, and Hispanic).
note: Consortium assembling type 2 diabetes cases and controls of five ancestries from member cohorts for exome sequencing; a disease case-control aggregation with no exposure basis.

label: Uganda General Population Cohort
quote: a population-based study of 6,400 individuals from a geographically defined rural community in South-West Uganda
note: Rural general population cohort in south-west Uganda used for population genetics and cardiometabolic, communicable and non-communicable disease research; a general-population design with a broad purpose, so neither a disease nor an exposure cohort.

label: British Heart Foundation Family Heart Study
diseases: premature coronary artery disease | myocardial infarction
quote: We investigated the genetic determinants of premature CAD by performing a genomewide linkage analysis of 4,175 affected subjects from 1,933 families recruited throughout the United Kingdom. Each family had at least two available siblings with CAD, with validated onset before age 66 years.
note: UK families with at least two siblings affected by premature coronary artery disease recruited for linkage and association studies; the participants are CAD patients (unaffected siblings collected where available), with no exposure basis.

label: UK Blood Service Control Group
quote: Controls used were data from the Wellcome Trust Case Control Consortium 2 (WTCCC2) 1958 birth cohort and the UK Blood Service Control Group (available as EGAS00000000028).
note: Blood donors recruited through the UK Blood Services as a population control set for WTCCC and later association studies; unselected donors, so neither a disease nor an exposure cohort.

label: UK10K
quote: The UK10K project proposes a series of complementary genetic approaches to find new low-frequency/rare variants contributing to disease phenotypes.
note: Sequencing project collecting the TwinsUK and ALSPAC population cohorts together with extreme-phenotype (severe obesity) and rare-disease collections; its purpose is disease in general rather than one disease or disease family, so it is treated as a broad-purpose aggregation.

label: UK10K Rare Neuromuscular Disorders cohort
quote: The neuromuscular disorder samples are part of the “rare disease” group, and will undergo exome sequencing.
note: Patients with rare neuromuscular disorders contributed to the rare-disease arm of UK10K for exome and genome sequencing; a patient collection with no exposure basis.

label: University of Washington ovarian carcinoma cohort
quote: RNAseq data relative to 56 primary and treatment-naive ovarian carcinomas, from independent donors.
note: Series of 56 patients with primary treatment-naive ovarian carcinoma at the University of Washington whose tumours were RNA sequenced; a patient series with no exposure basis.

label: UPTIDER
quote: EXPRESSION OF ANTIBODY-DRUG CONJUGATE TARGETS IN BREAST CANCER METASTASES AND NORMAL TISSUE Using bulk mRNA sequencing, we investigated the expression of 72 ADC targets, which are clinically approved or under investigation, in 909 samples (64 primary untreated, 749 metastatic, 96 normal) from 30 female patients from our post-mortem tissue donation program UPTIDER (NCT04531696).
note: Post-mortem tissue donation programme at UZ Leuven for women with metastatic breast cancer; a patient cohort with no exposure basis.

label: VIVO Biobank
quote: The VIVO biobank currently stores pathological samples from over 600 patients with RMS.
note: UK biobank of pathological samples from over 600 patients with rhabdomyosarcoma and other childhood cancers, sequenced to find risk biomarkers; a patient biobank with no exposure basis.

label: West Coast Prostate Cancer Dream Team
quote: This dataset consists of genome-wide 5hmC methylomes at various stages of prostate cancer, including not only 93 metastases from castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC) patients, but also 5hmC patterns in cell-free DNA (cfDNA).
note: Patients with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer whose metastasis biopsies and plasma were collected by the West Coast Dream Team for sequencing; a patient cohort with no exposure basis.

label: WTCCC case-control study for Ankylosing Spondylitis
quote: WTCCC genome-wide case-control association study for Ankylosing Spondylitis (AS) using the 1958 British Birth Cohort collection as controls.
note: WTCCC collection of ankylosing spondylitis cases from the UK analysed against population controls; the cases of a case-control study, with no exposure basis.

label: WTCCC case-control study for Autoimmune Thyroid Disease
quote: WTCCC genome-wide case-control association study for Autoimmune Thyroid Disease (ATD) using the 1958 British Birth Cohort collection as controls.
note: WTCCC collection of autoimmune thyroid disease cases from the UK analysed against population controls; the cases of a case-control study, with no exposure basis.

label: WTCCC case-control study for Bipolar Disorder
quote: WTCCC genome-wide case-control association study for Bipolar disorder (BD) using the 1958 British Birth Cohort and the UK National Blood Service collections as controls.
note: The Wellcome Trust Case Control Consortium's UK collection of bipolar disorder cases, analysed against 1958 Birth Cohort and blood-donor controls: a disease case series with no exposure basis.

label: WTCCC case-control study for Breast cancer
quote: WTCCC genome-wide case-control association study for Breast cancer (BC) using the 1958 British Birth Cohort collection as controls.
note: The WTCCC UK collection of breast cancer cases, analysed against 1958 Birth Cohort controls: a disease case series with no exposure basis.

label: WTCCC case-control study for Coronary Artery Disease
quote: EGAD00000000004 WTCCC1 project Coronary Artery Disease (CAD) samples
note: The WTCCC UK collection of coronary artery disease cases, analysed against 1958 Birth Cohort and blood-donor controls; the EGA study text mislabels the disease as 'Bipolar disorder (CAD)', so the dataset description is quoted. No exposure basis.

label: WTCCC case-control study for Hypertension
quote: WTCCC genome-wide case-control association study for Hypertension (HT) using the 1958 British Birth Cohort and the UK National Blood Service collections as controls.
note: The WTCCC UK collection of hypertension cases (from the British Genetics of Hypertension study), analysed against population and blood-donor controls: a disease case series with no exposure basis.

label: WTCCC case-control study for Inflammatory Bowel Disease
quote: WTCCC genome-wide case-control association study for Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD) using the 1958 British Birth Cohort and the UK National Blood Service collections as controls.
note: The WTCCC UK collection of inflammatory bowel disease (Crohn's disease) cases, analysed against population and blood-donor controls: a disease case series with no exposure basis.

label: WTCCC case-control study for Multiple Sclerosis
quote: WTCCC genome-wide case-control association study for Multiple Sclerosis (MS) using the 1958 British Birth Cohort collection as controls.
note: The WTCCC UK collection of multiple sclerosis cases, analysed against 1958 Birth Cohort controls: a disease case series with no exposure basis.

label: WTCCC case-control study for Rheumatoid Arthritis
quote: WTCCC genome-wide case-control association study for Rheumatoid Arthritis (RA) using the 1958 British Birth Cohort and the UK National Blood Service collections as controls.
note: The WTCCC UK collection of rheumatoid arthritis cases, analysed against population and blood-donor controls: a disease case series with no exposure basis.

label: WTCCC case-control study for Tuberculosis
quote: WTCCC genome-wide case-control association study for Tuberculosis (TB) using the African samples as controls.
note: The WTCCC African collection of tuberculosis cases with African controls. Participants were selected as TB cases, a disease, not as people exposed to the agent, so this is a disease cohort and not an exposure cohort.

label: WTCCC case-control study for Type 1 Diabetes
quote: WTCCC genome-wide case-control association study for Type 1 Diabetes (T1D) using the 1958 British Birth Cohort and the UK National Blood Service collections as controls.
note: The WTCCC UK collection of type 1 diabetes cases, analysed against population and blood-donor controls: a disease case series with no exposure basis.

label: WTCCC case-control study for Type 2 Diabetes
quote: WTCCC genome-wide case-control association study for Type 2 Diabetes (T2D) using the 1958 British Birth Cohort and the UK National Blood Service collections as controls.
note: The WTCCC UK collection of type 2 diabetes cases, analysed against population and blood-donor controls: a disease case series with no exposure basis.

label: Charles F. and Joanne Knight Alzheimer Disease Research Center
diseases: Alzheimer disease | Alzheimer disease related dementia | frontotemporal dementia | dementia with Lewy bodies
quote: Out of the 6,625 Knight-ADRC participants (Table 1) recruited during the last 30 years, 2,746 of them are classified at the last assessment as AD (with 29 of them being Autosomal Dominant AD), 2,369 are considered cognitively unimpaired, and 1,510 are considered to suffer from other dementias (1,285 AD Related Dementias (ADRD), 153 FTD, and 72 DLB - Table 1.
note: The Washington University Alzheimer Disease Research Center's volunteer cohort: people with Alzheimer disease or related dementias and cognitively unimpaired controls followed for onset, recruited through the Memory and Aging Project and Memory Diagnostic Clinic for Alzheimer disease research. A disease research cohort (cases with controls), not an exposure cohort.

label: Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative
quote: A total of 819 subjects (229 cognitively normal, 398 with MCI, and 192 with AD) were enrolled at baseline and followed for 12 months using standard cognitive and functional measures typical of clinical trials.
note: A multi-site longitudinal cohort of people with mild Alzheimer disease or mild cognitive impairment and cognitively normal controls, enrolled to evaluate imaging and fluid biomarkers of Alzheimer disease progression. A disease cohort with controls; nothing about exposures.

label: Dominantly Inherited Alzheimer Network
quote: DIAN collects comprehensive information and tissue in accordance with standard protocols from asymptomatic and symptomatic ADAD mutation carriers and their non-carrier family members to determine the pathochronology of clinical, cognitive, neuroimaging, and fluid biomarkers of AD.
note: An international cohort of families with autosomal dominant Alzheimer disease mutations: asymptomatic and symptomatic mutation carriers and their non-carrier relatives, selected for their genetic risk of the disease. The selection basis is mutation carriage in a family, so 'at risk'; a genotype is not an environmental exposure.

label: Barcelona-1
diseases: Alzheimer's disease | dementia | mild cognitive impairment
quote: Barcelona -1 is a longitudinal observational study consisting of ~300 subjects at baseline carried out in the Memory and Disorder unit at the University Hospital Mutua de Terrassa, Terrassa, Barcelona, Spain.
note: A memory-clinic cohort from the Memory Disorders Unit of Hospital Mutua de Terrassa; the same paper describes its cases as sporadic AD cases with most other subjects carrying other diagnoses, and the definition names Alzheimer disease dementia, other dementias, MCI and subjective memory complaints. Patients of a memory clinic, so a disease cohort; no exposure basis.

label: Stockholm-Tartu Atherosclerosis Reverse Networks Engineering Task
quote: Coronary artery disease (CAD) patients eligible for coronary artery by-pass grafting (CABG) surgery (n = 200) and controls eligible for other open-heart surgeries (e.g. valve replacement, n = 84), verified to be CAD-free in pre-operative coronary angiograms, were enrolled at the Department of Cardiac Surgery, Tartu University Hospital.
note: Coronary artery disease patients undergoing bypass surgery at Tartu University Hospital, with CAD-free open-heart-surgery comparators, whose tissues were profiled to study cardiometabolic gene regulation. A patient series; no exposure basis.

label: Million Veteran Program
quote: To describe the design and ongoing conduct of the Million Veteran Program (MVP), as an observational cohort study and mega-biobank in the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) health care system.
note: A mega-biobank of United States military veterans enrolled through VA health care to study genetic influences on health and disease broadly. Every participant is a veteran, which the guidance counts as a war-or-military exposure basis, but the cached sources give no exposure-focused design purpose and the cohort is not built around a deployment, so the exposure verdict is borderline. No single disease: a general biobank.

label: Chinese Imaging Genetics study
quote: This study prospectively collected genomic, neuroimaging, environmental, and behavioral data from more than 7000 healthy Chinese Han participants aged 18-30 years.
note: A neuroimaging genetics cohort of healthy young Chinese Han adults whose stated aim is genetic and environmental factors and their interactions on brain phenotypes, with lifelong macro-environmental exposures (climate, air pollution, urbanization, population density, green space) derived from remote sensing and survey data for each participant's residences. Environment is half of the design, so an exposure cohort of medium confidence; healthy volunteers, so not a disease cohort.

label: African American Study of Kidney Disease and Hypertension
quote: Participants include African-American men and women aged 18 to 70 yr who have hypertensive kidney disease and GFR between 20 and 65 ml/min per 1.73 m(2).
note: African American adults with hypertensive chronic kidney disease enrolled in a randomized trial of antihypertensive regimens and blood-pressure goals, then followed in a cohort study of kidney disease progression. Patients with the disease; drug treatment is not an environmental exposure.

label: Amsterdam Dementia Cohort
diseases: dementia | Alzheimer's disease | mild cognitive impairment
quote: The ADC started collecting samples in the year 2000 and is an ongoing, observational follow-up study of patients who visited the memory clinic of the Alzheimer Center at Amsterdam UMC, location VU University medical center (VUmc).
note: All patients who visited the memory clinic of the Alzheimer Center Amsterdam since 2000, followed for research on early diagnosis, heterogeneity and vascular factors in dementia. A memory-clinic patient series; no exposure basis.

label: Protein Aggregation and Neurotransmitter Deficits Study
quote: The purpose of this study is to understand the role of brain proteins and neurotransmitters in the symptoms of PD compared to healthy aging.
note: A Washington University movement-disorders study following people with Parkinson disease and healthy older controls with imaging, motor and cognitive testing to relate brain proteins and neurotransmitters to PD symptoms. A disease cohort with controls; no exposure basis.

label: Protein and Imaging Biomarkers of Parkinson Disease Study
quote: The purpose of this study is to understand the relationship between clinical symptoms and brain changes in people with PD as compared to healthy aging.
note: A Washington University movement-disorders study following people with Parkinson disease and healthy older controls with MRI, PET and clinical testing. A disease cohort with controls; no exposure basis.

label: BioBank Japan
quote: The BBJ is a registry of patients diagnosed with any of 47 target common diseases.
note: A patient-based biobank: every participant was enrolled at a hospital as a patient with one of 47 (later 51) target common diseases, which the source contrasts with population-based biobanks. Participants are selected for having a disease, so 'patients', but the disease list is broad (cancers, cardiometabolic, respiratory and other diseases), which puts it close to the broad-purpose exclusion; no exposure basis.

label: Age, Gene/Environment Susceptibility-Reykjavik Study
quote: The AGES-Reykjavik sample is drawn from an established population-based cohort, the Reykjavik Study.
note: A population-based cohort of older Icelanders drawn from the Reykjavik Study, phenotyped across cardiovascular, neurocognitive, musculoskeletal and metabolic systems to study disease and disability in old age. 'Gene/Environment' in the name refers to risk factors and gene-environment interaction in general, not to a defined exposure or an exposure-measurement design; the purpose spans many diseases, so not a disease cohort.

label: Stanford Alzheimer's Disease Research Center
diseases: dementia | Alzheimer's disease | Lewy body disorders
quote: The SADRC cohort is a longitudinal observational study of clinical dementia subjects and age-sex-matched non-demented subjects.
note: The Stanford Alzheimer's Disease Research Center's observational cohort of people with Alzheimer disease, Lewy body disorders or mild cognitive impairment and matched non-demented controls, focused on Alzheimer disease and Lewy body disorders. A disease cohort with controls; no exposure basis.

label: Canadian Longitudinal Study on Aging
quote: The CLSA recruited participants between 2010 and 2015 who were between the ages of 45–85 years to investigate social, environmental, and other factors that affect aging and disease.
note: A national stratified sample of 51,338 Canadians aged 45-85 assembled as a longitudinal platform for research on health and aging. A general population cohort with a broad purpose: 'environmental' factors are one of many measured, not a design purpose, and no single disease is studied.

label: Jackson Heart Study
quote: JHS is a prospective population-based observational study designed to investigate risk factors for cardiovascular disease (CVD) in Black individuals.
note: Community-based cohort of African American adults in Jackson, Mississippi, designed to investigate risk factors for cardiovascular disease: a population study of one disease family, with no exposure-based selection or purpose.

label: UK Biobank Pharma Proteomics Project
quote: The UKB Pharma Plasma Proteome (UKB-PPP) cohort comprises plasma samples from 54,219 individuals, including 46,595 randomly selected participants, 6,376 consortium-chosen individuals and 1,268 participants from a COVID-19 repeat imaging study.
note: A mostly random sub-sample of UK Biobank participants profiled for plasma proteomics to map pQTLs; a general population biobank subset with no exposure or disease selection.

label: Mass General Brigham Biobank
quote: It collects biological samples and health data from consenting individuals at Massachusetts General Hospital, Brigham and Women’s Hospital, and local healthcare sites within the MGB network66.
note: Healthcare-system biobank of consenting patients across the Mass General Brigham network, not selected for any disease; its interest in environmental context is geospatial and socioeconomic rather than a designed exposure study.

label: Cardiovascular Health Study
quote: The Cardiovascular Health Study (CHS) is a population-based, longitudinal study of coronary heart disease and stroke in adults aged 65 years and older.
note: Population-based cohort of older adults sampled from Medicare lists in four US communities whose stated objective is the onset and course of coronary heart disease and stroke; no exposure-based design.

label: Framingham Heart Study
quote: Whereas the FHS was originally conceived and designed to study the epidemiology of cardiovascular disease, it has evolved over the years with staggering expanded breadth and depth that have far greater implications in the study of the epidemiology of a wide spectrum of human diseases.
note: Community-based multi-generational cohort of Framingham residents conceived and designed to study the epidemiology of cardiovascular disease, the archetypal population study of one disease family; no exposure-based design.

label: Rhineland Study
quote: We used data from the Rhineland Study, an ongoing population-based cohort study in Bonn, Germany, to perform a GWAS on circulating complex lipid levels and composition measured using the Metabolon Complex Lipids Platform.
note: Population-based cohort of Bonn residents aged 30 and over, run by DZNE, whose stated aim is what keeps people healthy or makes them resistant to disease in general, with neurodegenerative and age-related diseases named as one interest: a broad health-and-ageing purpose, not one disease and not an exposure design.

label: European Prospective Investigation into Cancer and Nutrition-Potsdam
quote: EPIC was developed to examine the relationships between diet, nutritional status, lifestyle and environmental factors, as well as the incidence of cancer and other chronic diseases lilke type 2 diabetes.
note: The Potsdam centre of EPIC, a population-based diet-and-cancer cohort in which initially healthy adults are examined for exposure characteristics such as nutritional behaviour; cancer is the disease the cohort was set up for, though the stated purpose extends to other chronic diseases such as type 2 diabetes, hence medium confidence on the disease verdict.

label: Hispanic Community Health Study/Study of Latinos
quote: The HCHS/SOL will recruit 16,000 men and women who self-identify as Hispanic or Latino, 18 to 74 years of age, from a random sample of households in defined communities in the Bronx, Chicago, Miami, and San Diego.
note: Community-based cohort drawn by random household sampling of Hispanic/Latino adults in four US cities, studying heart, lung, blood, sleep, kidney, liver, diabetes, cognitive, dental and hearing conditions together with immigration and acculturation: a broad multi-disease purpose, not an exposure design.

label: Busselton Health Study
quote: The BHS is a community-based study in Western Australia that includes both related and unrelated individuals (predominantly of European ancestry) and has been described in more detail elsewhere46–48.
note: Community-based survey of residents of Busselton, Western Australia, run since 1966 and used for cardiovascular, respiratory, metabolic and ageing research: a general population cohort with no single disease or exposure purpose.

label: Swedish Infrastructure for Medical Population-Based Life-Course and Environmental Research
quote: The Swedish Infrastructure for Medical Population-Based Life-Course and Environmental Research (SIMPLER; https://www.simpler4health.se/w/sh/en) includes data from two large, ongoing population-based studies: the Cohort of Swedish Men (COSM) and the Swedish Mammography Cohort (SMC)58.
note: Research infrastructure combining two population-based Swedish cohorts (COSM and SMC) whose stated purpose is research on dietary and lifestyle factors and genetics in relation to health in later life; the diet-and-lifestyle purpose makes it an exposure-designed aggregation, while its health outcomes are broad rather than one disease.

label: Swedish CArdioPulmonary bioImage Study
diseases: cardiovascular disease | chronic obstructive pulmonary disease
quote: The Swedish CArdioPulmonary BioImage Study (SCAPIS) was initiated as a major joint national effort in Sweden to reduce mortality and morbidity from cardiovascular disease (CVD), chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) and related metabolic disorders, all of which are important issues for public health.
note: Randomly recruited national population cohort of Swedes aged 50-64 whose stated purpose is cardiopulmonary disease (cardiovascular disease and COPD with related metabolic disorders); treated as a population study of a named disease family rather than a broad chronic-disease cohort, hence medium confidence. No exposure-based design.

label: Malmö Offspring Study
quote: The study participants of MOS consists of invited adult children and grandchildren to participants in the Malmö Diet and Cancer Study—Cardiovascular Cohort (MDCS-CC, n = 6103), which is a random, deeply phenotyped subpopulation of the Malmö Diet and Cancer Study (MDCS) [17].
note: Family-based cohort of the adult children and grandchildren of a random Malmö population sample, mapping risk factors for family traits of chronic diseases in general; diet is one of many measured factors, not the defining or main subject.

label: Metabolic Syndrome in Men Study
quote: METSIM is a study of 10,197 Finnish men from Kuopio in the late-settlement region of northeast Finland designed to investigate factors associated with type 2 diabetes and cardiovascular diseases3 (Supplementary Table 2).
note: Population-based cohort of Finnish men designed to investigate risk factors for type 2 diabetes and cardiovascular disease, the cardiometabolic disease family its name (Metabolic Syndrome in Men) points to; medium confidence because the purpose spans two related diseases. No exposure-based design.

label: Qatar Genome Program
quote: The QGP is a population-based study designed to perform whole genome sequencing of the Qatar Biobank (QBB) participants9 with the aim to gain insights into the population structure and the genetic architecture of clinically relevant phenotypes in the Middle Eastern Qatari population.
note: National whole-genome sequencing programme of Qatar Biobank volunteers to characterise the Qatari population; a population biobank with no disease or exposure selection.

label: Trøndelag Health Study
quote: In the HUNT Study, all residents aged ≥20 years in the Nord-Trøndelag region, Norway, have been invited to repeated surveys since 1984-86.
note: Total-population health survey of all adult residents of Trøndelag County, Norway, covering a broad range of health topics; a general population cohort with no disease or exposure selection.

label: Simons Foundation Powering Autism Research for Knowledge
quote: Any individual living in the United States with a professional diagnosis (by a physician, psychologist, or therapist) of ASD plus their parents and an unaffected sibling are eligible to participate in SPARK.
note: Nationwide US cohort of individuals with a professional diagnosis of autism spectrum disorder and their family members, built to accelerate autism research; a patient (family-based) disease cohort with no exposure basis.

label: Chronic Renal Insufficiency Cohort Study
quote: The Chronic Renal Insufficiency Cohort (CRIC) Study is an ongoing, multicenter, longitudinal study of nearly 5500 adults with CKD in the United States.
note: Multicentre prospective cohort of adults with chronic kidney disease enrolled at seven US clinical centres to study progression of kidney disease and cardiovascular disease; a patient cohort, not exposure-defined.

label: Systematic and Combined Analysis of Olink Proteins
quote: Each SCALLOP member works on human study collections from the general population, clinical trials or patients with certain diseases such as coronary artery disease, rheumatoid arthritis, bipolar disease, heart failure, dementias or metabolic syndrome.
note: Consortium pooling Olink proteomics and genotype data from general population cohorts, clinical trials and patient collections of many unrelated diseases to map pQTLs; it collects no single disease and no exposure-based cohorts.

label: China Medical University Hospital Biobank
quote: The study participants were part of the China Medical University Hospital (CMUH) Precision Medicine Project, a systemic effort initiated in 2018 to recruit subjects and collect biospecimens from all patients who come to CMUH for medical visits [69,70].
note: Hospital-based biobank recruiting all patients attending China Medical University Hospital, Taichung, for medical visits, used for GWAS and PheWAS across hundreds of traits; unselected for any disease or exposure.

label: Religious Orders Study and Rush Memory and Aging Project
quote: The Religious Orders Study and Rush Memory and Aging Project are both ongoing longitudinal clinical-pathologic cohort studies of aging and Alzheimer's disease (AD).
note: Pair of volunteer cohorts of older adults enrolled without dementia, with annual evaluation and brain donation, whose stated purpose is Alzheimer's disease; a cohort set up to study one disease, not exposure-based.

label: Mayo Clinic Biobank
quote: Participants were all Mayo Clinic patients, 18 years of age or older and US residents.
note: Clinic-based biobank of unselected adult Mayo Clinic patients established to supply controls for case-control studies and a prospective cohort for common outcomes; no disease or exposure selection.

label: HOLBAEK Study
quote: The study population consisted of children and adolescents from the HOLBAEK Study (previously known as The Danish Childhood Obesity Biobank),17 including an obesity clinic cohort with a BMI above the 90th percentile for sex and age (BMI standard deviation score [SDS] > 1.28) according to a Danish reference; and a population-based cohort, recruited from schools in 11 municipalities in Zealand, Denmark.
note: Danish childhood obesity biobank combining an obesity clinic cohort of children and adolescents in treatment with a population-based reference cohort; obesity counts as a disease, so a patient cohort with controls, not exposure-based.

label: FinnGen
quote: The FinnGen study (https://www.finngen.fi/en) is an ongoing research project that utilizes samples from a nationwide network of Finnish biobanks and digital healthcare data from national health registers.
note: Nationwide Finnish biobank-plus-register study of about 500,000 people studying thousands of disease endpoints; hospital-based recruitment enriches it for disease in general but it is selected for no single disease and no exposure.

label: NIHR BioResource Rare Diseases Study
quote: Patients with rare diseases and their close relatives were enrolled into 15 rare disease domains approved by the Sequencing and Informatics Committee of the NBR.
note: Whole-genome sequencing cohort of patients with rare diseases (or extreme quantitative traits), their affected relatives and controls, enrolled at NHS hospitals for diagnosis and gene discovery; a patient cohort across 15 rare disease domains, not exposure-based.

label: Australian Imaging, Biomarker & Lifestyle Flagship Study of Ageing
quote: Participants with AD (211) had neuropsychological profiles which were consistent with AD, and were more impaired than participants with mild cognitive impairment (133) or healthy controls (768), who performed within expected norms for age on neuropsychological testing.
note: Longitudinal volunteer cohort of people over 60 with Alzheimer's disease, mild cognitive impairment and healthy controls recruited for prospective research into Alzheimer's disease; lifestyle factors are one class of candidate predictor alongside imaging and biomarkers, not the cohort's defining or main subject, so not an exposure cohort.

label: PopGen Biobank
quote: PopGen currently pursues recruitment, sampling and processing activities in close collaboration with a multitude of clinical partners, covering cardiovascular, neuropsychiatric and environmental diseases.
note: A population-based biobank in northern Germany that ascertains patients across cardiovascular, neuropsychiatric and other complex diseases together with population controls. A multi-disease genetic-epidemiology resource with no exposure design, so neither an exposure cohort nor a cohort of one disease.

label: Diabetic Nephropathy Cohort
quote: This prospective study included Chinese T2D participants from the Singapore Study of Macro-angiopathy and Micro-vascular Reactivity in Type 2 Diabetes (SMART2D) and Diabetic Nephropathy (DN) cohorts.
note: Outpatients with type 2 diabetes recruited at a Singapore diabetes centre and followed for diabetic nephropathy and cardiovascular events; a patient cohort, with no exposure-based selection.

label: Singapore Study of Macro-Angiopathy and Micro-Vascular Reactivity in Type 2 Diabetes
quote: A total of 2258 patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) were recruited at baseline.
note: A prospective cohort of patients with type 2 diabetes recruited in northern Singapore to study vascular function and diabetes complications; a patient cohort, not exposure-defined.

label: Women's Health Initiative
quote: The Women's Health Initiative (WHI) is a large and complex clinical investigation of strategies for the prevention and control of some of the most common causes of morbidity and mortality among postmenopausal women, including cancer, cardiovascular disease, and osteoporotic fractures.
note: Postmenopausal women enrolled into prevention trials (low-fat eating pattern, hormone therapy, calcium and vitamin D) or a parallel observational study, followed for cancer, cardiovascular disease and fractures. The dietary arm is an assigned intervention rather than an exposure-defined design, and the purpose spans several disease families, so neither verdict is yes.

label: Study of Health in Pomerania-TREND
quote: To identify determinants of the anti-TSST-1 antibody response, we examined 976 participants of the German population-based epidemiological Study of Health in Pomerania (SHIP-TREND-0).
note: A population-based sample of adults from Western Pomerania recruited as the second SHIP cohort for general health research; no exposure or disease selection.

label: Korean Genome and Epidemiology Study
quote: KoGES includes the community-based Ansan and Ansung study, the urban community-based health examinee study, and the rural community-based cardiovascular disease association study.
note: A consortium of Korean population-based cohorts and a national biobank set up to study the genetic and environmental aetiology of common complex diseases. Environmental exposure data are collected among many variables, but the design is a general-purpose population resource, not an exposure or single-disease study.

label: Netherlands Epidemiology of Obesity Study
quote: The Netherlands Epidemiology of Obesity (NEO) study is designed to investigate the pathways that lead to obesity-related diseases and conditions in a population-based prospective cohort study of individuals aged 45–65 years, with an oversampling of individuals with overweight or obesity.
note: A population-based cohort from the Leiden area in which people with a BMI of 27 or higher were eligible, oversampling overweight and obesity, designed to trace pathways to obesity-related diseases. Participants were selected for a disease-risk state (obesity counting as a disease), not for an environmental exposure.

label: Wisconsin Registry for Alzheimer's Prevention
quote: The Wisconsin Registry for Alzheimer's Prevention is a longitudinal observational cohort study enriched with persons with a parental history (PH) of probable Alzheimer's disease (AD) dementia.
note: Middle-aged adults enriched for a parental history of Alzheimer's disease dementia, followed for preclinical Alzheimer's disease; a cohort selected for disease risk, with no exposure basis.

label: Wisconsin Alzheimer's Disease Research Center
quote: The purpose of the Wisconsin Alzheimer's Disease Research Center (ADRC) Clinical Core is to help researchers identify people at risk for Alzheimer’s disease earlier and find better ways to prevent and treat Alzheimer’s disease and related memory disorders.
note: The Clinical Core longitudinal cohort of the Wisconsin ADRC, recruiting people with mild Alzheimer's disease or mild cognitive impairment alongside healthy controls and middle-aged adults with a parental history of Alzheimer's disease; a disease cohort of patients and at-risk relatives, not exposure-defined.

label: Food Chain Plus
diseases: metabolic inflammation | type 2 diabetes mellitus | obesity
quote: The aims of the study are to identify determinants of the development and progression of (A) diseases based on chronic inflammation (e.g. type 2 diabetes mellitus); (B) associated comorbidities (e.g. cardiovascular disease, retinopathy, neuropathy and nephropathy); and (C) developing comorbidities, such as gastrointestinal, musculoskeletal and respiratory diseases.
note: A Kiel-region cohort of which three quarters were drawn at random from residents' registers and one quarter were patients with metabolic inflammation from the university obesity outpatient centre, set up to study metabolic inflammation and the diseases it drives. Nutrition profiling is one of many data layers rather than an exposure-centred design, so the exposure verdict is no; the single-pathology purpose and patient component make it a disease cohort.

label: Amish Complex Disease Research Program
quote: To date, over 7000 Amish adults have participated in one or more of our studies as part of the Amish Complex Disease Research Program72.
note: A University of Maryland research programme collecting studies of the Old Order Amish founder population of Lancaster County on the genetics of complex diseases (osteoporosis, cardiometabolic traits, longevity). Its members are population and family studies across many diseases with no exposure design, so both verdicts are no.

label: BioVU
quote: In 2007, VUMC launched a biobank, BioVU, and the BioVU Consent form is provided to patients in the outpatient clinic environments at VUMC.
note: A practice-based biobank of DNA from leftover clinical blood of Vanderbilt patients linked to de-identified health records; donors are unselected for any disease or exposure.

label: Southall and Brent Revisited
quote: Southall and Brent REvisited: cohort profile of SABRE, a UK population-based comparison of cardiovascular disease and diabetes in people of European, Indian Asian and African Caribbean origins.
note: A population-based tri-ethnic London cohort set up in 1988 to compare cardiovascular disease and diabetes between European, South Asian and African Caribbean people, described more loosely in a 2024 paper as a study of ethnic differences in chronic disease. Taken as a population study of one cardiometabolic disease family; no exposure basis.

label: Gut-and-Liver Axis in Alcoholic Liver Fibrosis
quote: 558 adults with alcohol-related liver disease aged 19–82 years, matched with healthy controls recruited from the Region of Southern Denmark5.
note: Consecutively recruited patients with a history of harmful drinking and early alcohol-related liver disease, with matched healthy controls, from Odense within the EU GALAXY consortium. Selection on harmful alcohol use makes it an exposure-defined cohort, and the participants are patients with alcohol-related liver disease.

label: Cardiovascular Risk in Young Finns Study
quote: The sample comprised 2776 participants (54 % female) from the Cardiovascular Risk in Young Finns Study who had CVD risk factor data measured in childhood in 1980 (aged 3-18 years) and markers of preclinical CVD measured in adulthood.
note: A population-based cohort of Finnish children and adolescents sampled in 1980 and followed into adulthood to relate childhood cardiovascular risk factors to preclinical cardiovascular disease, as its name states. A general population cohort devoted to one disease family; no exposure basis.

label: Study of Colorectal Cancer in Scotland
quote: We conducted the analysis in a well-characterized population-based study of 5,675 patients after CRC diagnosis in Scotland.
note: A population-based case-control study of colorectal cancer in Scotland whose cases are followed for survival; the participants of interest are colorectal cancer patients, with no exposure-based selection.

label: China Kadoorie Biobank
quote: The China Kadoorie Biobank (CKB) is a population-based prospective cohort of >512,000 adults recruited from 2004 to 2008 from 10 geographically diverse regions across China.
note: A population-based prospective biobank of half a million adults from ten regions of China studying many diseases and risk factors; no exposure or disease selection.

label: All of Us Research Program
quote: The All of Us Research Program plans to enroll a diverse group of at least 1 million persons in the United States in order to accelerate biomedical research and improve health.
note: A national precision-medicine cohort enrolling a million diverse US adults with questionnaires, health records and biospecimens; a general population resource with no exposure or disease selection.

label: BioMe Biobank
quote: A snLVEF genetic risk score (GRS) was applied and cases of snLVEF were identified in 486 754 individuals across two population-based cohorts (BioMe Biobank and UK Biobank).
note: An electronic health record-linked biobank enrolling patients of the Mount Sinai Health System non-selectively; a general biobank with no exposure or disease selection.

label: Coronary Artery Risk Development in Young Adults Study
quote: The longitudinal CARDIA study was initiated in 1985 with the recruitment of young adult participants (aged 18-30 years) equally balanced by female and male sex and black and white race at 4 field centers located in Birmingham, AL, Chicago, IL, Minneapolis, MN, and Oakland, CA.
note: A prospective cohort of Black and White young adults recruited in 1985-1986 at four US centres and followed into midlife for the development of coronary and cardiovascular risk factors and disease, as its name states. A general population cohort devoted to one disease family; not exposure-defined.

label: Health for Life in Singapore
quote: Participants were recruited from the Singapore general population11,13,14.
note: A population-based multi-ethnic cohort of 10,004 Singapore residents for precision-medicine research on diverse diseases; no exposure or disease selection.

label: Cleveland Family Study
quote: The Cleveland Family Study (CFS) was designed to investigate the familial basis of SDB, with four visits occurring from 1990 to 2006 [21].
note: A family study built around index probands with laboratory-confirmed obstructive sleep apnoea, their relatives and neighbourhood control families, designed to study the familial basis of sleep-disordered breathing. A disease cohort of patients and their at-risk relatives; no exposure basis.

label: deCODE genetics Icelandic cohort
quote: This study is based on whole-genome sequence data from the whole blood of 15,220 Icelanders participating in various disease projects at deCODE genetics.
note: A population sample of Icelanders recruited through deCODE's many disease-specific projects and its general-population deCODE Health Study, used for genome-wide studies of diseases and traits at large. A multi-disease national resource with no exposure design, so both verdicts are no.

label: PainOMICS Retrospective Study
quote: We validated SOPs used in the PainOmics retrospective study to find -omics biomarker to stratify patients with chronic low back pain recruited in the second middle of 2014.
note: A multicentre retrospective case-control study of patients with chronic low back pain and pain-free controls run by the EU PainOMICS project; a patient cohort with no exposure basis.

label: The Pomak cohort
quote: We use whole-genome sequencing (WGS) to capture the entire allele frequency spectrum in 2,893 samples from two Greek population-based cohorts, MANOLIS and Pomak.
note: A population-based cohort of adult volunteers from the isolated Pomak villages of northern Greece recruited within the Hellenic Isolated Cohorts to study the genetics of complex traits; no exposure or disease selection.

label: Genetic Epidemiology Research on Adult Health and Aging
quote: Participants in the GERA cohort were recruited from the adult membership of the KPNC health plan, a large integrated health care system that provides comprehensive medical services to four million members.
note: GERA is a general cohort of adult Kaiser Permanente Northern California health-plan members within RPGEH, genotyped as a resource for GWAS of diverse traits and conditions; participants were selected neither for an exposure nor for a disease.

label: Correlated Expression and Disease Association Research
quote: We collected peripheral blood as well as intestinal biopsies (ileum, transverse colon, rectum) from 323 healthy Europeans visiting the Academic Hospital of the University of Liège as part of a national screening campaign for colon cancer.
note: CEDAR is a panel of about 320 healthy adults recruited at a colon-cancer screening campaign in Liège whose blood-cell and gut transcriptomes serve as an eQTL resource; it was built to interpret IBD risk loci, but its participants are healthy volunteers rather than patients, so it is not a disease cohort, and no exposure defines it.

label: Generation Scotland: Scottish Family Health Study
quote: Generation Scotland (GS) is a large family-based cohort study established as a longitudinal resource for research into the genetic, lifestyle and environmental determinants of physical and mental health.
note: Generation Scotland is a family-based general-population cohort recruited through general practices as a broad resource for physical and mental health research; environment is one of many determinants and no single disease is its purpose.

label: Genetic Epidemiology Network of Arteriopathy
quote: In the first phase of GENOA (Phase I: 1996–2001), sibships with at least two adults with clinically diagnosed essential hypertension before age 60 were recruited, and all siblings in the sibship were invited to participate regardless of hypertension status.
note: GENOA recruited sibships ascertained on at least two siblings with clinically diagnosed essential hypertension before age 60, to find genes for blood pressure and hypertensive target-organ damage; recruitment is by disease (hypertensive sibships, normotensive siblings included), and no environmental exposure defines the cohort.

label: Northern Finland Birth Cohorts
quote: We used data from two general population birth cohort studies, Northern Finland Birth Cohorts 1966 and 1986 (NFBC1966 and NFBC1986).
note: The Northern Finland Birth Cohorts programme collects two general-population birth cohorts (1966 and 1986) followed from the fetal period for health and well-being; neither an exposure nor a disease defines them.

label: Taiwan Biobank
quote: To advance epidemiological and biomedical research, Taiwan launched its own biobank, the Taiwan Biobank (TWB), in 2012, which prospectively collected a wide variety of lifestyle behaviors, environmental risk factors, and family history of common, complex diseases in the general Taiwanese population and measured genetic information in the biobank participants.
note: Taiwan Biobank is a prospective population biobank of volunteers from the general Taiwanese population; it records lifestyle and environmental exposures among many variables without exposure being its design purpose, and it targets no single disease.

label: GeneRISK study
quote: We use data from the prospective GeneRISK cohort46 whose principal aim is to assess the impact of communication of genetic risk information of CVD to study participants.
note: GeneRISK is a general-population cohort of Finnish adults (population register, occupational health customers, blood donors) set up to test how returning polygenic and clinical risk for atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease changes health behaviour; participants were not selected for disease, but the cohort's stated purpose is one disease family, so it is a population study of cardiovascular disease; no exposure defines it.

label: Healthy Aging in Neighborhoods of Diversity across the Life Span
quote: We designed a multidisciplinary, community-based, prospective longitudinal epidemiologic study among socioeconomically diverse African Americans and Whites.
note: HANDLS is an area-probability community sample of Baltimore adults stratified by age, sex, race and poverty status to study how race and socioeconomic status shape age-related health disparities; socioeconomic status alone is not an environmental exposure under these rules, and its health outcomes are broad.

label: Mount Sinai Crohn's and Colitis Registry
quote: Patients with UC (n=484) or CD (n=464) and HCs (ages 18+, n=365) were recruited as part of a cross-sectional study, the Mount Sinai Crohn’s and Colitis Registry (MSCCR), between December 2013 and September 2016 from the outpatient and endoscopy units of the Mount Sinai Hospital.
note: MSCCR is a registry of about 1,500 adults recruited at endoscopy at Mount Sinai Hospital, mostly patients with ulcerative colitis or Crohn's disease plus non-IBD controls, for molecular studies of inflammatory bowel disease; a patient series with controls, not an exposure cohort.

label: Netherlands Study of Depression and Anxiety
quote: The Netherlands Study of Depression and Anxiety (NESDA, www.nesda.nl) is a longitudinal, multi-site, naturalistic, case-control cohort study set up to examine the etiology, course and consequences of depressive and anxiety disorders.
note: NESDA recruited adults with current or remitted depressive and/or anxiety disorders, at-risk persons and healthy controls from the general population, primary care and mental health care to follow the course of these disorders; a case-control disease cohort with no defining exposure.

label: Health, Aging and Body Composition Study
quote: The Health, Aging, and Body Composition (Health ABC) study11 was a prospective longitudinal observational study designed to assess the association of body composition with physical function and disability in older adults.
note: Health ABC enrolled community-dwelling adults aged 70-79 from Medicare lists and Black residents of Pittsburgh and Memphis to study body composition, functional decline and disability in ageing; a population cohort of older adults with a broad purpose, selected neither for exposure nor for disease.

label: Michigan Genomics Initiative
quote: Here, we describe the Michigan Genomics Initiative (MGI), a single-health-system biobank currently consisting of >91,000 participants recruited primarily during surgical encounters at Michigan Medicine.
note: MGI is a health-system biobank of adult patients consented mainly at surgery, enriched for many diseases but for none in particular; a broad disease-genetics resource, not a cohort of patients with one disease, and no exposure defines it.

label: Immune and Metabolic Markers during Pregnancy and Child Development Study
diseases: autism spectrum disorder | other neurodevelopmental disorders
quote: Although this cohort was ascertained for children with autism spectrum disorder (ASD) and other neurodevelopmental disorders (DD), we gained novel insight into how maternal and fetal genetics shape levels of immune mediators in pregnancy.
note: IMPaCT is a case-control study of KPNC mother-child pairs oversampling children later diagnosed with autism spectrum disorder or other developmental delay, with general-population controls, to study maternal immune and metabolic markers in pregnancy; the cases of a case-control study make it a disease cohort, and no environmental exposure defines it.

label: Cohorts for Heart and Aging Research in Genomic Epidemiology Consortium
quote: Special features of the CHARGE consortium are the large overall sample size, the population-based recruitment of cohort members, the standardized methods of data collection, and the prospective follow-up for clinical events.
note: CHARGE collects large prospective population-based cohorts (AGES, ARIC, CHS, FHS, Rotterdam and later others) for GWAS meta-analysis across many cardiovascular and ageing-related phenotypes; its members are population cohorts and its stated purpose is methodological and broad (heart and ageing research), so it is neither an exposure nor a single-disease aggregation.

label: Helsinki Birth Cohort Study
quote: This study was carried out in 1082 subjects belonging to the Helsinki Birth Cohort Study, which consists of men and women born between 1934 and 1944, in Helsinki, Finland, representing a general population of elderly people.
note: HBCS is a birth cohort of all singletons born in two Helsinki maternity hospitals in 1934-1944, followed to study how early life shapes adult health; a general-population birth cohort, and the persistent-organic-pollutant analysis in one paper is a use of the cohort, not its design.

label: Generation R Study
quote: The study is designed to identify early environmental and genetic causes and causal pathways leading to normal and abnormal growth, development and health from fetal life, childhood and young adulthood.
note: Generation R is a population-based birth cohort in Rotterdam designed to identify early environmental and genetic causes of growth, development and health, naming environmental, endocrine, lifestyle and nutritional determinants as its main exposures of interest, and it is listed in the Global Exposome Cohort Catalogue; its outcomes are broad, so it is not a disease cohort.

label: 500 Functional Genomics
quote: The 500FG cohort is a population-based cohort of healthy individuals of Western European ancestry consisting of 237 males and 296 females with age range of 18-75 years.
note: 500FG is about 500 healthy adult volunteers recruited at Radboudumc to characterise variation in cytokine and immune responses; the host and environmental factors it examines (age, sex, BMI, season, vitamin D) are not environmental exposures in the sense used here, and healthy volunteers are not a disease cohort.

label: MyCode Community Health Initiative
quote: In 2007, Geisinger launched MyCode, a system-wide biobanking program to link samples and EHR data for broad research use.
note: MyCode is a health-system biobank of Geisinger patients consented for broad research use with EHR linkage and genotype and exome data; patients of an integrated health system without selection for one disease or for an exposure.

label: 23andMe research cohort
quote: All participants were drawn from the customer base of 23andMe, Inc., a direct-to-consumer genetics company.
note: The 23andMe research cohort is the company's consenting customer base answering online questionnaires; unselected consumers with no defining exposure or disease.

label: LIFE-Adult-Study
quote: The LIFE-Adult-Study is a population-based cohort study, which has recently completed the baseline examination of 10,000 randomly selected participants from Leipzig, a major city with 550,000 inhabitants in the east of Germany.
note: LIFE-Adult is a random population sample of Leipzig adults deeply phenotyped for major civilization diseases (metabolic, vascular, cognitive, depression, sleep, retinal, allergies); a broad multi-disease purpose in an unselected population, with no defining exposure.

label: Red Blood Cell-Omics Study
quote: As part of the REDS-III RBC-Omics study, a cohort of 12,535 volunteer blood donors were enrolled to donate a unit of blood that was processed into RBC components that were characterized for storage hemolysis parameters.
note: RBC-Omics enrolled about 13,400 volunteer blood donors at four US blood centres to study donor iron metabolism and red-cell storage haemolysis; unselected donors, not a disease or exposure cohort.

label: Corogene Study
diseases: coronary heart disease | acute coronary syndrome
quote: Corogene is a prospective, consecutive cohort study of Finnish patients referred for coronary angiography to the Helsinki University Central Hospital between 2006 and 2008.
note: Corogene is a consecutive series of Finnish patients referred for coronary angiography, assembled to study genetic predisposition to coronary heart disease, with its acute coronary syndrome cases forming a case-control sample against FINRISK controls; a patient cohort with no defining exposure.

label: Health 2000 GenMets Study
quote: In the current study, we used the GenMets sample, which includes individuals with metabolic syndrome and matched control subjects drawn from the Health 2000 study.
note: GenMets is a case-control sub-cohort of the Finnish Health 2000 survey of participants with metabolic syndrome and matched controls, genotyped for the genetics of metabolic syndrome; the cases of a case-control study, with no defining exposure.

label: Qatar Metabolomics Study on Diabetes
quote: Inclusion criteria were a primary form of type 2 diabetes (for patients) or an absence of type 2 diabetes (for controls).
note: QMDiab is a cross-sectional case-control study of 374 people with and without type 2 diabetes enrolled at Hamad Medical Corporation in Doha for multi-fluid metabolomics of diabetes; a patient case-control cohort, not an exposure cohort.

label: Genetic Study of Atherosclerosis Risk
quote: Participants came from EA and AA families identified from 1983 to 2006 from probands with a premature coronary disease event before 60 years of age who were identified at the time of hospitalization in any of 10 Baltimore area hospitals.
note: GeneSTAR enrolled the apparently healthy 30-59-year-old siblings of probands hospitalised with a premature coronary disease event before age 60 in Baltimore, to find environmental, phenotypic and genetic causes of premature cardiovascular disease; relatives of patients are an at-risk disease cohort, and the two-week aspirin trial is a medication, not an environmental exposure.

label: Nurses' Health Study
quote: We have summarized the evolution of the Nurses' Health Study (NHS), a prospective cohort study of 121 700 married registered nurses launched in 1976; NHS II, which began in 1989 and enrolled 116 430 nurses; and NHS3, which began in 2010 and has ongoing enrollment.
note: A prospective cohort of US registered nurses enrolled in 1976 and followed by questionnaire for lifestyle and other risk factors of major chronic diseases; the nurses were enrolled as reliable reporters, not for an occupational hazard. Lifestyle (diet, smoking, alcohol, activity) is the study's main subject per the definition, but the cached source only says lifestyle data were generated, so the exposure verdict is low confidence; the disease scope is chronic diseases broadly, so it is not a disease cohort.

label: Penn Medicine BioBank
quote: All individuals were patients of the University of Pennsylvania Health System and were enrolled in the Penn Medicine BioBank.
note: An EHR-linked biobank of unselected patients of the University of Pennsylvania Health System recruited in outpatient clinics for genomic discovery across all phenotypes; no exposure and no single disease defines it.

label: Epidemiological Investigation of Rheumatoid Arthritis
quote: EIRA, a case–control study established in 1996, currently contains >5000 incident RA cases from the middle and southern regions of Sweden [18].
note: A Swedish population-based case-control study of incident rheumatoid arthritis cases and population controls, started expressly to investigate environmental risk factors (cigarette smoking foremost) and their interaction with genotype; the cases make it a disease cohort and its stated design makes it an exposure cohort.

label: Ludwigshafen Risk and Cardiovascular Health Study
quote: The Ludwigshafen risk and cardiovascular (LURIC) health study is an ongoing study to explore risk factors for cardiovascular diseases and is aimed at the understanding of genes, environments, medications, and their associations with cardiac health [9].
note: A hospital-based cohort of patients referred for coronary angiography in Ludwigshafen, with and without coronary artery disease, followed to study risk factors for cardiovascular disease; environmental factors and chemical exposures are listed among many risk factors, not as the design's centre.

label: Diabetes Heart Study
diseases: type 2 diabetes | diabetic heart disease | cardiovascular disease
quote: The Diabetes Heart Study (DHS) is a community-based study of the genetic and epidemiological contributions to diabetic heart disease in which siblings concordant for type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM), as well as unaffected family members, were recruited from internal medicine and endocrinology clinics in western North Carolina.
note: A family study of siblings concordant for type 2 diabetes (plus unaffected relatives) recruited from clinics in North Carolina to study diabetic heart disease and subclinical cardiovascular disease; the affected sib-pairs make it a patient cohort, and no environmental exposure is part of its design.

label: Genetics of Personality Consortium
quote: Genome-wide association meta-analysis of 30 cohorts with genome-wide genotype, personality, and MDD data from the Genetics of Personality Consortium.
note: A consortium of about 30 population, twin and family cohorts pooled for GWAS meta-analyses of personality traits (neuroticism, extraversion); personality is a trait, and major depressive disorder status is available only in a few member cohorts as a secondary phenotype, so neither verdict is yes.

label: Genetic Risk Assessment for Chinese Eaglet-T1D
quote: We validated our results in two independent type 1 diabetes case–control cohorts (Children's Hospital of Philadelphia, Center for Applied Genomics [CHOP-CAG] and Genetic Risk Assessment for Chinese Eaglet-T1D [GRACE]) and two population-based cohorts (All of Us and UK Biobank).
note: A Chinese multicentre paediatric case-control collection of children with type 1 diabetes and controls used to validate polygenic risk scores; the cases make it a disease cohort and no exposure is involved.

label: Academic Medical Center Amsterdam Premature Atherosclerosis Study
quote: We included a total of 979 unique patients from the previously described prospective cohort AMC-PAS[6], with symptomatic Coronary Artery Disease (CAD) before the age of 51 years, defined as Myocardial Infarction (MI), coronary revascularization, or evidence of at least 70% stenosis in a major epicardial artery.
note: A prospective cohort of Academic Medical Center Amsterdam patients with symptomatic coronary artery disease before age 51, used for genetic studies of premature atherosclerosis; a patient series with no exposure basis.

label: Bogalusa Heart Study
quote: The BHS is a long-term epidemiology study of the natural history of cardiovascular disease from childhood to adulthood in the community of Bogalusa (65% white, 35% African American), Louisiana, the United States
note: A community-based cohort of children and adolescents of Bogalusa, Louisiana, begun in 1972 to study cardiovascular risk factors and the natural history of cardiovascular disease from early life; a Framingham-type population study of one disease family, with no exposure basis.

label: Cleveland Family Speech and Reading Study
diseases: speech sound disorder | childhood apraxia of speech
quote: We conducted a GWAS in the Cleveland Family Speech and Reading Study (CFSRS), a cohort ascertained through a proband with SSD, and replicated findings in a population-based cohort.
note: A family-based longitudinal cohort ascertained through children referred by speech-language pathologists with a speech sound disorder (including childhood apraxia of speech), with their siblings, followed for 25 years; speech sound disorder is a neurodevelopmental (DSM) disorder, so the probands make it a patient cohort, and no exposure is involved.

label: Genetics of Opioid Addiction Consortium
quote: We applied genomic structural equation modeling to conduct a GWAS of the new Genetics of Opioid Addiction Consortium (GENOA) data together with published studies (Psychiatric Genomics Consortium, Million Veteran Program, and Partners Health), comprising 23,367 cases and effective sample size of 88,114 individuals of European ancestry.
note: A consortium pooling twelve case-control GWAS samples of opioid addiction (Yale-Penn, COGA, deCODE, VIDUS and others); addiction counts as a disease, so it is a patient aggregation, and opioid use is a drug rather than an environmental agent, so it is not an exposure cohort.

label: Genetics of Opioid Addiction Study
quote: The GENOA and POST studies were designed to identify factors associated with opioid use and treatment outcomes including genetic risk factors in patients diagnosed with OUD and receiving treatment37.
note: A prospective cohort of adults with DSM-IV opioid dependence receiving methadone maintenance treatment at Canadian Addiction Treatment Centre clinics in Ontario, studied for genetic and other predictors of treatment outcomes; a patient cohort of an addiction disorder, with no environmental-exposure basis.

label: deCODE Health Study
quote: Speech samples were obtained from 14,144 Icelandic participants as a part of the deCODE Health Study in Iceland, which involves comprehensive phenotyping of a general population sample.
note: A comprehensively phenotyped general-population sample of Icelanders (enriched for carriers of rare variants) used for genetic association studies of many traits; neither disease nor exposure defines it.

label: Qatar Biobank
quote: The Qatar Biobank involves collection of extensive questionnaire information, clinical phenotyping and biological samples from Qatari nationals and long-term residents (≥15 years living in Qatar) aged 18 or more years, who comprise the eligible population.
note: A population-based prospective biobank of adult Qatari nationals and long-term residents recruited to study the causes and burden of disease in general; environmental and lifestyle factors are measured among many variables, so neither verdict is yes.

label: Reykjavik Study
quote: In brief, the Reykjavik Study is a population based cohort study established in 1967 by the Icelandic Heart Association to prospectively study cardiovascular disease in Iceland.
note: A random population sample of Reykjavik residents born 1907-1935, examined from 1967 by the Icelandic Heart Association to prospectively study cardiovascular disease and its risk factors; a population study of one disease family, with no exposure basis.

label: Human Functional Genomics Project
quote: The 500FG cohort consists of 534 healthy individuals of Caucasian origin and is part of the Human Functional Genomics Project (HFGP).
note: A Nijmegen research programme collecting cohorts of healthy volunteers (500FG, 200FG, 300BCG) and some patient groups (obese, diabetic, HIV) to identify genetic and non-genetic determinants of immune and cytokine responses; its subject is immune variability, not one disease, and host factors such as season and vitamin D are studied as covariates rather than as an exposure design.

label: Recipient Epidemiology and Donor Evaluation Study-III
quote: The Recipient Epidemiology and Donor Evaluation Study-III (REDS-III) is a 7-year multicenter transfusion safety research initiative launched in 2011 by the National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute.
note: An NHLBI transfusion-medicine research programme collecting blood donors and transfusion recipients (RBC-Omics donors, the Brazil sickle cell disease cohort and other protocols); its scope is blood safety and donor and recipient outcomes rather than one disease, and transfusion is a medical procedure, not an environmental exposure.

label: Research Program on Genes, Environment and Health
quote: The RPGEH was developed by the KPNC Division of Research as a resource that links together surveys, biospecimens and electronic health record data for research on the genetic and environmental determinants of common, age-related complex health conditions.
note: A Kaiser Permanente Northern California resource of consenting health-plan members (including the GERA adult cohort and a pregnancy cohort) linking surveys, biospecimens and records for common complex conditions; despite 'Environment' in its name, environmental determinants are one of many variables in a general resource, so neither verdict is yes.

label: Africa America Diabetes Mellitus Study
quote: Half of AF participants had T2D due to the T2D case-control study design of AADM, which was also reflected in the mean BMI being higher than expected for the general population of the countries sampled.
note: A genetic epidemiology study enrolling affected sib-pairs with type 2 diabetes and unaffected controls in Ghana, Nigeria and Kenya to map type 2 diabetes susceptibility genes; the affected sib-pairs make it a patient cohort, with no exposure basis.

label: Danish Blood Donor Study
quote: This study utilizes data from the Danish Blood Donor Study (DBDS)33,34, a large prospective cohort of blood donors.
note: A nationwide prospective cohort of healthy Danish blood donors with questionnaires, genotyping and registry linkage for research on donor health and public health in general; unselected healthy donors, so neither verdict is yes.

label: Howard University Family Study
quote: The subjects studied were all participants in the Howard University Family Study (HUFS), a population based family study of African Americans in the Washington metropolitan area.
note: A population-based family study of randomly ascertained African American families and unrelated individuals in Washington, DC, enrolled without selection on any phenotype to study common complex diseases (hypertension, obesity, type 2 diabetes) broadly; a general population sample with a broad purpose, so neither verdict is yes.

label: Stabilization of Atherosclerotic Plaque by Initiation of Darapladib Therapy Trial
quote: In a double-blind trial, we randomly assigned 15,828 patients with stable coronary heart disease to receive either once-daily darapladib (at a dose of 160 mg) or placebo.
note: An international randomized placebo-controlled trial of darapladib in 15,828 patients with stable coronary heart disease, whose baseline plasma biobank supports biomarker and genetic studies; a trial cohort of patients with one disease, and the only intervention is a drug.

label: Swedish BioFINDER Study
diseases: Alzheimer's disease | Parkinson's disease | dementia | parkinsonian disorders
quote: We initiated the Swedish BioFINDER (Biomarkers For Identifying Neurodegenerative Disorders Early and Reliably; NCT01208675) study in 2009 to learn more about the underlying etiologies of Alzgeimer’s and Parkinson’s diseases and related disorder.
note: A prospective clinic-based cohort recruited 2009-2014 at neurology and memory clinics in southern Sweden, of patients with mild cognitive impairment, dementias and parkinsonian disorders alongside cognitively unimpaired older adults, to develop early diagnosis of Alzheimer's and Parkinson's disease; a patient cohort for neurodegenerative disease, with no exposure basis.

label: CROATIA-Vis Study
quote: The CROATIA-Vis study includes 1,008 Croatians, aged 18–93 years, who were recruited from the villages of Vis and Komiza on the Dalmatian island of Vis during spring of 2003 and 2004.
note: A population-based cohort of adults from the isolated island of Vis, Croatia, richly phenotyped for genetic studies of complex traits in an isolate; environmental exposures are measured among many phenotypes, so neither verdict is yes.

label: National Alzheimer's Coordinating Center
quote: NACC is home to one of the largest, oldest, and most powerful Alzheimer’s disease datasets, built in collaboration with more than 42 Alzheimer’s Disease Research Centers (ADRCs) throughout the US over the past 25+ years.
note: The NIA-funded data resource pooling the standardized clinical, neuropathology and genetic data of participants of the US Alzheimer's Disease Research Centers, which enrol people with dementia or mild cognitive impairment and controls for research on Alzheimer's disease and related dementias; an aggregation of disease-centre cohorts, with no exposure basis.

label: Singapore Prospective Study Program
quote: SP2 (Singapore Prospective Study Program): The SP2 is a population-based study of diabetes and cardiovascular disease in Singapore.
note: A population-based re-visit of adults randomly sampled for earlier Singapore surveys, stated to be a study of diabetes and cardiovascular disease; no exposure defines it or is its subject.

label: Colorado Center for Personalized Medicine Biobank
quote: We describe the biobank at the Colorado Center for Personalized Medicine (CCPM Biobank) that was jointly developed by the University of Colorado Anschutz Medical Campus and UCHealth to serve as a unique, dual-purpose research and clinical resource accelerating personalized medicine.
note: An EHR-linked biobank of unselected adult UCHealth patients across all disease domains; neither an exposure nor a single disease defines it.

label: Adult Changes in Thought Study
quote: The ACT study is an ongoing population-based prospective cohort study that began in 1994 [20,21,22] and aims to identify risk and preventive factors for dementia.
note: A population-based cohort of dementia-free health-plan members aged 65 and over whose stated aim is risk and preventive factors for dementia; exposures are not its design purpose.

label: Hypertension Genetic Epidemiology Network
quote: HyperGEN recruited African American and White hypertensive sibships with 2 or more hypertensive sibs, at least 1 of them having severe HT.
note: A family study recruited through sibships with two or more hypertensive members (plus their offspring and population controls) to find genes for hypertension; no environmental exposure is involved.

label: Prostate, Lung, Colorectal, and Ovarian Cancer Screening Trial
diseases: prostate cancer | lung cancer | colorectal cancer | ovarian cancer
quote: The objectives of the Prostate, Lung, Colorectal and Ovarian Cancer Screening Trial are to determine in screenees ages 55-74 at entry whether screening with flexible sigmoidoscopy (60-cm sigmoidoscope) can reduce mortality from colorectal cancer, whether screening with chest X-ray can reduce mortality from lung cancer, whether screening men with digital rectal examination (DRE) plus serum prostate-specific antigen (PSA) can reduce mortality from prostate cancer
note: A randomised screening trial of about 155,000 men and women aged 55-74 not selected for disease, whose whole purpose is mortality from four cancers, so a population study of disease rather than a patient cohort; screening is a medical procedure, not an exposure.

label: Korean Cancer Prevention Study-II Biobank
quote: The Korean Cancer Prevention Study-II (KCPS-II) biobank was established to investigate these chronic diseases, with a particular focus on metabolic risk factors.
note: A population-based biobank of adults attending routine health examinations, established to study chronic diseases (cancer and cardiovascular disease) and their metabolic risk factors; despite the name, the purpose is broad chronic disease, so not a disease cohort, and no exposure defines it.

label: Leipzig Research Center for Civilization Diseases-Heart Study
quote: LIFE-Heart is a cohort of patients with suspected or confirmed coronary artery disease or myocardial infarction [23].
note: A hospital-based biobank of patients undergoing coronary angiography for suspected or confirmed coronary artery disease or myocardial infarction; no environmental exposure is involved.

label: Bandim Health Project
quote: Bandim Health Project (BHP) monitors health and survival of women and children in a nationally representative rural Health and Demographic Surveillance System (HDSS) in Guinea-Bissau.
note: A health and demographic surveillance system following the general population of women and children for child mortality, health interventions and vaccine effects; vaccines are medical interventions, not environmental exposures, and no disease defines it.

label: Center for Applied Genomics Biobank
quote: The cohort from the Center for Applied Genomics is composed of approximately 85,000 juvenile subjects below 18 years of age and of a diverse set of ancestries.
note: A paediatric hospital biobank recruiting children at CHOP with broad consent and EHR linkage, used for many childhood diseases (ADHD, atopic dermatitis and others); no single disease or exposure defines it.

label: Danish Twin Registry
quote: Because twins have been identified independent of traits and on a population basis, the Danish Twin Registry is well suited for studies to understand the influence of genetic and environmental factors for a wide variety of diseases and traits.
note: A nationwide twin register ascertained independent of traits; twin registries are neither exposure nor disease cohorts.

label: Electronic Medical Records and Genomics Network
quote: The Electronic Medical Records and Genomics (eMERGE) Network, established in 2007, is a consortium of academic and integrated health systems conducting discovery and implementation research in translational genomics.
note: A consortium of EHR-linked biorepositories (BioVU, BioMe, MyCode, ACT and others) for genomic discovery and return of results across the phenome; its members are general biobanks, so no on both counts.

label: Sorbs Study
quote: All subjects are part of a sample from an extensively phenotyped isolated population from Eastern Germany, the Sorbs.
