note: A volunteer sample of the Sorbs population isolate, phenotyped for metabolic and anthropometric quantitative traits; a general population cohort with no defining exposure or disease.

label: Dose-Responses to Exercise Training
quote: The Dose-Responses to Exercise Training (DR's EXTRA) study is a 4-y RCT on the health effects of regular physical exercise and a healthy diet in a population-based random sample of Finnish men and women aged 55–74 y living in the city of Kuopio in 2002 (see Supplemental Figure 1).
note: A randomised trial in a population-based random sample whose whole subject is the health effects of exercise and diet, so lifestyle exposures are its main subject (as assigned interventions rather than observed exposures, hence medium); participants were not selected for any disease.

label: Genetics of Lipid-Lowering Drugs and Diet Network
quote: GOLDN participants were identified through 3-generation families previously screened in the NHLBI Family Heart Study Minnesota or Utah centers [33].
note: A family study of the genetics of lipid response to a single standardised high-fat meal challenge and three weeks of fenofibrate; the meal is a metabolic test and fenofibrate a medication, not environmental exposures, and families were not selected for disease. Borderline on exposure because of the gene-by-environment framing.

label: Study of Women's Health Across the Nation
quote: The Study of Women’s Health Across the Nation interviewed women in their 40s and 50s from seven U.S. cities approximately yearly to collect information on their physical, biological, psychological, and social health.
note: A community-based cohort of midlife women followed through the menopausal transition for health in ageing; menopause and ageing are not diseases and no exposure defines it.

label: Finnish Diabetic Nephropathy Study
quote: Finnish diabetic nephropathy study (FinnDiane) is an ongoing (1997->), nation-wide multicentre study focusing on diabetic complications and currently comprises of over 5000 adults with type 1 diabetes9,10.
note: A nationwide cohort of adults with type 1 diabetes followed for diabetic kidney disease and other complications; no environmental exposure is involved.

label: IMAGEN study
quote: The IMAGEN study is the first multicentre genetic-neuroimaging study aimed at identifying the genetic and neurobiological basis of individual variability in impulsivity, reinforcer sensitivity and emotional reactivity, and determining their predictive value for the development of frequent psychiatric disorders.
note: Healthy 14-year-olds recruited from schools and followed for behavioural traits and their predictive value for frequent psychiatric disorders; the stated aim makes it a borderline population study of mental disorders. Its own authors say it was not placed to study environmental exposures.

label: Munich Antidepressant Response Signature
quote: MARS is a naturalistic open-label longitudinal treatment study with inpatients suffering from a depressive episode.
note: Inpatients admitted with a major depressive episode (unipolar or bipolar) followed during antidepressant treatment; antidepressants are medication, not an exposure.

label: Minority Aging Research Study
quote: The Minority Aging Research Study (MARS) is a longitudinal, epidemiologic cohort study of decline in cognitive function and risk of Alzheimer's disease (AD) in older African Americans, with brain donation after death added as an optional component for those willing to consider organ donation.
note: A community-recruited cohort of older African Americans without dementia whose stated subject is cognitive decline and risk of Alzheimer's disease; no exposure defines it.

label: Older Australian Twins Study
quote: The Older Australian Twins Study (OATS) was recently initiated to investigate genetic and environmental factors and their associations and interactions in healthy brain ageing and ageing-related neurocognitive disorders.
note: A twin study of older Australians on healthy brain ageing as well as ageing-related neurocognitive disorders; a twin sample with a broad brain-ageing purpose, measuring occupational exposure only among many factors, so no on both counts.

label: LymeProspect
quote: The LymeProspect cohort consisted of 1138 patients with a new physician-confirmed LB (either EM or disseminated manifestation) who were included at the initiation of antibiotic therapy and followed for one year, between April 2015 and October 201818,19.
note: Patients with confirmed Lyme borreliosis followed after antibiotic treatment for persistent symptoms; defined by the infection as a disease, not by exposure to the agent.

label: 300-Tanzania-FG
quote: Briefly, the 300TZFG cohort consists of 323 healthy Tanzanian individuals aged between 18 and 65 years residing in the Kilimanjaro region in Northern Tanzania.
note: Healthy adult volunteers in northern Tanzania phenotyped for cytokine responses in a functional genomics project; environmental and dietary factors are analysed but do not define the cohort or its design.

label: UCLA ATLAS Community Health Initiative
quote: In this study, we investigate the role of genetic ancestry in a disease context within the UCLA ATLAS Community Health Initiative (or ATLAS for brevity), a biobank embedded within the UCLA Health medical system composed of de-identified, EHR-linked genomic data from a diverse patient population [17, 18].
note: An EHR-linked biobank of unselected UCLA Health patients used for phenome-wide studies; no exposure or single disease defines it.

label: Insulin Resistance Atherosclerosis Family Study
quote: Recruitment for IRASFS was population-based and not based on disease status, e.g. diabetes.
note: Hispanic and African American families recruited on family size, not health status, to study the genetics of insulin resistance and visceral adiposity as quantitative intermediate phenotypes of type 2 diabetes and atherosclerosis; traits rather than a disease, and no exposure defines it.

label: WHI Genomics and Randomized Trials Network
diseases: coronary heart disease | stroke | venous thromboembolism | diabetes
quote: WHI Genomics and Randomized Trials Network – GARNET, which included all coronary heart disease, stroke, venous thromboembolic events and selected diabetes cases that happened during the active intervention phase in the WHI HT clinical trials and aged matched controls
note: A nested case-control GWAS sub-study of the WHI hormone therapy trials built from the coronary heart disease, stroke, venous thromboembolism and diabetes cases plus matched controls; hormone therapy is a medication, not an environmental exposure.

label: ALS Utrecht
note: Case-control sample of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis patients and healthy controls from UMC Utrecht contributed to the ENIGMA Plasticity meta-analysis; the cached texts hold only acknowledgements (Netherlands ALS Foundation) and the supplementary table is not downloaded, so the verdict rests on the definition only. No exposure defines it.

label: Brain Imaging Genetics study
quote: The Brain Imaging Genetics (BIG) study was initiated in 2007 and comprises healthy volunteer subjects, including many university students, who participate in diverse imaging studies at the Donders Centre for Cognitive Neuroimaging (DCCN), Nijmegen, The Netherlands (Franke et al., 2010).
note: Pool of self-reported healthy volunteers, mostly students, scanned at the Donders Centre for imaging genetics: no exposure or disease selection.

label: BrainSCALE study
quote: The participants were recruited from The Netherlands Twin Register (NTR) and at baseline consisted of 112 families, with 9-year-old twins and an older sibling.
note: Longitudinal twin-family study of normative brain development and cognition drawn from the Netherlands Twin Register; a twin registry sub-study about development, not exposure or disease.

label: Norwegian Cognitive NeuroGenetics sample
quote: Prominent features of the NCNG are the adult life-span coverage of healthy participants with high-dimensional imaging, and cognitive data from a genetically homogenous sample.
note: Healthy Norwegian adults across the life span collected for imaging and cognitive genetics; healthy-volunteer sample with no exposure or disease selection.

label: NeuroIMAGE study
quote: It is a multi-site prospective cohort study designed to investigate the course of ADHD, its genetic and environmental determinants, its cognitive and neurobiological underpinnings, and its consequences in adolescence and adulthood.
note: Follow-up of the Dutch IMAGE ADHD families (probands with an ADHD diagnosis, their unaffected siblings) plus control families, designed to study the course of ADHD; environmental determinants are studied generically, so not an exposure cohort.

label: Inter99 Study
quote: The Inter99 cohort is a randomized, non-pharmacological intervention study for the prevention of ischaemic heart disease, conducted on 6,784 randomly ascertained participants aged 30 to 60 years at the Research Centre for Prevention and Health in Glostrup, Denmark [45] (ClinicalTrials.gov: NCT00289237).
note: Population-based randomised trial of lifestyle counselling (smoking cessation, physical activity, diet) to prevent ischaemic heart disease in random samples of Copenhagen adults; lifestyle is its main subject, though as an intervention rather than an ambient exposure, so the exposure verdict is the debatable one.

label: iPSYCH case-cohort study
diseases: schizophrenia | autism | attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder | affective disorder
quote: Cases were identified as persons with schizophrenia (N=3540), autism (N=16 146), attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (N=18 726) and affective disorder (N=26 380), of which 1928 had bipolar affective disorder.
note: Danish population-based case-cohort sample of persons diagnosed with severe mental disorders plus a random population sub-cohort, built to study their genetic and environmental architecture; environment is generic, so not an exposure cohort.

label: Long Life Family Study
quote: The NIA Long Life Family Study (LLFS) is a longitudinal, multicenter, multinational, population-based multigenerational family study of the genetic and nongenetic determinants of exceptional longevity and healthy aging.
note: Families selected for exceptional familial longevity and healthy ageing; longevity is a trait, not a disease, and no exposure defines the cohort.

label: Genetic Epidemiology of COPD
quote: The COPDGene study was ascertained based on smoking status and COPD case-control status.
note: Multicentre cohort of current and former heavy smokers with and without COPD, ascertained on smoking status and COPD case-control status to find genetic factors and CT subtypes of COPD.

label: Genetic and phenotypic determinants of blood pressure and other cardiovascular risk factors
quote: GAPP affords an excellent opportunity to assess genetic and phenotypic predictors of cardiovascular risk factors and their progression over time in young and healthy adults from the general population.
note: Population-based cohort of healthy young adults in Liechtenstein whose stated purpose is the determinants of elevated blood pressure and other cardiovascular risk factors; counted as a population study of the cardiovascular disease family, though participants are free of cardiovascular disease at entry. Not an exposure cohort.

label: Women's Genome Health Study
quote: The Women’s Genome Health Study (WGHS) is a population-based, prospective cohort of initially healthy, female North American health care professionals at least 45 years old at baseline, representing participants in the Women’s Health Study (WHS) who provided a blood sample at baseline and consented for blood-based analyses.
note: Genome-wide subset of the Women's Health Study: initially healthy female health professionals followed for many incident outcomes (myocardial infarction, stroke, cancer, diabetes, osteoporosis); the health-professional sampling is a convenience population, not an occupational exposure, and the parent trial's aspirin and vitamin E are treatments.

label: Cameron County Hispanic Cohort
quote: We established a cohort on the United States-Mexico border to determine the prevalence of obesity and diabetes in this Mexican American population and to see whether minor economic advantages had any effect on health.
note: Community-based cohort of Mexican Americans in Brownsville, Texas, set up to determine the prevalence and determinants of obesity and diabetes; socio-economic status alone is not an exposure in scope.

label: Alzheimer's Disease Genetics Consortium
quote: This was a meta-analysis of genetic association studies in case-control, family-based, population-based, and longitudinal AD-related cohorts from the US Alzheimer's Disease Genetics Consortium, the Alzheimer's Disease Sequencing Project, the UK Biobank, the Finnish health registry, and the US Million Veterans Program.
note: US consortium assembling case-control, family-based and longitudinal Alzheimer disease cohorts (ADNI, NACC, ROS/MAP, MIRAGE and others) for genetic studies of late-onset Alzheimer disease; the smoking-interaction paper uses smoking as a covariate, not as the consortium's purpose.

label: Consortium for the Analysis of the Diversity and Evolution of Latin America
quote: We estimated individual ancestry proportions in a sample of 7,342 subjects ascertained in five countries (Brazil, Chile, Colombia, México and Perú).
note: Admixed Latin American volunteers, mostly students and staff (soldiers in Chile), characterised for physical appearance and ancestry to study admixture and the genetics of physical traits; neither exposure nor disease selects them.

label: Mexico City Prospective Study
quote: MCPS is a prospective cohort of more than 150,000 adults, aged at least 35 years, who were recruited between 1998 and 2004 from the contiguous urban districts of Coyoacán and Iztapalapa in Mexico City23,55.
note: Large prospective general-population cohort of Mexico City adults followed for known and new risk factors for mortality; broad purpose, no exposure or disease selection.

label: Airwave Health Monitoring Study
quote: The Airwave Health Monitoring Study is the only large-scale cohort study of police employees worldwide.
note: Occupational cohort of police officers and staff across Great Britain, established to evaluate health risks of the TETRA digital radio (radiofrequency electromagnetic field exposure, counted under radiation) and broadened to the health of the police workforce; not selected for any disease.

label: Cohorte Lausannoise
quote: In order to assess the prevalence of cardiovascular risk factors (CVRFs) in the Caucasian population of Lausanne, Switzerland, we conducted a population-based study (Colaus Study).
note: Random population sample of Lausanne adults whose stated purpose is the epidemiology and genetic determinants of cardiovascular risk factors and the metabolic syndrome, followed for incident cardiovascular events; counted as a population study of the cardiovascular disease family. Not an exposure cohort.

label: Melbourne Collaborative Cohort Study
quote: The MCCS was initially carried out to study a wide range of research questions, primarily the link between lifestyle and the risk of cancer and other chronic diseases (Milne et al., 2017)
note: Prospective cohort of Melbourne adults recruited by Cancer Council Victoria primarily to study the link between lifestyle and the risk of cancer (and other chronic diseases); the cached text names only 'lifestyle', so the categories are the lifestyle exposures as a group, and cancer is the primary disease though the purpose extends to other chronic diseases.

label: TRacking Adolescents' Individual Lives Survey
quote: the overall objective of TRAILS is ‘to contribute to the understanding of the determinants of adolescents’ mental (ill-)health and social development during adolescence and young adulthood, as well as the mechanisms underlying the associations between determinants and outcomes’
note: Dutch population cohort of adolescents (plus a clinical cohort of child-psychiatric referrals) whose overall objective is the determinants of mental (ill-)health and social development, with psychiatric diagnostic interviews and psychiatric case-register linkage; counted as a population study of mental disorders. Not an exposure cohort.

label: ADDITION-PRO Study
quote: ADDITION-PRO is a population-based, longitudinal cohort study of individuals at high risk for diabetes.
note: Danish adults sampled from the high-risk strata of the ADDITION-Denmark stepwise diabetes screening programme (impaired glucose regulation, incident diabetes, lower-risk sub-sample) and followed for cardiovascular disease; selected for diabetes risk, not for an exposure.

label: Finnish Cardiovascular Study
quote: The purpose of the Finnish Cardiovascular Study (FINCAVAS) is to construct a risk profile--using genetic, haemodynamic and electrocardiographic (ECG) markers--of individuals at high risk of cardiovascular diseases, events and deaths.
note: Clinical cohort of patients scheduled for an exercise stress test at Tampere University Hospital, built to profile individuals at high risk of cardiovascular disease, events and death; many already have cardiovascular illness, so 'patients' would also fit. Not an exposure cohort.

label: Health Professionals Follow-up Study
quote: The Health Professionals Follow-up Study is a prospective study of US male health professionals who enrolled in 1986 by completing a mailed questionnaire.
note: Prospective cohort of US male health professionals with diet and lifestyle questionnaires every two to four years and many outcomes (erectile dysfunction, hearing problems, prostate and colorectal cancer); no cached text states whether nutrition was its design purpose, so the exposure question cannot be settled here (missing: the study's own statement of its aims). Outcomes are broad, so not a disease cohort.

label: ARGO study
quote: The ARGO study is an ongoing collection of well-phenotyped OA patients undergoing total joint replacement and is based in Greece.
note: Greek collection of patients with severe hip or knee osteoarthritis undergoing total joint replacement, with healthy controls, for osteoarthritis genetics; no exposure defines it.

label: Ansan and Ansung Study
quote: In the three population-based cohorts, 10,030, 173,357, and 28,338 participants were independently recruited from the KoGES_Ansan and Ansung study, the KoGES_health examinee (HEXA) study and the KoGES_cardiovascular disease association study (CAVAS), respectively.
note: Community-based population cohort of adults from Ansan and Ansung, the first KoGES cohort, studying common chronic diseases and their genetic and environmental risk factors; broad purpose, no exposure or disease selection.

label: Nagahama Prospective Cohort for Comprehensive Human Bioscience
quote: This study cohort was recruited from the general population living in Nagahama city, a largely rural city of 125,000 inhabitants in Shiga prefecture, located in the center of Japan.
note: General-population prospective cohort of Nagahama City residents for genomic and clinical research; no exposure or disease selection.

label: Chronic Kidney Disease Genetics Consortium
quote: The CKDGen Consortium is an international collaborative effort dedicated to the investigation of the genetic underpinnings of kidney function and disease
note: A GWAS meta-analysis consortium of mostly population-based studies dedicated to the genetics of kidney function and chronic kidney disease; its primary phenotype is eGFR, a quantitative trait, so the disease verdict rests on the consortium's stated purpose and name rather than on patient recruitment. No exposure design.

label: Tohoku Medical Megabank Project
quote: We started two prospective cohort studies in Miyagi and Iwate Prefectures: a population-based adult cohort study, the TMM Community-Based Cohort Study (TMM CommCohort Study)
note: Population-based adult and birth/three-generation cohorts of residents of the Miyagi and Iwate prefectures damaged by the 2011 earthquake and tsunami, launched to monitor the chronic health effects of the disaster; otherwise a general biobank with no single-disease focus.

label: Fred Hutchinson Prostate Cancer Study
quote: This study included 383 men of European American ancestry from the Fred Hutchinson (FH) Cancer Research Center cohort who were diagnosed with clinically localized PCa and underwent RP as primary treatment.
note: Population-based case-control studies of prostate cancer in King County, Washington, with cases from the SEER registry and cancer-free controls; a disease cohort with no exposure design.

label: Whole Genome Association Analysis of Hematopoietic Cell Transplant (HCT) Outcomes
quote: Indications for HCT included hematological malignancy or myelodysplasia.
note: Recipients of a first allogeneic haematopoietic cell transplant for haematological malignancy or myelodysplasia at the Fred Hutchinson Cancer Research Center, with their donors, genotyped for graft-versus-host disease and relapse; the transplant is a treatment, not an environmental exposure.

label: Meta-Analyses of Glucose and Insulin-related traits Consortium
quote: MAGIC (Meta-Analysis of Glucose and Insulin-related traits Consortium) was established to focus on the genetic analysis of glycemic traits in individuals without diabetes.
note: A meta-analysis consortium of mostly population cohorts studying quantitative glycaemic traits (fasting glucose, fasting insulin, 2-hour glucose, HbA1c) in individuals without diabetes; traits rather than a disease define its scope, so it is not recorded as a diabetes cohort, and nothing in its design concerns exposures.

label: Molecular Genetics of Adverse Drug Reactions in Childhood Study
quote: The United Kingdom MAGIC study cohort was a retrospective cohort of platinum-treated pediatric cancer patients recruited between January 2012 and March 2018 at eight United Kingdom sites
note: A UK pharmacogenetic study of adverse drug reactions in children whose cisplatin cohort is paediatric cancer patients phenotyped for hearing loss; chemotherapy is a treatment, not an environmental exposure.

label: Raine Study
quote: The Raine Study is a well-characterised pregnancy cohort located in Western Australia.
note: A Western Australian pregnancy cohort following mothers and offspring from gestation into adulthood to study early-life influences on later health and behaviour; a general birth cohort with no exposure or disease focus.

label: Prospective Study of Pravastatin in the Elderly at Risk
diseases: vascular disease | coronary heart disease | stroke
quote: Briefly, PROSPER is designed to examine the benefits of pravastatin (40 mg per day) versus placebo in 70–82 year old men and women with either pre-existing vascular disease or elevated risk of such disease due to smoking, hypertension, or diabetes.
note: A statin trial in elderly people selected for pre-existing vascular disease or high risk of it, with coronary and stroke endpoints; part of the cohort are patients and the rest at risk, so the whole is recorded as at risk. Statin treatment is a medication, not an exposure.

label: Genetic Epidemiology Network of Salt Sensitivity
quote: Each family was ascertained through a proband with untreated prehypertension or stage-1 hypertension in rural China.
note: A family feeding study in rural China of blood pressure responses to controlled dietary sodium and potassium; diet is its main subject, though as an experimental intervention rather than an ambient exposure, hence medium confidence. Families were ascertained through probands with prehypertension or stage-1 hypertension, so probands and their relatives are at risk of hypertension.

label: Kaiser Permanente Research Bank
quote: The KP Research Bank (KPRB), a research resource within KP, is seeking to collect biospecimens and surveys from at least 400,000 adult members across the U.S. and linking that information to the EHR.
note: A health-system biobank of consenting adult Kaiser Permanente members linked to electronic health records, with general, pregnancy and cancer sub-cohorts; the resource as a whole is unselected by exposure or disease.

label: Minnesota Center for Twin and Family Research
quote: The Minnesota Center for Twin and Family Research (MCTFR) comprises multiple longitudinal, community-representative investigations of twin and adoptive families that focus on psychological adjustment, personality, cognitive ability and brain function, with a special emphasis on substance use and related psychopathology.
note: Community-representative twin and adoptive family studies whose special emphasis is substance use and related psychopathology (funded by NIAAA and NIDA, with one member study oversampled for risk of substance use disorders); substance use is a main subject, as in a smoking-behaviour consortium, and substance use disorders are a disease family, but the studies also cover personality, cognition and brain function broadly, hence medium confidence.

label: Relationship between Insulin Sensitivity and Cardiovascular disease
quote: The RISC (Relationship between Insulin Sensitivity and Cardiovascular disease) Study is using the infrastructure of an extended European collaborative research group to study insulin resistance and CVD risk in 1500 healthy people aged 30 to 60 years from 20 centres in 13 countries.
note: Healthy European adults without diabetes, hypertension or dyslipidaemia, clamp-phenotyped and followed for atherosclerosis, cardiovascular disease and type 2 diabetes; a healthy cohort, but one set up to study these specific diseases, so recorded as a population study of disease with medium confidence.

label: Rotterdam Study I
quote: The first cohort (RS-I) started in 1990 and included 7,983 inhabitants, aged ≥55 years from Ommoord, a suburb of Rotterdam in the Netherlands.
note: The first cohort of the population-based Rotterdam Study, inhabitants aged 55 and over of a Rotterdam suburb, studying chronic diseases broadly; no exposure or single-disease design.

label: Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development Study
quote: With one important departure, the ABCD cohort recruitment emulates a multi-stage probability sample of eligible children: A nationally distributed set of 21 primary stage study sites, a probability sampling of schools within the defined catchment areas for each site, and recruitment of eligible children in each sample school.
note: A school-recruited probability sample of US children aged 9-10 followed for brain and cognitive development, mental health and substance use; the Global Exposome Cohort Catalogue lists it for its geocoded linkage to air pollution and neighbourhood data, but exposures are one of many linked variables rather than the stated design purpose, and its outcomes are broad developmental ones.

label: Study to Understand the Genetics of the Acute Response to Metformin and Glipizide in Humans
quote: One thousand participants at risk for type 2 diabetes from diverse ancestries underwent sequential glipizide and metformin challenges.
note: A pharmacogenetic challenge study of adults enriched for risk of type 2 diabetes given glipizide and metformin; the drug challenges are medication, not an exposure.

label: Colon Cancer Family Registry
quote: Participants were probands and relatives from families recruited between 1997 and 2012 to the Colon Cancer Family Registry Cohort via both population-based recruitment and clinic-based recruitment in Australasia and North America.
note: An international registry of colorectal cancer cases (probands), their unaffected relatives and population controls; the probands are patients and the relatives at risk, so the registry is recorded under patients.

label: DIAbetes COhoRtE
quote: DIACORE is a prospective cohort study aiming to recruit 6000 patients of self-reported Caucasian ethnicity with prevalent DM2 for at least 10 years of follow-up.
note: A German prospective cohort of outpatients with prevalent type 2 diabetes followed for complications, chiefly renal events.

label: Osteoporotic Fractures in Men Study
quote: The Osteoporotic Fractures in Men Study (MrOS) is a prospective cohort study examining the risk factors for fractures, osteoporosis, and prostate cancer [94,95] in males age 65 or older from six U.S. communities.
note: A community-based cohort of US men aged 65 and over designed to study risk factors for osteoporosis, fractures and prostate cancer, with a sleep ancillary study.

label: Prevention of Renal and Vascular End-stage Disease study
quote: The baseline PREVEND participants were recruited from a total of 6000 individuals with a urinary albumin concentration ≥10 mg/L and a random control sample of individuals with a urinary albumin concentration <10 mg/L (n=2592).
note: A Groningen general-population cohort, enriched for people with elevated urinary albumin plus a random sample, set up to study renal and cardiovascular disease as its name states; the albuminuria enrichment gives it an at-risk element.

label: European Alzheimer & Dementia Biobank
quote: This consortium groups together 20,464 Alzheimer’s disease (AD) cases and 22,244 controls after quality controls from 16 European countries
note: A European consortium pooling clinically diagnosed Alzheimer's disease case-control datasets for genetic studies of Alzheimer's disease and related dementias.

label: INTERSTROKE Study
quote: The INTERSTROKE study is a case–control study of acute first stroke and was undertaken with 13,462 stroke cases and 13,488 controls recruited between January 11, 2007 and August 8, 2015 in 32 countries worldwide.
note: An international case-control study of first acute stroke; it quantifies modifiable risk factors including tobacco and alcohol, but the cohort is defined by disease and its risk-factor scope is broad rather than an exposure design.

label: Shanghai Women's Health Study
quote: The resources from the cohort will be valuable in future studies of environmental exposures and biomarkers for the risk of cancer and other chronic diseases.
note: A population-based cohort of Shanghai women set up, like other diet-and-cancer cohorts, to study environmental and lifestyle exposures (diet, soy, fish, tobacco, alcohol) and biomarkers in relation to cancer, with other chronic diseases secondary; exposure and cancer are both stated purposes.

label: Montreal Heart Institute Biobank phase2
quote: To increase our discovery power, we also measured CEC and other lipid phenotypes in an additional 863 CAD‐free participants and 2534 patients with CAD (MHI Biobank phase 2 in Table S1).
note: A nested case-control genotyping set of the Montreal Heart Institute Biobank: patients with coronary artery disease and CAD-free controls.

label: Montreal Heart Institute Biobank phase1
quote: we measured HDL‐mediated cholesterol efflux using 2 different cellular models to generate 4 different CEC phenotypes in 996 CAD‐free participants and 1000 patients with myocardial infarction from the MHI Biobank (MHI Biobank phase 1 in Table S1)
note: The whole-genome-sequenced nested case-control set of the Montreal Heart Institute Biobank: patients with myocardial infarction and controls free of coronary artery disease.

label: Darmkrebs: Chancen der Verhütung durch Screening
quote: The study population for this analysis included patients diagnosed with CRC and recruited in the DACHS study (Darmkrebs: Chancen der Verhütung durch Screening), an ongoing multi-center population-based case-control study with additional active follow-up of cases conducted in the Rhine-Neckar region in the South of Germany.
note: A German population-based case-control study of colorectal cancer with active follow-up of the cases; a disease cohort with no exposure design.

label: British Genetics of Hypertension study
quote: We phenotyped 2010 affected sibling pairs drawn from 1599 severely hypertensive families, and completed a 10 centimorgan genome-wide scan.
note: BRIGHT is a resource of affected sibling pairs and trios from severely hypertensive families, with normotensive controls, for the genetics of essential hypertension; participants were selected for the disease, not for any environmental exposure.

label: Genetic Investigation of ANthropometric Traits consortium
quote: The Genetic Investigation of ANthropometric Traits (GIANT) consortium is an international collaboration that seeks to identify genetic loci that modulate human body size and shape, including height and measures of obesity.
note: GIANT meta-analyses GWAS of anthropometric traits (height, BMI, waist measures) across population cohorts; its subject is body size and shape as quantitative traits, not a disease or an exposure, so it is no on both counts.

label: Hong Kong Degenerative Disc Disease Population Cohort
quote: This study examined the intercorrelations, risk factor associations, and single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) heritabilities of lumbar disc MRI features in a large-scale sample to classify the different intervertebral disc phenotypes associated with LDD.
note: A population-based cohort of Southern Chinese volunteers recruited regardless of back symptoms and given lumbar MRI and genotyping so that intervertebral disc degeneration can be studied, hence a population study of one disease; environmental factors are only covariates.

label: International Lung Cancer Consortium
quote: We have therefore conducted a pooled analysis of tobacco smoking and risk of BAC within the framework of the International Lung Cancer Consortium (ILCCO), which includes completed and ongoing studies of molecular and genetic epidemiology of lung cancer [15], with the aim of providing a precise measurement of the association between tobacco smoking and BAC.
note: ILCCO pools lung cancer case-control and cohort studies (its members are lung cancer studies), so it is a disease aggregation of patients; tobacco is a risk factor it analyses, not the basis on which its studies were assembled.

label: Alzheimer's Disease Sequencing Project
quote: The Alzheimer's Disease Sequencing Project (ADSP) is a national initiative to understand the genetic architecture of Alzheimer's disease and related dementias (ADRD) by integrating whole genome sequencing (WGS) with other genetic, phenotypic, and harmonized datasets from diverse populations.
note: ADSP sequences Alzheimer disease cases and controls drawn from many AD and population cohorts (its DSS page lists WES of 5,096 AD cases and 4,965 controls); an aggregation collected for one disease, with no exposure component.

label: Cebu Longitudinal Health and Nutrition Survey
quote: The CLHNS is a community-based study that recruited 3327 women from 33 randomly selected barangays (administrative units) from the 252 barangays that comprised Metro Cebu in 1982.
note: A community-based birth cohort of Cebu mothers and their 1983-84 infants followed on growth, schooling and health; the sources read describe recruitment and collection of environmental data but not the design purpose, so the exposure verdict (early nutrition as the cohort's subject) rests on the definition only; no disease focus.

label: HerediGene Population Study
quote: Participants in the HerediGene: Population study are voluntary US residents over the age of 18 years.
note: A population genomics study enrolling any adult Intermountain Healthcare patient for whole-genome sequencing linked to health records; unselected for disease or exposure.

label: Heart and Vascular Health Study
diseases: cardiovascular disease | venous thromboembolism | myocardial infarction | stroke | atrial fibrillation
quote: The HVH study is a population-based case-control study that includes individuals who experienced cardiovascular events, including a first VTE, and also included genetic analyses and performed a follow-up of the VTE cases for VTE recurrence.
note: A case-control study within Group Health of incident myocardial infarction, stroke, venous thromboembolism and atrial fibrillation with a shared control group; the cases are patients with cardiovascular events, and there is no exposure basis.

label: Intermountain Heart Collaborative Study
quote: IHCS enrolls patients admitted to Intermountain catheterization labs (Intermountain Medical Center: Salt Lake City, UT; LDS Hospital: Salt Lake City, UT; and McKay Dee Hospital, Ogden, UT) [24].
note: A registry and biorepository of patients undergoing coronary angiography at Intermountain hospitals, followed for cardiovascular outcomes and used as an angiographic CAD case series (later widened as the INSPIRE registry); a clinical patient cohort, not an exposure cohort.

label: Johnston County Osteoarthritis Project
quote: JoCo OA began in 1990 as a community-based prospective cohort of European-ancestry and African American men and women with and without osteoarthritis (OA).
note: A population-based cohort of Johnston County adults sampled regardless of osteoarthritis status and followed for the incidence and progression of knee, hip and other osteoarthritis; one disease is its stated purpose, with no exposure basis.

label: London Life Sciences Prospective Population Study
quote: The London Life Sciences Prospective Population Study (LOLIPOP) is a prospective cohort study of ~ 28000 Indian Asian and European men and women, recruited from the lists of 58 General Practitioners in West London, UK, between 2003 and 2008.
note: A population-based cohort recruited from general practice lists to study the cardiometabolic risk of South Asians; a broad cardiometabolic purpose in a general population, so neither a disease nor an exposure cohort.

label: Asian Skin Traits and Genetics Research
quote: In this study, we established the ASTAGR (Asian Skin Traits and Genetics Research) cohort, comprising 2762 female participants from 4 Asian countries (Korea, Vietnam, Thailand, and Indonesia).
note: A cohort of women from four Asian countries measured for 26 skin traits with genotyping and skin-related surveys; it studies normal trait variation, not a disease, and non-genetic factors are covariates rather than a design purpose.

label: Diet, Activity and Lifestyle Study
quote: We genotyped candidate polymorphisms and tagSNPs in PTGS1 (COX-1) and PTGS2 (COX-2) in a population-based case-control study (Diet, Activity and Lifestyle Study, DALS) of colon cancer (n=1470 cases/1837 controls) and rectal cancer (n=583/775), and independently among cases and controls from the Colon Cancer Family Registry (CCFR; colon n= 959/1535, rectal n= 505/839).
note: A population-based case-control study of colon and rectal cancer whose name and questionnaire centre on diet, physical activity and lifestyle as the risk factors under study; the cases make it a patient cohort and the design makes it a diet-and-cancer exposure study, though the sources read describe the data collected rather than stating the aim.

label: Invecchiare in Chianti
quote: 1,453 persons (age-range 20-102 years; 91.6% of the eligible) selected from city registry of Greve in Chianti and Bagno a Ripoli (Tuscany, Italy), using a multistage sampling method.
note: A population-based study of ageing sampled from municipal registries to study the loss of walking ability and other age-related decline; ageing and function are not diseases, and diet is measured only as a covariate.

label: Japan Multi-Institutional Collaborative Cohort Study
quote: Although the main purpose is to confirm and detect gene-environment interactions of lifestyle-related diseases, mainly of cancer, through the cohort analyses, it includes cross-sectional analyses on lifestyle factors, biomarkers, and genotypes, as well as confirmation/ screening of new biomarkers usable for early diagnosis of cancer. The endpoints are cancer diagnosis and death.
note: A Japanese population genome cohort whose stated purpose is gene-environment (lifestyle) interaction, with detailed alcohol, smoking, diet and exercise data, so lifestyle exposure is its design subject; its endpoints are cancer diagnosis and death, making it a population study of cancer, although the source frames this as lifestyle-related diseases mainly cancer.

label: Nijmegen Bladder Cancer Study
quote: In this study, we analysed data of the Nijmegen Bladder Cancer Study (NBCS), one of the largest case–control studies for UBC worldwide, as to gain better insights into the role of recurrent infections of the (lower) urinary tract as a risk factor for UBC.
note: A case-control study of urinary bladder cancer patients identified through the Netherlands Cancer Registry, with population controls from the Nijmegen Biomedical Study; a patient cohort with no exposure basis.

label: Norwegian Breast Cancer Study
quote: To identify potential target gene(s), we examined the associations of the three lead SNPs with expression levels of genes located within 1 Mb in three different studies: (1) 116 normal breast samples and 241 breast tumors from the Norwegian Breast Cancer Study (NBCS)
note: A Norwegian breast cancer case-control study within BCAC whose cases are incident breast cancers from three hospitals and whose tumour and normal breast tissue is used in expression studies; a patient cohort, no exposure basis.

label: QSkin Sun and Health Study
quote: The cohort was established to study the development of skin cancer and melanoma in the population with the highest reported incidence of these diseases in the world.
note: A random population sample of Queensland adults established to study skin cancer and melanoma, with a baseline built around sun exposure, sunburn and tanning-bed history; a population study of one disease family whose design centres on ultraviolet exposure.

label: RIKEN Study
quote: RIKEN Study The Japanese cohort of knee osteoarthritis GWAS (disease cohort) consists of 900 cases and 3,400 controls.
note: A Japanese knee osteoarthritis case-control collection of about 900 symptomatic cases diagnosed by orthopaedic surgeons and 3,400 controls, assembled for GWAS; a patient cohort with no exposure basis.

label: RIKEN cohort
quote: For the RIKEN cohort, a total of 219 mRCC patients treated with sunitinib were recruited from 15 Japanese medical institutes.
note: A pharmacogenetic series of metastatic renal cell carcinoma patients treated with sunitinib; a patient cohort, and treatment with a drug is not an environmental exposure.

label: Swedish Mammography Cohort
quote: The Swedish Mammography Cohort (SMC) [17] was established in 1987–1990 when 90,303 women born between 1914–48 and living in central Sweden (Uppsala or Västmanland counties) were invited to participate in a mammography screening program and to complete a food frequency questionnaire (FFQ) (74% response rate).
note: A population-based cohort of central Swedish women established around a food frequency questionnaire at mammography screening and followed through registers for diet, lifestyle and chronic disease; diet is its core design instrument, but its disease purpose is broad (chronic disease, notably cancer), so it is not a disease cohort.

label: Shanghai Men's Health Study
quote: The Shanghai Men's Health Study (SMHS) is a population-based cohort study of 61,480 men aged 40-74 years, launched in 2002 in urban Shanghai to investigate the contribution of lifestyle/environmental factors and genetic susceptibility to cancer and other non-communicable diseases (NCDs).
note: A population-based cohort of Shanghai men launched to investigate lifestyle/environmental factors (detailed diet, smoking, alcohol, occupation, physical activity) and genetic susceptibility, so exposure is its stated design purpose; its disease purpose (cancer and other non-communicable diseases) is broad, so not a disease cohort.

label: VITamins And Lifestyle Study
quote: In brief, the participants in the VITAL study cohort were recruited from men and women aged above 50 years and living in the 13-county area in Western Washington State covered by the Surveillance, Epidemiology, and End Results (SEER) program cancer registry.
note: A prospective cohort of western Washington adults recruited within a SEER cancer-registry area with a baseline questionnaire on diet, supplement use and lifestyle, to study supplements and lifestyle in relation to cancer risk; the sources read show the design (supplement and diet content, cancer-registry catchment) but the cancer aim itself is stated only in the definition.

label: Western Australian Sleep Health Study
quote: This study describes the development of such a cohort (The Western Australian Sleep Health Study) in OSA patients of Caucasian-European origin attending the only public sleep clinic in Western Australia (WA).
note: A clinic-based cohort of patients referred for sleep-disordered breathing to the sole public sleep clinic in Western Australia, phenotyped with polysomnography to study the genetics of obstructive sleep apnoea; a patient cohort with no exposure basis.

label: European Medical Information Framework for Alzheimer's Disease Multimodal Biomarker Discovery study
quote: Inclusion criteria were having normal cognition (NC) or a diagnosis of mild cognitive impairment (MCI) or AD-type dementia at baseline, age above 50 years, known amyloid-beta (Aβ) status, availability of cognitive test results and at least two of the following materials: plasma, DNA, magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) or cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).
note: An aggregation of 11 European memory-clinic cohorts combined for Alzheimer disease biomarker discovery, spanning normal cognition, MCI and AD-type dementia with known amyloid status; assembled for one disease, no exposure basis.

label: NHLBI Family Heart Study
quote: The NHLBI Family Heart Study is a multicenter, population-based study of genetic and nongenetic determinants of coronary heart disease (CHD), atherosclerosis, and cardiovascular risk factors. In phase I, 2,000 randomly selected participants and 2,000 with family histories of CHD were identified among 14,592 middle-aged participants in epidemiologic studies.
note: NHLBI family study of the determinants of coronary heart disease: half the families were randomly sampled and half selected for high familial CHD risk from existing population studies, so it is a population study of one disease family (with an at-risk half) rather than a patient series; environments are mentioned only as generic determinants, not as a design focus.

label: Hyperglycemia and Adverse Pregnancy Outcome Study
quote: The HAPO Study was an observational study designed to investigate the association between maternal glycemia during pregnancy, less severe than overt diabetes, and adverse pregnancy outcomes [34].
note: Multinational cohort of unselected pregnant women given a standard OGTT to relate maternal glycaemia below the diabetes threshold to pregnancy and newborn outcomes; participants were not selected for a disease and the stated subject is a glycaemia continuum and pregnancy outcomes rather than one disease (gestational diabetes was defined retrospectively in analyses), and no environmental exposure is studied.

label: Catheterization Genetics
diseases: ischemic heart disease | coronary artery disease
quote: Individuals were selected from the CATHGEN biorepository of patients referred for evaluation of ischemic heart disease recruited sequentially through the cardiac catheterization laboratories at Duke University (Durham, NC) [30].
note: Clinical biorepository of patients recruited sequentially at cardiac catheterisation while being evaluated for ischaemic heart disease, followed for cardiovascular events; a patient series (the source also calls them patients at risk of heart disease, since not all prove to have CAD). No exposure defines it.

label: Colorectal Cancer Genetics & Genomics
quote: CRCGEN combines data of two Spanish case-control studies.
note: Spanish colorectal cancer case-control collection (incident CRC cases with hospital and population controls), used for colorectal cancer genetics; the cases are the cohort, controls included. No exposure focus.

label: Italian Network of Genetic Isolates - Carlantino
quote: INGI-CAR - INGI-CARLANTINO INGI-CAR consisted of about 1000 subjects who were drawn from Carlantino, an isolated village of southern Italy.
note: Population-based genetic isolate cohort of an Apulian village, studied for complex traits in general (coffee consumption, sweet liking, ECG traits); neither an exposure nor a disease defines it.

label: EPIC-InterAct Study
quote: A total of 12,403 verified incident cases of type 2 diabetes occurred during 3.99 million person-years of follow-up of 340,234 EPIC participants eligible for InterAct. We defined a centre-stratified subcohort of 16,154 individuals for comparative analyses.
note: Case-cohort study nested in EPIC: all verified incident type 2 diabetes cases plus a random subcohort, assembled to study how diet and physical activity interact with genes in diabetes risk; the cases make it a disease cohort and the stated gene-lifestyle purpose makes it an exposure study.

label: Leipzig Adults
note: Definition only: a Leipzig sample of about 900 adults with a mean BMI of 35 to 38 collected through the IFB AdiposityDiseases and the German Obesity Biomaterial Bank for obesity-trait consortia, i.e. an obesity patient sample; the cached papers give only funding acknowledgments (SFB-1052 Obesity mechanisms), no recruitment description. No exposure.

label: Swiss Study on Air Pollution and Lung Diseases in Adults
diseases: bronchial asthma | chronic bronchitis | allergic conditions
quote: The aim of the SAPALDIA cross-sectional study carried out in 1991 was to determine the prevalence of bronchial asthma, chronic bronchitis and allergic conditions in the adult population of Switzerland and to identify and to determine the respective importance of potentially influencing factors.
note: Population-based Swiss cohort designed to measure the health effects of long-term air pollution, with monitored NO2, SO2, O3 and particulates and GIS exposure estimates: an air-pollution cohort; its stated aim is the prevalence and determinants of asthma, chronic bronchitis and allergic conditions in adults, one disease family, so also a population study of lung disease.

label: Bunkyo Health Study
quote: Bunkyo Health Study is a prospective cohort study of over 10 years21, which recruited older subjects aged 65–84 years living in Bunkyo-Ku, an urban area in Tokyo, Japan.
note: Probability sample of community-dwelling older residents of a Tokyo ward followed for muscle function, metabolic health and need for long-term care: a general ageing cohort, not selected for or aimed at one disease and without an exposure focus.

label: Shimane CoHRE Study
quote: The Shimane CoHRE study conducted by Shimane University in Japan worked in collaboration with Okinoshima town in the Shimane prefecture to identify potential factors of healthy aging among rural residents.
note: Community health-examination cohort of rural older adults in Shimane Prefecture run for healthy ageing and chronic disease in general; no exposure or single disease defines it.

label: Fangchenggang Area Male Health and Examination Survey
quote: Briefly, the FAMHES was a population-based study conducted among non-institutionalized Chinese men aging from 17 to 88 years old in Guangxi, China.
note: Population-based survey of men attending routine physical examinations in Fangchenggang, designed for environmental and genetic factors in age-related chronic diseases in general; environment is a generic aim (serum metal levels were later used as GWAS phenotypes) rather than a defining exposure, and the disease aim is broad.

label: Italian Network of Genetic Isolates - Friuli Venezia Giulia
quote: INGI-FVG - INGI-Friuli Venezia Giulia The INGI-FVG cohort consisted of about 1700 subjects drawn from the project “Genetic Park of Friuli Venezia Giulia”.
note: Population-based genetic isolate cohort of six villages in Friuli Venezia Giulia, studied for complex traits in general; neither an exposure nor a disease defines it.

label: Osteoarthritis Initiative
quote: The Osteoarthritis Initiative (OAI) is a prospective longitudinal study designed to identify risk factors for the incidence and progression of symptomatic tibiofemoral knee osteoarthritis.
note: Multicentre observational study of knee osteoarthritis enrolling an incidence subcohort selected for increased risk (the majority), a progression subcohort with symptomatic knee OA and a small reference group, so an at-risk cohort that also holds patients; no exposure defines it.

label: SWOG Cancer Research Network
quote: SELECT was coordinated by SWOG, a national consortium of institutions and investigators that conducts multidisciplinary clinical trials to improve the practice of medicine in preventing, detecting, and treating cancer, and to enhance the quality of life for cancer survivors.
note: NCI cancer clinical trials network (aggregation) whose trial cohorts are cancer treatment trials of cancer patients (e.g. CALGB/SWOG 80405 in metastatic colorectal cancer) and cancer prevention trials of men at risk (SELECT, PCPT); classified by what it collects as a cancer patient aggregation. No exposure focus.

label: Leeds Colorectal Cancer Study
quote: A study of 500 incident colorectal cancer cases and population controls, matched for age, sex and general practitioner, was conducted in the UK to investigate this hypothesis.
note: Population-based colorectal cancer case-control study (Leeds, Dundee, York) whose founding paper says it was conducted to test the meat- and smoking-derived heterocyclic amine / NAT2 hypothesis, with detailed diet (an EPIC-modelled food frequency questionnaire) and smoking interviews and Food Standards Agency funding: cases make it a disease cohort and diet and tobacco are its stated design subject; medium because later uses treat it as a general CRC case-control set.

label: North Carolina Colon Cancer Study
quote: The North Carolina Colon Cancer Studies I and II (NCCCS I and NCCCS II) were population-based case-control studies conducted in 33 counties of North Carolina.
note: Population-based case-control studies of colon (phase I) and distal colorectal (phase II) cancer in North Carolina with oversampled African Americans; the cases make it a disease cohort. Diet and medication were collected as risk factors among others, with no stated exposure design purpose.

label: Alpha-Tocopherol, Beta-Carotene Cancer Prevention Study
quote: Briefly, ATBC was a randomized placebo‐controlled trial (NCT00342992 clinicaltrials.gov) examining α‐tocopherol and/or β‐carotene for primary prevention of lung and other cancers in 29,133 male Finnish smokers, aged 50–69 years at recruitment between 1985 and 1988.
note: Finnish prevention trial that enrolled 29,133 male smokers, later followed as a cohort: recruited as smokers, so an exposure-defined cohort, and selected for their smoking-related risk of lung and other cancers, so at risk. The supplements are an intervention, not an exposure.

label: Growth and Obesity Chilean Cohort Study
note: Definition and name only: a longitudinal cohort of Santiago children recruited at age 3.5 from childcare centres and followed into adolescence to study growth, puberty and obesity; the cached paper describes only the recruitment, not the purpose, so the obesity aim rests on the cohort's name and definition. No exposure focus.

label: Health Examinees Study
quote: HEXA cohort was initiated in 2004 to identify environmental and genetic risk factors for major chronic diseases in Koreans, targeting men and women over 40 years of age who visited medical examination centers in urban areas.
note: Large population-based KoGES cohort of health examinees recruited for environmental and genetic risk factors of major chronic diseases in general: a broad-purpose population cohort, with environment only as a generic aim.

label: Newfoundland Colorectal Cancer Registry
quote: In order to investigate the factors, especially genetic components, responsible for CRC we established the Newfoundland Colorectal Cancer Registry.
note: Population-based registry of colorectal cancer patients diagnosed under 75 in Newfoundland and Labrador, followed for survival, with population controls added for case-control analyses; a patient registry. Smoking was analysed as a risk factor but does not define the cohort.

label: Toshiba cohort
quote: This study was conducted at Toshiba Corp, an electronics manufacturer in Japan.
note: Corporate genome cohort of consenting Toshiba employees with health check-up and questionnaire data, used for vaccine side-effect GWAS and a salt-reduction trial; the workplace is a recruitment setting, not an occupational hazard, and no disease selects the participants.

label: Women's Health Initiative Memory Study
quote: WHIMS, an ancillary study of the WHI Hormone Trials, was designed to investigate the effects of hormone therapy (conjugated equine estrogens (CEE) alone vs. placebo or CEE plus medroxyprogesterone [E + P] acetate vs. placebo) on cognitive outcomes among 7479 women aged 65–80 years recruited from 39 clinical sites across the United States who were cognitively unimpaired at randomization (1996–1999)
note: Ancillary trial of the WHI hormone trials in cognitively unimpaired older women, designed to test hormone therapy against incident mild cognitive impairment and probable dementia, so a population study of dementia; medium because the COHO term is the WHIMS+ genotyping set, which adds other hormone-trial women to represent the whole trial population. Hormone therapy is a medication, not an environmental exposure.

label: WHI SNP Health Association Resource
quote: the WHI SNP Health Association Resource (WHI SHARe), a randomly selected sample of 8,515 African American and 3,642 Hispanic women from WHI.
note: Randomly selected African American and Hispanic women from the Women's Health Initiative genotyped under the NHLBI SHARe project: a general population sample, defined by neither exposure nor disease.

label: Isle of Wight Whole Population Birth Cohort
quote: Parental consent was obtained from 1456 of the 1536 children for inclusion into a longitudinal study of asthma and allergic disease (Figure 1).
note: Whole-population birth cohort of the Isle of Wight established to measure the prevalence, natural history and risk factors of asthma and allergic diseases from infancy to adulthood: an unselected birth cohort with one disease family as its purpose. Environmental risk factors (smoking, pets) are one of several aims, not the design centre.

label: Starr County Health Studies
quote: To assess the prevalence and morbidity of noninsulin-dependent diabetes mellitus among Mexican Americans, 14% of the Starr County, Texas, population (97% Mexican-American) was randomly sampled.
note: Programme of studies of type 2 diabetes among Mexican Americans in Starr County, Texas, built on a random population sample and later diabetes case-control collections and household surveys; a population study of one disease that also holds diabetes patients. No exposure focus.

label: International Multicentre ADHD Genetics project
quote: Behavioural data were collected from 1068 probands with the combined type of attention deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD-CT) and 1446 'unselected' siblings.
note: European multi-site family sample of children with DSM-IV combined-type ADHD, their siblings and parents, collected for molecular genetic studies of ADHD; a patient (proband-family) cohort, with no exposure basis.

label: Family Blood Pressure Program
quote: A major part of participants in three networks GENOA, HyperGEN and SAPPHIRe were recruited mainly through hypertensive probands.
note: NHLBI programme pooling four family networks recruited mainly through hypertensive probands to study the genetic determinants of blood pressure and hypertension; the families contain both hypertensive probands and their relatives, so the disease role is patients (with at-risk relatives). No exposure basis.

label: Women's Health Study
quote: The Women’s Health Study (WHS) was a randomized, double-blind, clinical trial of low-dose aspirin and vitamin E in the primary prevention of CVD and cancer among 39,876 apparently healthy women age ≥45 years.
note: Primary-prevention trial of aspirin and vitamin E in apparently healthy female health professionals, followed as a cohort for CVD, cancer and other incident disease; healthy volunteers with a broad two-disease-family purpose, so not a disease cohort, and the only exposures are the trial medications.

label: Genetics and Epidemiology of Colorectal Cancer Consortium
quote: GECCO is now aiming to broaden its investigation of colorectal cancer risk by examining tumor characteristics in concert with host characteristics.
note: International consortium pooling colorectal cancer case-control, cohort and trial studies (cases and controls) to find genetic risk factors and gene-environment interactions for colorectal cancer; classified by what it collects. Gene-environment work does not make it an exposure cohort.

label: Prostate Cancer Association Group to Investigate Cancer-Associated Alterations in the Genome
quote: We evaluated the most significant single-nucleotide polymorphisms (SNP) in these loci using a worldwide consortium of 13 groups (PRACTICAL). Blood DNA from 7,370 prostate cancer cases and 5,742 male controls was analyzed by genotyping assays.
note: Consortium of prostate cancer case-control and cohort study groups pooling cases and controls to study inherited susceptibility to prostate cancer; no exposure basis.

label: Singapore Multi-Ethnic Cohort
quote: The Multi-Ethnic Cohort (MEC) Study is a population-based study in Singapore (n=14 530) with recruitment conducted between 2004 and 2010.
note: Population-based cohort of Singapore residents of three ethnic groups, free of major disease at recruitment, for chronic disease research broadly; neither an exposure nor a disease cohort.

label: ADDITION-Denmark
quote: The Danish arm of the ADDITION-Europe study7 was a trial of intensive treatment of people with screen-detected diabetes, which included training in motivational interviewing for GPs.
note: Danish arm of ADDITION-Europe: general-practice populations were screened and those with screen-detected type 2 diabetes were cluster-randomised to routine or intensive treatment and followed for CVD and death; a trial cohort of patients with the condition. No exposure basis.

label: Anglo-Danish-Dutch Study of Intensive Treatment in People with Screen Detected Diabetes in Primary Care
quote: We did the multicentre Anglo-Danish-Dutch Study of Intensive Treatment In People with Screen Detected Diabetes in Primary Care (ADDITION-Europe) to investigate this issue.
note: Cluster-randomised trial in Denmark, the Netherlands and the UK of intensive multifactorial treatment in 3,057 people with screen-detected type 2 diabetes; a trial cohort of patients. No exposure basis.

label: Montreal Heart Institute Biobank
quote: The MHIBB is a cardiology hospital cohort in which there is obvious enrichment of CV diseases.
note: Hospital-based biobank of patients of the Montreal Heart Institute, a cardiology hospital, so the participants are cardiology patients enriched for cardiovascular disease rather than all confirmed cases; the sources call them patients. No exposure basis.

label: Exeter Family Study of Childhood Health
quote: We recruited 1017 families from a postcode-defined area in central Exeter. Specific inclusion criteria were established to obtain a homogeneous, non-diabetic, UK Caucasian cohort.
note: Prospective family study of parents and children from a postcode-defined area of Exeter, deliberately non-diabetic and disease-free, set up to test the fetal insulin hypothesis and study birthweight and early growth; a birth cohort about growth, not disease or exposure.

label: Global Lipids Genetics Consortium
quote: Here we conduct a multi-ancestry, genome-wide genetic discovery meta-analysis of lipid levels in approximately 1.65 million individuals, including 350,000 of non-European ancestries.
note: Consortium meta-analysing GWAS of blood lipid levels across some 200 mostly population studies; blood lipids are a quantitative trait rather than a disease, and the member studies are not selected by exposure.

label: Molecular Epidemiology of Colorectal Cancer Study
quote: The Molecular Epidemiology of Colorectal Cancer Study (MECC) is a population-based study of incident CRC cases and healthy controls recruited from northern Israel from 1998 to 2017 [45].
note: Population-based case-control study of incident colorectal cancer in northern Israel; the cases of a case-control study make it a patient cohort. Environmental risk factors are studied but do not define the cohort.

label: Nurses' Health Study II
quote: Started in 1989, NHSII recruited 116,429 female registered nurses ages 25–42 from 14 states with large numbers of registered nurses.
note: Prospective cohort of female registered nurses recruited for chronic-disease epidemiology in women; nurses were chosen as reliable reporters, not for an occupational hazard, and the many exposure analyses (aircraft noise, diet) are among many variables rather than the design purpose. Broad chronic-disease remit, so not a disease cohort.

label: National Institute on Alcohol Abuse and Alcoholism cohort
quote: The sample consisted of 119 European American (EA) and 82 African American (AA) healthy controls that were recruited at the National Institute on Alcohol Abuse and Alcoholism (NIAAA) at the National Institutes of Health (NIH), USA.
note: Sample of healthy controls recruited at NIAAA who did not meet criteria for alcohol dependence or other major psychiatric disorders; healthy volunteers, so neither a disease nor an exposure cohort despite the institute's name.

label: Southern Community Cohort Study
quote: To accomplish this aim, we utilize data from the Southern Community Cohort Study (SCCS), a cohort with rich multilevel data designed to help address racial disparities in cancer outcomes.
note: Prospective cohort of predominantly Black, low-income adults in the southeastern US, NCI-funded and designed to address racial disparities in cancer, though it is also used for other chronic diseases; a general-population cohort whose stated purpose is one disease family. Low income by itself is not an exposure.

label: Taiwan Precision Medicine Initiative
quote: Here we present the Taiwan Precision Medicine Initiative (TPMI), established by Academia Sinica in collaboration with 16 major medical centres around Taiwan, which has recruited 565,390 participants who consent to provide DNA samples for genetic profiling and grant access to their electronic medical records (EMRs) for research.
note: Hospital-based precision-medicine cohort of 565,390 unselected Taiwanese participants with genotypes linked to electronic medical records for common-disease and pharmacogenetic research; a biobank with a broad remit, so neither a disease nor an exposure cohort.

label: Baependi Heart Study
quote: The Baependi Heart Study was set up in 2005 to develop a longitudinal family-based cohort study that reflects on some of the genetic and lifestyle-related peculiarities of the Brazilian populations, in order to evaluate genetic and environmental influences on CVD risk factor traits.
note: Family-based cohort of residents of a rural Brazilian town set up, Framingham-like, to study genetic and environmental influences on cardiovascular disease risk factors, later broadened to sleep and mental health; a population study of one disease family. 'Environmental influences' are mentioned only in passing.

label: Born in Guangzhou Cohort Study
quote: The Born in Guangzhou Cohort Study (BIGCS) is a large-scale prospective observational study investigating the role of social, biological and environmental influences on pregnancy and child health and development in an urban setting in southern China.
note: General birth cohort of pregnant women and their children in Guangzhou studying social, biological and environmental influences on pregnancy and child health and development; environment is one of three broad themes rather than the design purpose, and the cohort is about development, not disease.

label: Genetics, Osteoarthritis and Progression Study
quote: The GARP study is a prospective observational study in patients with familial generalized osteoarthritis, hand osteoarthritis and other osteoarthritis phenotypes.
note: Dutch sibling-pair cohort of patients with symptomatic osteoarthritis at multiple joint sites recruited from clinics around Leiden to study osteoarthritis susceptibility and progression; a patient cohort. No exposure basis.

label: Physicians' Health Study
quote: PHS I was initiated in 1982 and was a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of 22,071 US male physicians aged 40–84 years aimed at evaluating the impact of aspirin and beta-carotene on cardiovascular disease (CVD) and cancer outcomes, respectively [22].
note: Primary-prevention trials of aspirin, beta-carotene and vitamins in healthy US male physicians, followed as a cohort for CVD and cancer; healthy volunteers with a two-disease-family prevention purpose, so not a disease cohort, and the only exposures are the trial supplements.

label: Trinity Student Study
quote: Samples were collected as part of the Trinity Student Study (TSS), in which a cohort of healthy young adults (aged 18–28 y) were recruited at Trinity College Dublin over a 1-y period (2003–2004), as described previously (36–38).
note: Cohort of about 2,000 healthy young adult students recruited at Trinity College Dublin for genetic studies of circulating metabolites; healthy volunteers, no disease or exposure basis.

label: Yale-Penn study
diseases: cocaine dependence | opioid dependence | alcohol dependence
quote: The discovery sample was derived from the Yale-Penn sample, a cohort of 11,439 participants (5758 AAs and 5681 EAs) recruited through treatment centers and advertisements for genetic studies of cocaine, opioid or alcohol dependence11.
note: Sample recruited through treatment centres and advertisements for genetic studies of cocaine, opioid and alcohol dependence; addiction counts as a disease and the selection is by DSM-IV dependence diagnosis, not by substance exposure, so it is a patient cohort rather than an exposure cohort.

label: Cardiovascular Disease Association Study
quote: The CAVAS cohort had participants from rural areas to investigate cardiovascular diseases.
note: Population-based rural cohort of the Korean Genome and Epidemiology Study whose name and stated purpose are cardiovascular disease, though KoGES uses it for chronic disease generally; a general-population cohort set up for one disease family. No exposure basis.

label: China Health and Nutrition Survey
quote: The CHNS cohort includes new household formation and replacement communities and households; all household members are studied.
note: Longitudinal household survey across Chinese provinces, the first to collect individual dietary intake in China, built around diet, physical activity and other health behaviours as social and economic conditions change; diet and activity are its main subject, so it is an exposure (lifestyle) cohort, but it has no disease focus.

label: 300-Obese
quote: The 300-Obese (300-OB) cohort, one of the studies of the Human Functional Genomics Project, comprises a group of more than 300 individuals of Western-European ancestry with a body mass index (BMI) greater than or equal to greater than or equal to 27 kg/m2, aged between 55 and 80 years (12).
note: Cohort of about 300 overweight or obese adults (BMI 27 or more) enrolled in Nijmegen to study inflammation and cardiovascular disease pathways in obesity; obesity counts as a disease and participants were selected for it. No exposure basis.

label: Anti-Amyloid Treatment in Asymptomatic Alzheimer's Disease Study
quote: The A4 Study was a secondary prevention trial in preclinical Alzheimer’s disease, aiming to slow cognitive decline associated with brain amyloid accumulation in clinically normal older individuals.
note: A secondary-prevention trial that screened cognitively normal older adults with amyloid PET and enrolled those with elevated brain amyloid (preclinical Alzheimer's disease), so the participants were selected for their risk of Alzheimer's disease; no environmental exposure is involved.

label: Child and Adolescent Twin Study in Sweden
quote: The CATSS study has the potential of answering important questions on the etiology of childhood mental health problems and their role in the development of later adjustment problems.
note: A population twin cohort of all Swedish twins born since 1992 whose design centres on childhood mental health: screening for autism, ADHD, tic, conduct, obsessive-compulsive and eating disorders with clinical follow-up of screen-positive pairs, so it is a population study of one disease family (mental disorders) rather than a plain twin registry; the 'social environment' it records is not an environmental exposure in scope.

label: CLUE II
quote: We, therefore, analyzed prospective data from CLUE II (Give Us a Clue to Cancer and Heart Disease), a community-based, cohort study in Washington County, Maryland, to test the hypothesis that preexisting, treated diabetes would predict 1) cancer incidence and cancer mortality in people at risk for cancer and 2) cancer case fatality and all-cause mortality in adults who subsequently develop cancer.
note: A community-based volunteer cohort of Washington County residents set up as a campaign against cancer and heart disease, two disease families rather than one, so it is treated as a general population cohort with a broad chronic-disease purpose; exposures such as diet are measured among many variables, not as the design purpose.

label: Genetic Regulation of Arterial Pressure in Humans in the Community Study
quote: The discovery cohort - Genetic Regulation of Arterial Pressure of Humans in the Community (GRAPHIC) Study consists of 2037 subjects from 520 white British pedigrees recruited from the general population in Leicestershire (UK)
note: Nuclear families recruited from the general population through general practices to study the genetic regulation of blood pressure, a quantitative trait rather than a disease; no exposure enters the design.

label: Monongahela-Youghiogheny Healthy Aging Team
note: A population-based random sample of adults aged 65 and over followed with cognitive assessments and CDR-based MCI/dementia staging; the available text (PMID:40042063) states no purpose beyond longitudinal cognitive assessment, so whether MYHAT is a population study of dementia/MCI or a cohort of cognitive ageing generally cannot be settled from the cached sources; the definition's 'dementia' is not supported by a quotable statement. Not an exposure cohort.

label: Utah residents (CEPH) with Northern and Western European ancestry
quote: These included all HapMap Phase I and II samples, along with further samples from the same four populations: individuals from the Centre d’Etude du Polymorphisme Humain collected in Utah, USA, with ancestry from northern and western Europe (CEU); Han Chinese in Beijing, China (CHB); Japanese in Tokyo, Japan (JPT); and Yoruba in Ibadan, Nigeria (YRI).
note: A HapMap/1000 Genomes reference population sample of unselected Utah residents of northern and western European ancestry, held as DNA and cell lines for studies of genetic variation; neither disease nor exposure defines it.

label: Yoruba in Ibadan, Nigeria
quote: These included all HapMap Phase I and II samples, along with further samples from the same four populations: individuals from the Centre d’Etude du Polymorphisme Humain collected in Utah, USA, with ancestry from northern and western Europe (CEU); Han Chinese in Beijing, China (CHB); Japanese in Tokyo, Japan (JPT); and Yoruba in Ibadan, Nigeria (YRI).
note: A HapMap/1000 Genomes reference population sample of unselected Yoruba people in Ibadan, Nigeria, held as DNA and cell lines for studies of genetic variation; neither disease nor exposure defines it.

label: Copenhagen Prospective Study on Asthma in Childhood
diseases: asthma | atopic dermatitis | allergic rhinitis | allergy
quote: The Copenhagen Prospective Study on Asthma in Childhood is a single-center, birth cohort study of children of asthmatic mothers.
note: A clinical birth cohort of 411 children of asthmatic mothers, i.e. children at high risk of asthma and other atopic diseases, whose stated objective is the interplay of genetic, environmental and lifestyle factors with scheduled exposure assessments (air quality, allergens, diet, microbiology), so it is designed to study exposures as well as being an at-risk disease cohort; the exposure verdict is a judgement on design emphasis rather than an exposure-defined recruitment.

label: DemGene network
quote: We conducted a genome-wide association study (GWAS) of AD cases and controls of European descent from the multi-center DemGene network across Norway and two independent European cohorts.
note: A Norwegian network of memory-clinic sites collecting Alzheimer's disease dementia cases (with controls) for genetic studies, so an aggregation of patient collections; no exposure component.

label: Diabetes Genetics Replication and Meta-analysis Consortium
quote: We conducted a multiethnic genome-wide association study of T2D among 53,102 cases and 193,679 control subjects from African, Hispanic, Asian, Native Hawaiian, and European population groups in the Population Architecture Genomics and Epidemiology (PAGE) and Diabetes Genetics Replication and Meta-analysis (DIAGRAM) Consortia.
note: A consortium of type 2 diabetes case-control genome-wide association studies, so it collects patient (case) collections with controls; no exposure component.

label: Determining the Influence of Susceptibility COnveying Variants Related to one-Year mortality after BMT
diseases: acute myeloid leukemia | myelodysplastic syndrome | acute lymphoblastic leukemia
quote: To inform our hypothesis we used two independent cohorts for our study, Determining the Influence of Susceptibility COnveying Variants Related to one-Year mortality after BMT (DISCOVeRY-BMT) composed of acute myeloid leukemia (AML), MDS and acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL) patients and their ≥8/8 HLA-matched unrelated donors.
note: Patients with AML, MDS or ALL who received an unrelated-donor transplant, together with their healthy donors, assembled for survival genetics; the transplant is a medical procedure, not an environmental exposure.

label: European Alzheimer's Disease Initiative
quote: To identify other risk loci, we conducted a large genome-wide association study of 2,032 individuals from France with Alzheimer's disease (cases) and 5,328 controls.
note: A French Alzheimer's disease case-control genome-wide association dataset (one of the IGAP founding datasets), so an aggregation of patient collections; no exposure component.

label: EPICURE Consortium
quote: For the specific category of genetic generalised epilepsy, we noted the association at 2p16.1 that was previously reported in the EPICURE cohort; this cohort provided about half of our sample for the meta-analysis of this subtype (table 1).
