label: Genotek COVID-19 study
quote: We conducted a genome-wide association study (GWAS) on 7,124 individuals (comprising 6,400 controls who had mild to moderate COVID-19 and 724 cases with severe COVID-19).
note: Genotek customers who reported COVID-19 in online questionnaires, contributed as mild-to-moderate COVID-19 controls to the severe-COVID GWAS and studied for long COVID; all had the infection, so a patient cohort for COVID-19. SARS-CoV-2 infection is here the disease, not an environmental exposure.

label: Genetics of Kidneys in Diabetes Study
quote: A large number of individuals with type 1 diabetes were screened to identify two subsets, one with clear-cut kidney disease and another with normal renal status despite long-term diabetes.
note: DNA collection of people with type 1 diabetes enrolled as diabetic nephropathy cases or long-duration normoalbuminuric controls, with parents as trios; all probands are diabetes patients. No exposure design.

label: Graz Stroke Study
quote: GRAZ Between 1994 and 2003, subjects with first-ever and recurrent ischemic strokes admitted to the stroke unit of the Department of Neurology, Medical University of Graz (Graz, Austria) were included.
note: Hospital-based series of ischaemic stroke patients admitted to the Graz stroke unit, a SiGN genetic research centre contributing cases. No exposure design.

label: Head and Neck 5000
quote: Head and Neck 5000 is an observational study that recruited people with head and neck cancer from across the United Kingdom.
note: Prospective clinical cohort of people newly diagnosed with head and neck cancer recruited before treatment across UK centres. Lifestyle questionnaires are covariates, not the design purpose.

label: International Agency for Research on Cancer Central Europe Study
quote: A multicenter case-control study comprising 811 upper aerodigestive tract cancer cases and 1,083 controls was conducted in: Bucharest (Romania), Lodz (Poland), Moscow (Russia), Banska Bystrika (Slovakia), and Olomouc and Prague (Czech Republic).
note: Hospital-based case-control study of upper aerodigestive tract cancer in six central European centres, so a patient cohort. Its stated rationale is genetic susceptibility in relation to alcohol and tobacco exposure in a high-incidence region, which makes alcohol and tobacco a design purpose rather than incidental covariates; medium confidence because the bundle holds only the abstract's framing.

label: Institute for Behavioral Genetics
quote: The Colorado Twin Registry (CTR) is a population-based registry housed at the Institute for Behavioral Genetics at the University of Colorado.
note: Aggregation of the Colorado Adoption Project and the population-based Colorado Twin Registry, general behavioural-development samples analysed for childhood psychiatric traits; neither a disease nor an exposure selection.

label: International Collaboration for the Genomics of HIV
quote: The International Collaboration for the Genomics of HIV was established as a platform to combine all available genome-wide SNP data sets obtained on HIV-1 infected individuals worldwide.
note: Consortium pooling HIV cohorts of people living with HIV-1 for host-genetic studies of acquisition, viral load and control; the members are patient cohorts. HIV infection is the disease here, not an environmental exposure.

label: International Endometriosis Genetics Consortium
quote: The IEGC is a collaborative effort that aggregates data from multiple international studies to investigate the genetic factors of endometriosis4.
note: Consortium of endometriosis GWAS (surgically confirmed, record- or self-reported cases with controls), so an aggregation of case-control studies of one disease. No exposure design.

label: INGI-Val Borbera
quote: As a part of a research program aimed at the identification of genes and variants associated to common disorders, we present here the analysis of a cohort of 1803 adult subjects from Val Borbera, selected based on their ancestry to represent the general population in the valley.
note: Population isolate cohort of adults selected by ancestry to represent the general population of the Val Borbera, for gene mapping of common disorders and quantitative traits; a general population sample with a broad purpose.

label: Ischemic Stroke Genetics Study
quote: The ISGS is a prospective case-control genetic association study of patients with first-ever ischemic stroke at 5 US tertiary stroke centers.
note: Multicentre case-control study of adults with first-ever ischaemic stroke and matched stroke-free controls at five US centres. Smoking is an exploratory covariate, not the design purpose.

label: Karolinska Mammography Project for Risk Prediction of Breast Cancer
quote: The KARMA study aims to study and determine the roles and interactions of mammographic density, genetic determinants and lifestyle in the risk of breast cancer to build a comprehensive risk prediction model including all known and established risk factors for breast cancer.
note: Prospective cohort of women attending mammography in Sweden, set up specifically to study breast cancer risk and build risk prediction models: a population study of one disease. Lifestyle is one of many risk factors, not an exposure design.

label: Kathleen Cuningham Foundation Consortium for Research into Familial Breast Cancer
quote: Based in Australia, the primary aim of kConFab is to facilitate high-quality research by amassing a large and comprehensive resource of epidemiological and clinical data with biospecimens from individuals at high risk of breast and/or ovarian cancer, and from their close relatives.
note: Resource of multiple-case breast/ovarian cancer families recruited through family cancer clinics, holding affected and unaffected members and BRCA1/2 carriers; a high-risk family cohort (also containing patients). No exposure design.

label: Krakow stroke genetics study
quote: KRAKOW All consecutive subjects with ischemic stroke (fulfilling WHO criteria12 (3)) who were admitted to the Stroke Unit at the Jagiellonian University (Krakow, Poland) and who provided informed consent were included in the study.
note: Single-centre hospital-based series of consecutive ischaemic stroke patients admitted to the Krakow stroke unit, with stroke-free controls; a SiGN genetic research centre. No exposure design.

label: Leuven Stroke Genetics Study
quote: Cases of European descent with cerebral ischemia, defined as a clinical stroke with imaging confirmation or a TIA with a new ischemic lesion on diffusion-weighted imaging, who were admitted to the Stroke Unit of the University Hospitals (Leuven, Belgium) were enrolled in the LSGS between 2005 and 2009.
note: Hospital-based study of patients with cerebral ischaemia admitted to the Leuven stroke unit, with controls from the same population; a SiGN genetic research centre. No exposure design.

label: Men of African Descent and Carcinoma of the Prostate
quote: We tested this infrastructure by collecting epidemiologic, medical record, and genomic data from a total of 311 patients with CaP and 218 matched controls recruited at the seven SSA centers.
note: Clinic-based case-control study of histologically confirmed prostate cancer in men of African descent at seven sub-Saharan African centres, with cancer-free controls. No exposure design.

label: Maywood Cohort
quote: Participants from the US were recruited into the Genetic Study of Hypertension in Blacks between 1995–1999 and the Fat Reduction Intervention Trial in African-Americans (FRITAA) between 1995–1998.
note: Random population sample of African-American families in Maywood, Illinois, enrolled by Loyola for its blood-pressure and hypertension genetics studies (the US site of the hypertension-in-Blacks programme), later used for anthropometric GWAS; a population sample whose stated purpose is hypertension. No exposure design.

label: Minnesota Breast Cancer Family Study
quote: The Minnesota Breast Cancer Family Study is a historical cohort study of relatives of a consecutive series of 426 breast cancer cases (probands) identified between 1944 and 1952.
note: Historical cohort of relatives of breast cancer probands followed for cancer incidence; the participants are selected as relatives of patients. No exposure design.

label: Middlesex County Ischemic Stroke Study
quote: Middlesex County Ischemic Stroke Study (MCISS) The MCISS was initiated as a prospective hospital based stroke registry at the New Jersey Neuroscience Institute (Edison, NJ, U.S.A.).
note: Prospective hospital-based registry of adults admitted with ischaemic stroke to the New Jersey Neuroscience Institute; a SiGN genetic research centre. No exposure design.

label: HARMONISATION study
diseases: vascular cognitive impairment | Alzheimer's disease | dementia
quote: The Harmonization study is an ongoing prospective study which recruited patients from memory clinics of the National University Hospital and St. Luke’s Hospital in Singapore, aiming to examine cognitive deterioration and associated biomarkers in older Asian individuals with cognitive impairment and dementia due to AD and/or cerebrovascular disease (CeVD).
note: Memory-clinic cohort of older Singaporeans with no cognitive impairment, MCI or dementia due to Alzheimer's disease and/or cerebrovascular disease, followed to study vascular cognitive impairment and AD; a patient cohort. No exposure design.

label: Genes Affecting Stroke Risk and Outcome Study
quote: MGH Genes Affecting Stroke Risk and Outcome Study (MGH-GASROS) Cases were all consecutive patients aged 18 years presenting with ischemic stroke and admitted to the Massachusetts General Hospital (MGH) Stroke Unit through the Emergency Department, or evaluated in the MGH Neurology outpatient clinics, as well as on the inpatient Medical and Vascular Surgical services from January 2003 to July 2008.
note: Hospital-based study of consecutive acute ischaemic stroke patients at Massachusetts General Hospital with matched stroke-free controls, for stroke risk and outcome genetics; a SiGN genetic research centre. No exposure design.

label: Melanoma Institute Australia cohort
quote: With written, informed consent, patients with histo-pathological confirmed CM cases managed at MIA, Sydney, Australia were identified from this Biospecimen Bank and Database.
note: Patients with histopathologically confirmed cutaneous melanoma from the Melanoma Institute Australia biospecimen bank, followed for melanoma-specific survival. Australia's high UV setting is context, not a selection by exposure.

label: Montrachet Study
quote: The Montrachet (Maculopathy Optic Nerve nuTRition neurovAsCular and HEarT diseases) Study is a population‐based study designed to find associations between age‐related eye diseases and neurologic and heart diseases in the elderly as a primary objective.
note: Population-based eye study of Dijon 3C participants aged 75 and over, whose primary objective is age-related eye diseases and their associations with neurologic and heart diseases; a general population sample set up around one disease family, hence medium confidence. Nutrition appears in the name but is not the recruitment basis or stated design.

label: MUNICH stroke study
quote: Cases were consecutive European Caucasians recruited from a single dedicated Stroke Unit at the Department of Neurology, Klinikum Großhadern, Ludwig-Maximilians-University, Munich.
note: Hospital-based collection of consecutive ischaemic stroke patients from the Munich stroke unit, genotyped in WTCCC2 and contributing to METASTROKE, SiGN and MEGASTROKE. No exposure design.

label: Murcia Twin Registry
quote: The Murcia Twin Registry (MTR) was created in 2006, under the auspices of the University of Murcia and the regional Health Authority, aiming to develop a research resource in Spain intended to stimulate current research and new investigation on the analysis of genetic factors related to health and health-related behaviors.
note: Population-based register of adult twins in Murcia for research on genetic and environmental influences on health and health-related behaviours; a twin registry with a broad purpose, neither disease- nor exposure-selected.

label: Norwegian, Exeter and King's College Consortium for Genetics of Neuropsychiatric Symptoms in Dementia
quote: All were diagnosed with possible, probable, 20 and when available, autopsy‐confirmed definite 21 AD (for participant characteristics see Table 1).
note: A consortium that pools Alzheimer's disease patients from Norwegian registries and nursing-home cohorts, AddNeuroMed and Italian and Greek clinics to study the genetics of psychosis and affective symptoms in dementia; every participant of the GWAS it fed was diagnosed with AD. No environmental exposure in its design.

label: NeuroGenetics Research Consortium
quote: We performed a genome-wide association study of 2,000 individuals with Parkinson's disease (cases) and 1,986 unaffected controls from the NeuroGenetics Research Consortium (NGRC).
note: A clinic-recruited case-control sample of Parkinson's disease patients and healthy controls in four US states; environmental risk factors are covariates, not the recruitment basis.

label: Genetics of Hypertension in Blacks
quote: Study participants were recruited from Yoruba-speaking communities in southwest Nigeria as part of a long-term study on the environmental and genetic factors underlying hypertension [10].
note: Community-recruited Yoruba adults with normal or elevated blood pressure from Igbo-Ora and Idikan, gathered for a long-term study of hypertension and analysed as hypertensives versus normotensives (consortium papers call it a case-control study of hypertension). Environmental factors are mentioned only in passing.

label: Nanjing Medical University Global Screening Array project
quote: To systematically identify genetic variants for NSCLC risk, we newly genotyped 19 546 samples from Chinese NSCLC cases and controls from the Nanjing Medical University Global Screening Array Project
note: A Chinese case-control sample of histologically confirmed non-small-cell lung cancer patients and cancer-free controls genotyped by Nanjing Medical University; smoking is a covariate, not the design.

label: Parkinson's Disease Cognitive Genetics Consortium
quote: We screened the GBA coding region for mutations and the E326K polymorphism in 1,369 PD patients enrolled at eight sites from the PD Cognitive Genetics Consortium.
note: A consortium of US Parkinson's disease research centres that pools PD patients with a shared cognitive battery to find genetic risk factors for cognitive impairment in PD.

label: Poland Ovarian Cancer Study
quote: the Polish Ovarian Cancer study, Poland (POC)] and one hospital-based study [Bavaria Case-Control Study (BAV)] included 4946 cases with primary histologically-confirmed invasive ovarian carcinoma and 6582 controls.
note: A Polish case-control study of ovarian cancer within the Ovarian Cancer Association Consortium.

label: Screening Across the Lifespan Twin survey, Younger cohort
quote: The target population was the younger part of the SALT cohort born between 1943 and 1958.
note: A questionnaire and saliva-collection wave of the Swedish Twin Registry's SALT cohort (twins born 1943-1958) run with epidemiologists, clinicians, political scientists and economists: a twin registry sample with a broad purpose, so neither a disease nor an exposure cohort, although the registry itself was founded to study smoking and alcohol.

label: Severe Asthma Research Program
quote: The Severe Asthma Network (Severe Asthma Research Program) was established by the National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute in 2001 to advance collectively the study of severe asthma to determine factors that differentiated these patients or subjects from those with milder asthma.
note: An NHLBI network recruiting adults and children with severe and non-severe asthma for deep phenotyping of severe asthma mechanisms.

label: Sickle Cell Clinical Research and Intervention Program
quote: Initiated in 2014, the SCCRIP study prospectively recruits patients diagnosed with SCD and includes retrospective and longitudinal collection of clinical, neurocognitive, geospatial, psychosocial, and health outcomes data.
note: A St. Jude lifespan cohort of patients with sickle cell disease; geospatial and social-determinant data are collected but exposure is not the design.

label: Asian Indian Diabetic Heart Study/Sikh Diabetes Study
quote: Asian Indian Diabetic Heart Study/Sikh Diabetes Study (AIDHS/SDS) is a case-control study designed to investigate the association between genetic and environmental factors and their risk on type 2 diabetes (T2D) and cardiovascular disease in a population of Punjabi ancestry from India.
note: A family-based then case-control study of type 2 diabetes and cardiovascular disease in Punjabi Sikhs of North India; 'environmental factors' are mentioned generically, not as an exposure design.

label: Sickle Cell Genome Project
quote: To investigate this in sickle cell disease (SCD), we performed whole-genome sequencing (WGS) of 722 individuals with hemoglobin HbSS or HbSβ0-thalassemia from Baylor College of Medicine and from the St. Jude Children's Research Hospital Sickle Cell Clinical Research and Intervention Program (SCCRIP) longitudinal cohort study.
note: A whole-genome-sequenced cohort of sickle cell disease patients from Baylor and the SCCRIP cohort.

label: St George's stroke cohort
quote: The Wellcome Trust Case Control Consortium 2 (WTCCC2) ischemic stroke study comprises ischemic stroke cases recruited from 3 centers in the United Kingdom (St George's London, Oxford, and Edinburgh) and 1 center in Munich, Germany.
note: A hospital-based collection of ischaemic stroke patients at St George's London, one of the WTCCC2 and SiGN stroke case collections.

label: Sisters in Breast Screening Study
quote: The Sisters in Breast Screening Study (SIBS) was designed to study the genetic basis of quantitative phenotypes related to breast cancer, in particular breast density and sex-hormone levels [Varghese et al., 2012; Kataoka et al., 2009].
note: Cancer-free women and their female relatives recruited through NHS breast screening, not selected for risk, but the study's stated purpose is the genetics of breast-cancer intermediate phenotypes (mammographic density, sex hormones), so it is a population study of one disease.

label: St. Jude Lifetime Cohort Study
quote: Eligibility criteria for inclusion in the St. Jude Lifetime Cohort (SJLIFE) study include: (1) diagnosis of childhood malignancy treated at SJCRH; (2) survival ≥ 10 years from diagnosis; and (3) current age ≥ 18 years.
note: Survivors of paediatric cancer treated at St. Jude, followed for late effects of the cancer and its treatment; chemotherapy and radiotherapy are medical treatments, so this is not an environmental exposure cohort.

label: Swedish Low-risk Colorectal Cancer Study
quote: The case cohort was composed of 1786 consecutive CRC patients of Swedish origin recruited through the Swedish Low-Risk CRC Study Group from 14 different hospitals from central Sweden during 2004–2006.
note: Consecutive colorectal cancer patients from 14 hospitals in central Sweden with spouse controls; a lifestyle questionnaire was collected but exposure is not the design.

label: Screening Markers for Colorectal Cancer Study
quote: We conducted a case-control study of the association between subsets of colorectal polyps, including adenomas and serrated polyps, and single-nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) related to colorectal cancer through prior genome-wide association studies (GWAS).
note: A case-control study of colorectal polyps (adenomas and serrated polyps) versus polyp-free controls among Group Health colonoscopy patients; adenoma is a pre-cancerous state, so the cases are at risk of colorectal cancer, and its advanced-adenoma cases feed colorectal cancer consortia.

label: Siblings With Ischemic Stroke Study
quote: The Siblings With Ischemic Stroke Study enrolled 312 probands with ischemic stroke from 70 US and Canadian centers.
note: Affected sibling pairs with ischaemic stroke (plus some stroke-free siblings) enrolled at US and Canadian centres for linkage and family-based association.

label: Saguenay Youth Study
quote: The Saguenay Youth Study (SYS) is a two-generational study of adolescents and their parents (n = 1029 adolescents and 962 parents) aimed at investigating the aetiology, early stages and trans-generational trajectories of common cardiometabolic and brain diseases.
note: Adolescent sibships from the Saguenay-Lac-Saint-Jean founder population, half selected as prenatally exposed to maternal smoking and matched with non-exposed adolescents, so an exposure-defined cohort; its disease aim ('common cardiometabolic and brain diseases') is broad, not one disease.

label: ThyroidOmics Consortium
quote: The ThyroidOmics Consortium was formed to study the determinants and effects of thyroid diseases and thyroid function, using various omics technologies in multiple large and well-phenotyped cohort studies.
note: A consortium of mostly population-based cohorts whose stated purpose is thyroid disease and thyroid function; much of its output concerns thyroid hormone levels (a trait), but it also meta-analyses hypo- and hyperthyroidism, so it counts as a population study of one disease family.

label: Treatment Options for Type 2 Diabetes in Adolescents and Youth
quote: We compared the efficacy of three treatment regimens to achieve durable glycemic control in children and adolescents with recent-onset type 2 diabetes.
note: A randomised trial (with observational follow-up) of children and adolescents with recent-onset type 2 diabetes; the lifestyle arm is a treatment, not an environmental exposure.

label: Tracking Parkinson's
quote: Patients attending specialist clinics in the United Kingdom with recent onset (<3.5 years) and young onset (diagnosed <50 years of age) PD were enrolled.
note: A UK multicentre longitudinal study of recent- and young-onset Parkinson's disease patients (with some unaffected siblings) to explain phenotypic variation.

label: Universitatsklinikum Saarlandes case-control dataset
quote: The UKS cohort is a thoroughly diagnosed case-control cohort from Universitatsklinikum Saarlandes, consisting of individuals clinically diagnosed with sporadic Alzheimer’s disease (N = 596; age-at-onset [mean ± SD]: 72.2 ± 6.6 years) and cognitively healthy, age-, gender-, and ethnicity-matched population-based controls (N = 170; age-at-exam: 64.1 ± 3.0 years).
note: A German case-control cohort of clinically diagnosed sporadic Alzheimer's disease patients and matched population controls.

label: Viborg Vascular
diseases: abdominal aortic aneurysm | peripheral arterial disease | hypertension
quote: The objective of this study is to assess the efficacy and the cost-effectiveness of a combined screening program for AAA, PAD and hypertension.
note: A randomised population screening trial of all men aged 65-74 in the Central Denmark Region, invited to screening for abdominal aortic aneurysm, peripheral arterial disease and hypertension: a general population sample whose stated purpose is one vascular disease family, so a population study of disease rather than a patient cohort.

label: West Bank Cancer Registry
quote: Palestinian Cancer Registry (PCR) is a population-based registry established in 1996 under the umbrella of the Ministry of Health and started its regular work in 1998.
note: The Palestinian Ministry of Health's cancer registry for the West Bank, continuing the West Bank part of the population-based Palestinian Cancer Registry; a disease registry of incident cancer cases.

label: Washington University St. Louis Stroke Study
quote: The WUSTL patient collection included ischemic stroke cases admitted to Barnes-Jewish Hospital/Washington University Medical Center (St. Louis, MO, U.S.A.) for genetic studies starting from August 1, 2008.
note: A hospital-based collection of ischaemic stroke patients admitted to Barnes-Jewish Hospital in St. Louis, one of the SiGN genetic research centres.

label: Sea Islands Genetics Network – Reasons for Geographic and Racial Differences in Stroke
quote: Stage 1 discovery samples included 17 T2D GWAS studies (ARIC, CARDIA, CFS, CHS, FamHS, GeneSTAR, GENOA, HANDLS, Health ABC, HUFS, JHS, MESA, MESA Family, SIGNET-REGARDS, WFSM, FIND, and WHI) with up to 23,827 African American subjects (8,284 cases and 15,543 controls).
note: The SIGNET-genotyped subset of REGARDS: African American participants with type 2 diabetes plus matched diabetes-free controls (and Low Country residents), contributed to the MEDIA consortium as one of 17 type 2 diabetes case-control GWAS. The parent REGARDS is a stroke cohort, but this subset was selected for diabetes; no environmental exposure defines it.

label: Wellcome Trust Case Control Consortium 2 Parkinson's disease study
quote: We performed a genome-wide association study (GWAS) in 1705 Parkinson's disease (PD) UK patients and 5175 UK controls, the largest sample size so far for a PD GWAS.
note: Case-control GWAS of UK patients with idiopathic Parkinson's disease against WTCCC2 controls; a disease patient series, no exposure.

label: CALGB 80303
quote: These encouraging data led Cancer and Leukemia Group B (CALGB) to conduct a double-blind, placebo-controlled, randomized phase III trial of gemcitabine/bevacizumab versus gemcitabine/placebo in advanced pancreatic cancer patients.
note: Phase III trial whose participants all have locally advanced or metastatic pancreatic cancer; the bevacizumab intervention is a medication, not an environmental exposure.

label: CALGB 90401
quote: A randomized, placebo-controlled study based on preclinical and clinical data that supports the potential role of vascular endothelial growth factor in prostate cancer was performed to evaluate the addition of bevacizumab to standard docetaxel and prednisone therapy in patients with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC).
note: Phase III trial of men with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer; treatment is not an exposure.

label: Colonomics
quote: Here we present Colonomics (https://www.colonomics.org/), a multi-omics dataset that comprises 100 stage II colon cancer patients from which samples of tumoral tissue (T) and paired normal adjacent tissue (N) were obtained from the surgical specimen.
note: Multi-omics series of stage II colon cancer patients (tumour and paired normal mucosa) with healthy-donor mucosa as reference; a patient series, no exposure.

label: CALGB 40503
quote: Women with hormone receptor-positive MBC were randomly assigned 1:1 in a multicenter, open-label, phase III trial of letrozole (2.5 mg orally per day) with or without bevacizumab (15 mg/kg intravenously once every 3 weeks) within strata defined by measurable disease and disease-free interval.
note: Trial of women with hormone receptor-positive advanced breast cancer; endocrine therapy and bevacizumab are treatments, not exposures.

label: 23Mofang cohort
quote: Participants were recruited from 23Mofang Inc.—a Chinese direct-to-consumer genetic testing company—through organic posts on their official app.
note: Research cohort of customers of a Chinese direct-to-consumer genetic testing company with self-reported traits; individual GWAS pick self-reported cases (myopia, photic sneeze reflex) from it, but the cohort itself is unselected for disease or exposure.

label: 3D Facial Norms cohort
quote: All individuals were recruited as part of the 3DFN project, which was limited to individuals of self-identified European ancestry who had no history of craniofacial trauma, congenital malformation, or surgery.
note: Normative craniofacial repository of healthy people screened to exclude craniofacial conditions; a control/normative cohort about facial morphology, not disease or exposure.

label: 4D-SZ cohort
quote: As the first time point for the vagino-cervical microbiome of the 4D-SZ cohort, 516 Chinese volunteers joined from May to July during an annual physical examination in 2017.
note: Multi-omics cohort of adult volunteers recruited at annual physical examinations in Shenzhen; diet and lifestyle are recorded among many variables for host-microbiome study, but exposure is not a stated design purpose and no disease selects the participants.

label: Age-Related Eye Disease Study
quote: The Age-Related Eye Disease Study (AREDS) was initially conceived as a long-term multicenter, prospective study of the clinical course of age-related macular degeneration (AMD) and age-related cataract.
note: Retinal-clinic cohort recruited with a spectrum of AMD and lens opacity (from none to advanced) to follow the clinical course of AMD and cataract, with embedded randomised trials of antioxidant vitamins and zinc for both; most participants have some disease, and the supplements are a treatment, not an environmental exposure.

label: Age-Related Eye Disease Study 2
quote: The Age-Related Eye Disease Study 2 (AREDS2), a multicenter, randomized, double-masked, placebo-controlled phase 3 study with a 2 × 2 factorial design, conducted in 2006-2012 and enrolling 4203 participants aged 50 to 85 years at risk for progression to advanced AMD with bilateral large drusen or large drusen in 1 eye and advanced AMD in the fellow eye.
note: Phase 3 trial of people with bilateral intermediate AMD or advanced AMD in one eye, at risk of progression to advanced AMD; nutritional supplements are the intervention, not an exposure.

label: African Research on Kidney Disease
quote: The optimal methods to estimate glomerular filtration rate (GFR) and therefore to determine the presence of CKD in SSA are uncertain. We plan to measure iohexol excretion to accurately determine GFR in Malawi, South Africa and Uganda.
note: Kidney-function study embedded in general population cohorts in Malawi, South Africa and Uganda, enrolling adults with and without CKD by baseline serum creatinine to measure GFR and determine CKD; its stated purpose is one disease, so a population study of kidney disease; no environmental exposure.

label: Berkeley Aging Cohort Study
quote: Seventy‐eight cognitively healthy OA were recruited through the Berkeley Aging Cohort Study (BACS), an ongoing longitudinal study of typical cognitive aging in community‐dwelling older adults.
note: Community volunteers with normal cognition followed for typical cognitive aging with amyloid and tau PET; preclinical Alzheimer's pathology is studied in them, but they are healthy volunteers not selected for disease or risk and the stated purpose is normal aging, so not a disease cohort; no exposure.

label: Diabetes UK Warren 1 Repository
quote: Between 1989 and 1996, 505 British families with at least two siblings affected by Type 1 diabetes were recruited.
note: DNA repository of British families with two or more siblings affected by type 1 diabetes (and their parents) for linkage and association studies; a disease family collection, no exposure.

label: Brain Development and Air Pollution Ultrafine Particles in School Children
quote: Among the children recruited through a set of representative schools of the city of Barcelona, (Spain) in the Brain Development and Air Pollution Ultrafine Particles in School Children (BREATHE) study, 186 typically developing participants aged 8-12 years underwent brain MRI on the same 1.5 T MR unit over a 1.5-year period (October 2012-April 2014).
note: Schoolchildren cohort built to measure the effect of traffic-related air pollution (EC, NO2, ultrafine particles) on cognitive and brain development, with schools chosen as high/low pollution pairs (so also selected by exposure); typically developing children, no disease.

label: National Cancer Institute Breast and Prostate Cancer Cohort Consortium
quote: The National Cancer Institute Breast and Prostate Cancer Cohort Consortium--a pooled analysis of multiple large cohort studies with a total of more than 5,000 cases of breast cancer and 8,000 cases of prostate cancer--was therefore initiated.
note: Consortium pooling nested case-control studies of breast and prostate cancer from large prospective cohorts; classified by what it collects (cancer cases and controls). Some member cohorts (EPIC, ATBC) are diet cohorts, but the consortium's purpose is genetic and gene-environment analysis of the two cancers, not exposure.

label: Biomarkers and Stratification To Optimise outcomes in Psoriasis
quote: BSTOP is an ongoing prospective observational study of patients with a primary diagnosis of moderate‒severe plaque psoriasis across > 70 UK dermatology centres, which includes biological sample collection.
note: Prospective observational study and biobank of patients with moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis starting systemic therapy; a patient cohort, no exposure.

label: Black Women's Health Study
quote: Black Women’s Health Study (BWHS) is a U.S. prospective cohort study of 59,000 United States Black women who enrolled in the study in 1995 and have been followed by biennial questionnaires since then.
note: General prospective cohort of Black women followed for many conditions (breast cancer, lupus, hypertension, diabetes, fibroids); a broad-purpose population cohort, so neither a disease nor an exposure cohort.

label: Coronary Artery Calcification in Type 1 Diabetes Study
quote: CACTI was designed to examine the prevalence of subclinical atherosclerosis in adults with type 1 diabetes and a comparable group of controls without any diabetes.
note: Adults with long-standing type 1 diabetes and non-diabetic controls followed for coronary artery calcification; participants selected for the disease, the outcome is subclinical coronary atherosclerosis; no exposure.

label: Collaborative Association Study of Psoriasis
quote: To identify psoriasis susceptibility loci, we genotyped 438,670 SNPs in 1,409 psoriasis cases and 1,436 controls of European ancestry.
note: Pooled case-control collection of dermatologist-diagnosed psoriasis cases and controls from three US groups, genotyped through GAIN; a disease case-control cohort, no exposure.

label: California and Uganda Prostate Cancer Study
quote: For men of African ancestry, GRS replication was conducted among 1,586 cases and 1,086 controls from California and Uganda (CA UG Study) genotyped with the Illumina H3 Africa array and imputed using Phase 3 of the 1000 Genomes Project15 as the reference panel and Minimac4 on the Michigan Imputation Server27 (Supplementary Table 1 and 2).
note: Case-control study of prostate cancer in men of African ancestry (SEER-identified cases in Los Angeles, incident cases at Mulago Hospital, Kampala) used as a prostate cancer GRS replication set; a disease case-control cohort, no exposure.

label: Cryptosporidiosis and Enteropathogens in Bangladesh Birth Cohort
quote: Cryptosporidiosis is a major cause of childhood diarrhea in low- and middle-income countries and has been linked to impairment of child growth. This study investigated the burden of cryptosporidiosis and its impact on child growth in both a rural and an urban site in Bangladesh.
note: Birth cohort in urban and rural Bangladesh followed with surveillance and monthly stools to study the incidence, immunity and genetic susceptibility of cryptosporidiosis (and other enteropathogens) and its effect on growth; a birth cohort whose stated purpose is one infectious disease. Children are not selected by exposure, so not an exposure cohort.

label: Childhood Cancer Survivor Study
quote: In 1994, the US National Cancer Institute funded the Childhood Cancer Survivor Study, a multi-institutional research initiative designed to establish a large and extensively characterized cohort of more than 14,000 5-year survivors of childhood and adolescent cancer diagnosed between 1970 and 1986.
note: Retrospective cohort of five-year survivors of childhood cancer (with sibling comparisons) for research on late effects; participants all had cancer. Its 'exposures' are cancer treatments (radiotherapy, anthracyclines), which are medical treatments and out of scope.

label: Collaborative European NeuroTrauma Effectiveness Research in Traumatic Brain Injury
quote: This multicenter, longitudinal, prospective, observational study in 22 countries across Europe and Israel will collect detailed data from 5400 consenting patients, presenting within 24 hours of injury, with a clinical diagnosis of TBI and an indication for computed tomography.
note: Prospective observational cohort of patients presenting to hospital with traumatic brain injury across Europe and Israel; a patient cohort, no environmental exposure.

label: Cystic Fibrosis-Related Diabetes Study
quote: The Cystic Fibrosis Genome Project (CFGP) is comprised of individuals with CF recruited by the CF Twin and Sibling Study (TSS)15 and Cystic Fibrosis-Related Diabetes (CFRD) Study16 (Johns Hopkins University)
note: Johns Hopkins study enrolling people with cystic fibrosis with and without CF-related diabetes, a contributor to the Cystic Fibrosis Genome Project; a patient cohort, no exposure.

label: US Cystic Fibrosis Twin and Sibling Study
quote: All subjects were part of the CF Twin-Sibling Study (n = 1038 individuals in 575 families) and were recruited from CF centers in the United States (n = 952), Australia (n = 48), Israel (n = 24), and United Kingdom (Scotland)(n = 14) between 2000 and 2013 on the basis of having CF and having a twin or sibling with CF.
note: Family-based study of twins and siblings who all have cystic fibrosis, recruited on the basis of having CF, to find genetic and environmental modifiers of CF outcomes; the participants are patients, and the 'environmental' modifiers are generic clinical covariates, not a defining environmental exposure.

label: Chicago Health and Aging Project
quote: CHAP is a longitudinal population study of common chronic health problems of older persons, especially of risk factors for incident Alzheimer's disease, in a biracial neighborhood of the south side of Chicago.
note: Population-based cohort of older adults in four Chicago neighbourhoods whose stated purpose is common chronic conditions of late life, especially risk factors for incident Alzheimer's disease, with clinical evaluation for AD in stratified random samples; the purpose is broad but centred on Alzheimer's disease. Air-pollution analyses were done later on modelled exposures, not as the design purpose, so it is not an exposure cohort.

label: Christchurch Health and Development Study
quote: The Christchurch Health and Development Study (CHDS) is a longitudinal cohort study that enrolled at birth 1265 people born in Christchurch, New Zealand in 1977.
note: Population-based birth cohort of all children born in Christchurch over four months in 1977, followed on health, development and wellbeing across the life course; a general birth cohort with no disease or exposure as its purpose (earthquake exposure was asked about retrospectively at age 35, not a recruitment basis).

label: National Institute of Neurological Disorders and Stroke Exploratory Trials in Parkinson's Disease Long-Term Study-1
quote: A total of 1,741 PD participants from 45 sites in the United States and Canada were randomized 1:1 to either 10 g of creatine/day or matching placebo.
note: Phase III placebo-controlled trial population of adults with early treated Parkinson's disease, randomised to creatine or placebo; a patient cohort, and the only 'exposure' is a trial drug.

label: Dunedin Multidisciplinary Health and Development Study
quote: Participants were members of the Dunedin Multidisciplinary Health and Development Study, a longitudinal study of 1037 people born in New Zealand in 1972-1973.
note: Complete birth cohort born in Dunedin in 1972-1973, followed from age 3 into midlife on health and behaviour across seven research themes (mental health, cardiovascular, respiratory, oral, sexual health, psychosocial); a general birth cohort with no single disease or exposure purpose.

label: European Community Respiratory Health Survey
quote: The European Community Respiratory Health Survey collected information on prevalent asthma-like symptoms from representative samples of adults aged 20-44 years (29 centres in 13 European countries and Australia) at baseline and 10 and 20 years later (n=7844).
note: Multicentre cohort of adults aged 20-44 selected at random from population registers to compare the prevalence, risk factors and treatment of asthma and allergic disease across countries, followed for asthma, allergy, lung function and COPD: a general-population study set up for one disease family. Second-hand smoke, occupational and other risk factors are measured as risk factors for asthma rather than as the design purpose, so it is not an exposure cohort.

label: EDRN Colorectal and Pancreatic Neoplasm Virtual Biorepository
diseases: colorectal cancer | pancreatic cancer | gastrointestinal malignancies | premalignant conditions | inflammatory bowel disease | pancreatic diseases
quote: The main objective of this initiative was to gather dispersed biospecimens and data pertaining to patients who have been regularly managed and followed-up from 1990 to 2000 either for regular colorectal cancer screening or gastrointestinal malignancies, premalignant conditions, inflammatory bowel disease, pancreatic diseases and pancreatic and colorectal cancers at different centers in the University of Pittsburgh Medical Center (UPMC) hospital networks.
note: NCI Early Detection Research Network biorepository at the University of Pittsburgh of clinically annotated specimens and data from patients managed for colorectal and pancreatic cancers, other GI malignancies, premalignant conditions, IBD and pancreatic disease (plus colorectal cancer screening patients); a patient biorepository, with tumour accessions, and no exposure design.

label: Echinococcus Multilocularis and Internal Diseases in Leutkirch
quote: Participating in the present study were 2,187 adults (1,138 females [52.0%]; 1,049 males [48.0%], age: 18-65 years) taken from a sample of 4,000 persons randomly chosen from an urban population.
note: Population-based random sample of residents of Leutkirch, Germany, examined in 2002 with questionnaire, ultrasound and blood sampling; its original aim of measuring the prevalence of Echinococcus multilocularis infection was widened to internal diseases and public health generally, so it is a general health survey of unselected residents rather than a disease or exposure cohort.

label: Early Pseudomonas Infection Control Observational Study
quote: The Early Pseudomonas Infection Control (EPIC) program consists of two studies, a randomized multicenter trial in CF patients ages 1-12 years at first isolation of Pa from a respiratory culture, and a longitudinal cohort study enrolling Pa-negative patients.
note: Prospective observational cohort of children with cystic fibrosis aged 12 or under who were Pseudomonas aeruginosa-negative at enrolment, followed at 59 US CF centres for risk factors and consequences of early Pa acquisition; a patient cohort. Environmental risk factors (cigarette smoke, hot tubs, daycare) are among the risk factors evaluated, not a defining exposure or the design purpose.

label: Environmental Risk Longitudinal Twin Study
quote: The Environmental Risk Longitudinal Twin Study (E-Risk) comprised 2163 twin children from England and Wales (49.1% male) identified at birth in 1994 and 1995 and included administration of the Test of Word Reading Efficiency at age 7 years and the Wechsler Preschool and Primary Scale of Intelligence-Revised as a test of IQ at age 5 years.
note: Nationally representative twin birth cohort (England and Wales, 1994-95) studying how environmental and genetic factors contribute to behaviour, health and mental health problems from childhood to adulthood; a twin registry-type birth cohort with a broad purpose. The 'environmental risk' in its name is psychosocial (family, social, digital environments), not an environmental agent in scope here.

label: Gabapentin for chronic pelvic pain in women
quote: We aimed to measure the efficacy and safety of gabapentin in women with chronic pelvic pain and no obvious pelvic pathology.
note: Participants of a UK multicentre placebo-controlled trial of gabapentin in women aged 18-50 with chronic pelvic pain of at least three months and no obvious pelvic pathology; a patient (trial) cohort whose only 'exposure' is the trial drug.

label: Interdisciplinary Group for Advanced Research on BirtH outcomes - DBT India Initiative
quote: A cohort study of pregnant women was initiated in May 2015 at the civil hospital in Gurugram, Haryana, India.
note: Single-centre prospective pregnancy cohort in Haryana, India, enrolling women before 20 weeks' gestation and following them to delivery to find correlates and risk-prediction tools for preterm birth. Participants are unselected pregnant women and the outcome studied, preterm birth, is a pregnancy outcome rather than a disease, so it is not classed as a disease cohort; no environmental exposure is its purpose.

label: Global Biobank Meta-analysis Initiative
quote: We introduce the Global Biobank Meta-analysis Initiative (GBMI)-a collaborative network of 23 biobanks from 4 continents representing more than 2.2 million consented individuals with genetic data linked to electronic health records.
note: Consortium of population biobanks with genotypes linked to health records that meta-analyses GWAS across many diseases and endpoints; a collection of general biobanks, not defined by any disease or exposure.

label: Treatment program of DLBCL patients from the Groupe d'Etude des Lymphomes de l'Adulte
quote: In stage 2, we included data from two unpublished and previously genotyped GWAS (GELA/EPIC and Mayo) plus one published GWAS (UCSF7), totaling 1,196 DLCBL cases and 1,445 controls (Online Methods; Supplementary Tables 1, 3).
note: Patients with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma enrolled in the GELA LNH03 treatment trials whose germline DNA formed the case series of the GELA DLBCL GWAS (controls drawn from EPIC France); a patient series treated with chemotherapy regimens, with no exposure design.

label: Genetic and Environmental Risk Factors for Alzheimer's Disease Among African Americans Study
quote: Cases met NINCDS-ADRDA criteria for possible or probable AD, determined in a consensus conference which included a behavioral neurologist, psychiatrist, neuropsychologist, and a behavioral neurology nurse practitioner.
note: Case-control study of Alzheimer's disease in African Americans aged 65 or over identified through Henry Ford Health System claims data, with AD cases and cognitively normal controls; the cases of a case-control study. 'Environmental risk factors' in the name is generic and no environmental agent defines the sample or its design as documented.

label: Gene Environment Interaction and Breast Cancer in Germany
quote: The GENICA study involved interviews to assess shift work information in 857 breast cancer cases and 892 controls.
note: Population-based case-control study of breast cancer in the Greater Bonn region, built (with the Institute for Prevention and Occupational Medicine) to study how genes and environmental exposures interact in breast cancer, with detailed interviews on night and shift work; the cases make it a disease cohort and its gene-environment design centres on exposures, though the specific agents documented here are occupational (night work) rather than physical or chemical.

label: Genizon GWAS
quote: Currently published GWASs include eight Europe-originated psoriasis-associated GWAS cohorts, including CASP [7], Kiel [8], Genizon [8], PsA GWAS [9], WTCCC2 [10], Exomechip [11], PAGE [12], and GAPC [12], two South Asia-originated psoriasis-associated GWAS cohort including three batches [13], and one East Asia-originated psoriasis-associated GWAS cohort [14].
note: Case-control GWAS sample of psoriasis patients and controls from the Quebec founder population assembled by Genizon BioSciences; the cases of a case-control study, no exposure design.

label: GEnetic analysis of NUclear Families with Atopic Dermatitis
quote: The GENUFAD study (Genetic Analysis of Nuclear Families with Atopic Dermatitis) recruited complete nuclear families with at least two children affected with early-onset (<2 years of age) and moderate to severe AD as previously described [20].
note: Family-based genetic study recruiting nuclear families through at least two children with early-onset moderate to severe atopic dermatitis, plus unrelated affected children in its extended phase; a patient (affected family) cohort with no exposure design.

label: German Myocardial Infarction Family Study
quote: The 875 case subjects in the German MI Family Study were persons who had myocardial infarction before the age of 60 years and at least one first-degree relative with premature coronary artery disease.
note: Series of German case collections (GerMIFS I-VII) of people with early myocardial infarction or coronary artery disease, including familial cases and patients referred for angiography, compared with population controls; an aggregation of patient case series for one disease family, no exposure design.

label: Gene-Lifestyle Interactions and Complex Traits Involved in Elevated Disease Risk Study
quote: Sixteen fasting glucose-raising loci were genotyped in middle-aged adults from the Gene x Lifestyle interactions And Complex traits Involved in Elevated disease Risk (GLACIER) Study, a population-based prospective cohort study from northern Sweden.
note: Population-based prospective cohort nested in the Northern Sweden Health and Disease Study, established specifically for gene-lifestyle interaction studies of cardiometabolic traits, with diet (FFQ), physical activity, smoking and alcohol data from the Vasterbotten Intervention Programme; lifestyle exposures are its stated main subject, hence an exposure cohort, but its participants are unselected adults and its disease scope (cardiometabolic traits, type 2 diabetes, obesity, CAD) is broad, so not a disease cohort.

label: German Multicenter Allergy Study
diseases: allergic diseases | asthma | allergic rhinitis | eczema
quote: The MAS (Multicenter Allergy Study) is a previously described population-based birth cohort in which 1314 German infants were followed since 1990 to investigate the epidemiology of allergic diseases [44].
note: German birth cohort of 1314 newborns recruited in 1990 in five cities, deliberately enriched for newborns at high allergy risk (two allergic family members or raised cord-blood IgE) and followed into adulthood to study asthma, allergic rhinitis, eczema and sensitisation; a birth cohort set up for one disease family (part of the sample also 'at risk'), with no environmental exposure as its purpose.

label: Genetic Modifier Study
quote: The Genetic Modifier Study (GMS) consists of unrelated patients homozygous for the common CF allele F508del (HGVS nomenclature: p.Phe508del), recruited from extremes of lung function9.
note: Case-control study of genetic modifiers of cystic fibrosis lung disease enrolling F508del-homozygous CF patients at the extremes of lung function from US CF centres; a patient cohort with no exposure design.

label: Genetic Modifier Study of Severe CF Liver Disease
diseases: cystic fibrosis | cystic fibrosis liver disease
quote: Two-stage case-control study enrolling patients with CF and severe liver disease with portal hypertension (CFLD) from 63 CF centers in the United States as well as 32 in Canada and 18 outside of North America, with the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill as the coordinating site.
note: International case-control study of genetic modifiers of severe liver disease in cystic fibrosis, enrolling CF patients with cirrhosis and portal hypertension and CF controls without liver disease; a patient cohort with no exposure design.

label: GSK
quote: The samples from GSK derived from two randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled comparisons of the antidepressant efficacy and the effects on sexual functioning of Bupropion XL and escitalopram in outpatients with moderate to severe depression (22).
note: Pharmacogenetic sample of outpatients with moderate to severe major depressive disorder from two GlaxoSmithKline escitalopram trials, contributed to NEWMEDS for antidepressant-response genetics; a patient (trial) cohort whose only 'exposure' is a medication.

label: GSK Munich recurrent major depression case-control study
quote: The first GWAS was performed on 1022 recurrent MDD patients and 1000 controls genotyped on the Illumina 550 platform.
note: GlaxoSmithKline case-control sample of German patients with recurrent major depression recruited at the Max Planck Institute of Psychiatry in Munich and two satellite hospitals, with screened community controls, used as the first case-control cohort of the recurrent MDD GWAS; the cases of a case-control study, no exposure design.

label: Great Smoky Mountains Study
quote: The Great Smoky Mountains Study (GSMS) was originally designed to examine the prevalence of common childhood psychiatric disorders, their development over time and use of mental health services in a predominantly rural area of the southeastern United States.
note: A population-based longitudinal study of rural North Carolina children, sampled at random with oversampling of high scorers on a psychiatric screen, designed to study childhood psychiatric disorders and service use; no environmental exposure defines it.

label: Hasselt Appendicitis Immunology and Environmental Study
quote: A total of 325 patients were prospectively recruited in the HAPPIEST population at Jessa Hospital, Hasselt, Belgium, between June 2012 and October 2016.
note: A prospective cohort of acute appendicitis patients at Jessa Hospital, Hasselt; its registered aim includes analysing environmental factors (diet, lifestyle, early-life environment by questionnaire) in the pathology of appendicitis, so it counts as designed to study exposures, though the exposures are broad.

label: Hwasun Cancer Epidemiology Study-Breast
quote: Included in this project were 3,387 female breast 94 cancer cases, who were newly diagnosed between April 2004 and February 2013 at 95 Chonnam National University Hwasun Hospital, a cancer specified hospital in 96 Jeollanam-do province, South Korea.
note: The breast cancer arm of a hospital-based case-control study at Chonnam National University Hwasun Hospital; its cases are newly diagnosed breast cancer patients, and no environmental exposure defines it.

label: Health2008 Study
quote: In the population-based Health2008 study, 2218 men and women aged 30-60 years were invited.
note: A cross-sectional population-based study of a random sample of adults aged 30-60 in the Copenhagen area; neither an exposure nor a single disease defines it.

label: Health2010 Study
quote: Health2010 study was conducted between 2010-2011 and included a random sample aged 18-69 years and living in the western part of the capital region of Denmark.
note: A population-based study of a random sample of Danish adults aged 18-69 with a broad focus (cardiovascular disease, diabetes, asthma and allergy), so not a single-disease cohort, and no exposure defines it.

label: Hong Kong Diabetes Register
quote: We investigated glycemic progression among 7,091 Chinese patients with T2D from the Hong Kong Diabetes Register enrolled between 1995 and 2007.
note: A prospective register of diabetes patients at the Prince of Wales Hospital, Hong Kong, followed for complications and outcomes; a patient cohort with no defining environmental exposure.

label: HostSeq initiative
quote: The HostSeq initiative recruited 10,059 Canadians infected with SARS-CoV-2 between March 2020 and March 2023, obtained clinical information on their disease experience and whole genome sequenced (WGS) their DNA.
note: A Canadian databank aggregating 13 studies of people infected with SARS-CoV-2, for host-genetic research on COVID-19 outcomes; the participants have the infection, so it is a disease (patients) aggregation rather than an exposed-uninfected cohort.

label: Hvidoere Remission Phase Study
quote: A total of 275 patients aged <16 years were followed from onset of type 1 diabetes.
note: A multinational cohort of children with newly diagnosed type 1 diabetes followed for 12 months to study residual beta-cell function; a patient cohort with no defining exposure.

label: Nord-Trøndelag Health Study 1995–97
quote: All current residents ≥20 years of age in Nord-Trøndelag have been invited to each survey wave: the HUNT1 (1984–86, 77 202 participants, 89.4% of invitees participated),1 HUNT2 (1995-97, 65 228 participants, 69.5%)2 and HUNT3 (2006-08, 50 800 participants, 54.1%)3 surveys (Figure 1).
note: The second HUNT survey, to which all adult residents of Nord-Trøndelag were invited; a general population health survey defined neither by an exposure nor by a disease.

label: HypnoLaus Sleep Cohort Study
quote: Taking into account improvements in recording techniques and new criteria used to define respiratory events, we aimed to assess the prevalence of sleep-disordered breathing and associated clinical features in a large population-based sample.
note: A population-based sleep cohort of consecutive CoLaus/PsyCoLaus participants given home polysomnography; its stated aim is the prevalence of sleep-disordered breathing, one disease family, so a population study of disease; no exposure defines it.

label: Interaction of Gene and Environment of Depression during PostPartum
quote: IGEDEPP (Interaction of Gene and Environment of Depression during PostPartum) is a prospective multicenter cohort study of 3310 Caucasian women who gave birth between 2011 and 2016, with follow-up until one year postpartum.
note: A prospective cohort of women recruited after delivery in Paris maternity units and followed for a year to study postpartum depression; the 'environment' it studies is stressful life events and childhood trauma, which are psychosocial and outside the exposure scope.

label: Impact of Neurodevelopmental disorders and School performance: genes and environment
quote: Children who screened positive were interviewed for diagnostic confirmation according to the Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders, while students who screened negative served as controls.
note: A school-based cohort in Catalonia screening children for mental health problems and learning difficulties with diagnostic confirmation, set up to study neurodevelopmental disorders and school performance; 'environment' in the name is not a specific environmental exposure.

label: Japanese Consortium for Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis research
quote: The JaCALS registry is a multicenter patient registry for ALS involving 42 institutions across Japan.
note: A Japanese multicentre registry of ALS patients with DNA and clinical follow-up; a patient cohort with no defining exposure.

label: JAPC GWAS
quote: Briefly, incident prostate cancer cases were identified by cohort linkage to Surveillance, Epidemiology and End Results cancer registries covering Hawaii and California.
note: A nested case-control GWAS of prostate cancer in Japanese American men of the Multiethnic Cohort; the cases have the disease, and the GWAS itself is not designed around an environmental exposure.

label: Japan Prospective Studies Collaboration for Aging and Dementia
quote: The Japan Prospective Studies Collaboration for Aging and Dementia (JPSC-AD) is a multisite, population-based prospective cohort study of dementia, which was designed to enroll approximately 10,000 community-dwelling residents aged 65 years or older from 8 sites in Japan and to follow them up prospectively for at least 5 years.
note: A population-based cohort of community-dwelling older Japanese followed for incident dementia; its 'environmental risk factors' are general lifestyle and medical variables (diabetes, obesity, smoking, inactivity), not a defining environmental exposure.

label: Korean Research Project on the Integrated Exposure Assessment of Hazardous Substances for Food Safety
quote: We selected 4867 subjects of all ages throughout Korea.
note: A nationwide Korean survey population sampled across all ages and built to assess dietary exposure to hazardous substances (heavy metals and others) with biomonitoring; an exposure study of the general population, not a disease cohort.

label: LAPC GWAS
quote: Incident Latino PrCa cases were identified by linking with the cancer registries in Hawaii and California.
note: A nested case-control GWAS of prostate cancer in Latino men of the Multiethnic Cohort; the cases have the disease, and the GWAS is not designed around an environmental exposure.

label: Levodopa in Early Parkinson's Disease
quote: Patients with early stage PD whose functional health does not yet necessitate initiation of PD-medication will be randomised to either 40 weeks of treatment with levodopa/carbidopa 100/25 mg TID including 2 weeks of dose escalation or to 40 weeks placebo TID.
note: A Dutch randomised delayed-start trial of levodopa in patients with early Parkinson's disease; a patient trial cohort whose only 'exposure' is a medication, which is out of scope.

label: Luxembourg Parkinson's Study
quote: Since 2015, over 800 individuals with PD and atypical parkinsonism along with more than 800 control subjects have been recruited in the frame of the observational, monocentric, nation-wide, longitudinal-prospective Luxembourg Parkinson's study.
note: A Luxembourg observational cohort of patients with Parkinson's disease and atypical parkinsonism plus controls, deeply phenotyped for diagnosis and progression markers; no environmental exposure defines it.

label: Lung Tissue Research Consortium
diseases: chronic obstructive pulmonary disease | idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis | interstitial lung disease
quote: The LTRC was a biobank resource established by the NHLBI to collect and distribute lung tissue, blood samples, clinical data, and radiographic studies from participants with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF), other related idiopathic interstitial pneumonias (IIP) and interstitial pneumonias associated with connective tissue diseases who undergo medically-indicated lung resection.
note: An NHLBI biobank of lung tissue and blood from adults undergoing thoracic surgery, formed to collect material from patients with COPD and interstitial lung diseases (some participants turned out not to have them); no environmental exposure defines it.

label: Mammary Carcinoma Risk Factor Investigation
quote: In a large population-based case-control study in Germany, including 3,464 breast cancer cases aged 50-74 at diagnosis and 6,657 population based and frequency matched controls
note: A German population-based case-control study of postmenopausal breast cancer whose cases were followed as a patient cohort; its main risk factor of interest, menopausal hormone therapy, is a medication and out of the exposure scope.

label: Mayo Clinic Study of Aging
quote: The objective of this study was to establish a prospective population-based cohort to investigate the prevalence, incidence and risk factors for mild cognitive impairment (MCI) and dementia.
note: A random population sample of Olmsted County residents established to study the prevalence, incidence and risk factors of MCI and dementia; a population study of one disease family, not defined by any exposure.

label: MedStar
quote: Discovery studies were PennCath and MedStar (webappendix p 2), which recruited patients before coronary angiography at the University of Pennsylvania Medical Center (Penn) and Washington Hospital Center (WHC), respectively.
note: A hospital-based case-control study of angiographic coronary artery disease among patients undergoing cardiac catheterisation at Washington Hospital Center; no environmental exposure defines it.

label: Melanoma in Southern Sweden
quote: The Melanoma Inquiry in Southern Sweden (MISS) was a prospective cohort study looking at risk factors for melanoma [27].
note: A random population sample of southern Swedish women set up to study melanoma risk factors, centred on UV exposure, sunbed use and sun-exposure habits by questionnaire; so both a population study of melanoma and a cohort designed to study UV exposure (quote is the title of the cohort's design paper, printed by cached.py).

label: Michigan State University Twin Registry
quote: The MSUTR has two broad components: a large-scale, population-based registry of child, adolescent, and adult twins and their families (current N~30,000) and a series of more focused and in-depth studies drawn from the registry (projected N~7,200).
note: A population-based twin registry from Michigan birth records; although its research focus is psychopathology, twin registries are out of scope as disease cohorts, and no environmental exposure defines it.

label: Mater-University of Queensland Study of Pregnancy
quote: MUSP was originally developed as a birth cohort study. It has become a longitudinal study of growth, development and ageing with an emphasis on the generational transmission of a wide range of factors impacting on adult health outcomes.
note: A Brisbane pregnancy birth cohort of mother-child pairs that became a general longitudinal study of growth, development and ageing; neither exposure nor one disease is its design basis.

label: Myositis Genetics Consortium
quote: We analyzed 2,565 Caucasian IIM patient samples collected through the Myositis Genetics Consortium (MYOGEN) and 10,260 ethnically matched control samples.
note: An international consortium collecting DNA from patients with idiopathic inflammatory myopathies; its members are patients, so disease: patients; no exposure basis.

label: Carolina Breast Cancer Study
quote: The present study was conducted within the Carolina Breast Cancer Study (CBCS), a large, population-based case-control study of breast cancer biology and epidemiology enriched for breast cancers occurring among young women.
note: A population-based case-control and case cohort study of breast cancer in North Carolina; cases have the disease. Risk factors are studied among many, not as an exposure design.

label: North Carolina Bladder Cancer Study
quote: Using a polymerase chain reaction (PCR)-based method, we examined the frequency of the homozygous deleted genotype (GSTM1 0/0) in 229 patients with transitional cell carcinoma of the bladder and 211 control subjects who were enrolled from the Urology Clinics at Duke University Medical Center and the University of North Carolina Hospitals.
note: A hospital-based bladder cancer case-control study; cases are patients. Smoking is analysed as a modifier of genetic susceptibility, but participants were not selected for exposure and the main subject is carcinogen-metabolism and DNA-repair genotype, so exposure is no.

label: NCI-Maryland Prostate Cancer Case-Control Study
quote: the NCI-Maryland Prostate Cancer Case-Control Study consisting of 798 men with incident prostate cancer (402 AA and 496 EA) and 1,008 population-based controls (474 AA and 534 EA).
note: A prostate cancer case-control study in Baltimore; cases are patients. No exposure defines the cohort.

label: Northern Finland Birth Cohort 1966
quote: At baseline, all mothers with expected dates of delivery between 1 January and 31 December 1966 were recruited from the two northernmost provinces in Finland.
note: A whole-population birth cohort of northern Finland set up to study risk factors and consequences of preterm birth and intrauterine growth retardation (pregnancy outcomes, not a disease in scope), later a general life-course cohort.

label: Linxian General Population Nutrition Intervention Trial
quote: Rates of oesophageal/gastric cardia cancer in Linxian, a rural county in north central China, are among the world's highest, but the risk factors are not well understood.
note: A randomized vitamin/mineral supplementation trial of healthy adults in Linxian, a county with some of the world's highest oesophageal/gastric cardia cancer rates, followed as a cohort; nutritional exposure is its main subject (borderline, as the exposure is a supplement intervention) and its purpose is prevention of these cancers.

label: Neuro-Ophthalmology Research at Fundació ACE
diseases: dementia | mild cognitive impairment | Alzheimer's disease
quote: The study population included 1847 dementia patients, 764 MCI patients, and 559 CH individuals from the NORFACE cohort (Table 1).
note: Memory-clinic cohort of people evaluated for cognitive decline at Ace Alzheimer Center Barcelona, mostly dementia and MCI patients with some cognitively healthy participants; no exposure basis.

label: New York Cancer Project
quote: A new cohort study was undertaken with several aims: (1) to provide a database and biorepository for studies of cancer etiology and pathogenesis, including host genetics;
note: A venue-sampled cohort and biorepository of New York adults whose stated aims centre on cancer aetiology and racial/ethnic disparities in cancer; no exposure defines it.

label: Okinawa Bioinformation Bank
quote: BBJ is a hospital-based disease cohort, whereas OBi is a population-based study, and the mean age of BBJ participants is higher than that of OBi participants.
note: A population-based biobank of Okinawa residents for population history and genetics of common and rare diseases; neither exposure nor a single disease defines it.

label: Pancreatic Cancer Cohort Consortium
quote: We performed a multistage genome-wide association study including 7,683 individuals with pancreatic cancer and 14,397 controls of European descent.
note: An NCI consortium collecting pancreatic cancer cases and controls from cohorts and case-control studies for GWAS; classified by its cases as a pancreatic cancer patient aggregation; no exposure basis.

label: Prostate Cancer Genome-wide Association Study of Uncommon Susceptibility Loci
quote: A new genome-wide association study was conducted in prostate cancer cases and controls of European ancestry from the Prostate, Lung, Colorectal, and Ovarian (PLCO) Cancer Screening Trial.
note: A nested prostate cancer case-control GWAS within the PLCO screening trial; cases are prostate cancer patients; no exposure basis.

label: University of Pennsylvania Catheterization Study
quote: Discovery studies were PennCath and MedStar (webappendix p 2), which recruited patients before coronary angiography at the University of Pennsylvania Medical Center (Penn) and Washington Hospital Center (WHC), respectively.
note: Consecutive patients undergoing cardiac catheterisation and coronary angiography, studied for coronary artery disease; no exposure basis.

label: Pediatric Imaging, Neurocognition, and Genetics
quote: The main objective of the multi-site Pediatric Imaging, Neurocognition, and Genetics (PING) study was to create a large repository of standardized measurements of behavioral and imaging phenotypes accompanied by whole genome genotyping acquired from typically-developing children varying widely in age (3 to 20 years).
note: A cross-sectional imaging-genetics repository of typically developing children and young adults about brain and cognitive development; neither exposure nor disease defines it.

label: Karolinska Mammography Project for Risk Prediction of Breast Cancer - Case-Control Study
quote: pKARMA is a cohort of 5002 invasive breast cancer patients diagnosed between 2001 and 2008 in Stockholm and 5433 breast cancer-free women from KARMA (26).
note: A Swedish breast cancer case-control study of Stockholm breast cancer patients with KARMA controls; no exposure basis.

label: Parkinson Research Examination of CEP-1347 Trial
quote: Consenting PD patients not yet requiring dopaminergic therapy (n = 806) were randomized equally to CEP-1347 in dosages of 10 mg BID, 25 mg BID, or 50 mg BID, or matching placebo, and were evaluated blindly and prospectively.
note: A randomized drug trial in early Parkinson's disease patients, followed observationally afterwards; the only exposure is a drug, so exposure is no.

label: Predictors For ECT
diseases: major depressive episode | major depressive disorder
quote: Here, we test the utility of targeting the severe end of the MDD spectrum through genome-wide SNP genotyping of 2725 cases who received electroconvulsive therapy (ECT) for a major depressive episode (MDE) and 4035 controls.
note: Swedish patients treated with ECT for severe major depressive episodes; ECT is a treatment, not an environmental exposure.

label: Performance of Rotavirus and Oral Polio Vaccines in Developing Countries
quote: A birth cohort of 700 infants from the Mirpur area of Dhaka, Bangladesh was established, following infants for the first 2 years of life.
note: A vaccine-trial birth cohort of newborns in low-income Dhaka studying oral vaccine underperformance; the defining exposure is vaccination (a medical intervention), and enteric infections are outcomes studied, not a recruitment basis or a single-disease purpose.

label: Queensland Twin Registry
quote: Queensland Twin Registry (QTwin) Study is a population-based registry of identical and non-identical twins and triplets of all ages, living in Australia.
note: A population-based twin registry; twin registries are no on both counts.

label: Research in African American Alzheimer Disease Initiative
quote: We performed whole-genome sequencing (WGS) and multipoint linkage analyses in 51 multi-generational AA AD families ascertained through the Research in African American Alzheimer Disease Initiative (REAAADI) and the National Institute on Aging Late Onset Alzheimer's disease (NIA-LOAD) Family Based Study.
note: A family-based study of African American families affected by Alzheimer's disease (patients with their relatives) to find AD genes; no exposure basis.

label: The Roskilde cohort of pregnant women
quote: To test if serum YKL-40 is increased in women developing preeclampsia or small-for-gestational age fetuses.
note: A cohort of unselected pregnant women set up to test a biomarker for preeclampsia and fetal growth restriction; pregnancy itself does not count, but its stated purpose is these pregnancy disorders, so population study of disease (borderline).

label: Shanghai Breast Cancer Genetics Study
quote: The SBCGS was conducted in 5152 participants (2867 case participants and 2285 control participants) from the following four population-based studies conducted among Chinese women in urban Shanghai between 1996 and 2005: the Shanghai Breast Cancer Study [25], the Shanghai Breast Cancer Survival Study [26], the Shanghai Endometrial Cancer Study (contributing controls only) [27] and the Shanghai Women’s Health Study [28].
note: A breast cancer case-control genetics study pooling cases and controls from four Shanghai studies; classified by its cases as breast cancer patients; no exposure basis.

label: Scandinavian Lymphoma Etiology study
diseases: malignant lymphoma | non-Hodgkin lymphoma | Hodgkin lymphoma
quote: Briefly, SCALE is a population-based case–control study of the etiology of malignant lymphomas conducted in Sweden and Denmark 1999 to 2002.
note: A Danish-Swedish population-based case-control study of lymphoma aetiology; cases are patients. Exposures such as UV are studied among many risk factors, not as a design basis, so exposure is no.

label: Spanish Coalition to Unlock Research on Host Genetics on COVID-19
quote: The Spanish Coalition to Unlock Research on Host Genetics on COVID-19 (SCOURGE) recruited COVID-19 patients between March and December 2020 from hospitals across Spain and from March 2020 to July 2021 in Latin America (https://www.scourge-covid.org).
note: A host-genetics cohort of hospital-recruited COVID-19 patients; the infection is the disease, not an exposure in the exposed-uninfected sense.

label: Steno Diabetes Center T2D Cases
quote: A sample of clinical-onset type 2 diabetes patients and non-diabetic control individuals were ascertained at the outpatient clinic at Steno Diabetes Center, Copenhagen.
note: Type 2 diabetes patients and controls from the Steno Diabetes Center outpatient clinic; no exposure basis.

label: Scottish Diabetes Research Network Type 1 Bioresource
quote: SDRNT1BIO includes people with a clinical diagnosis of T1D who are aged 16 years or older at enrollment.
note: A Scottish bioresource of people with a clinical diagnosis of type 1 diabetes, so a patient cohort; no environmental exposure defines or drives it.

label: Shanxi Upper Gastrointestinal Cancer Genetics Project
diseases: esophageal squamous cell carcinoma | gastric cardia adenocarcinoma | gastric noncardia adenocarcinoma
quote: We evaluated questionnaire-based risk factors for UGI cancers in a case-control study from Shanxi Province, China, including 600 esophageal squamous cell carcinomas (ESCCs), 599 gastric cardia adenocarcinomas (GCAs), 316 gastric noncardia adenocarcinomas (GNCAs), and 1514 age- and gender-matched controls.
note: A case-control and case-only genetics project of upper gastrointestinal cancers in Shanxi, so its cases are patients. Questionnaire risk factors such as diet and smoking were measured, but the project is a genetic study of cancer cases, not one designed around an environmental exposure.

label: Swiss HIV Cohort Study
quote: The Swiss HIV Cohort Study (SHCS) is an ongoing multicentre research project dealing with adults infected with HIV aged 16 years or older residing in Switzerland.
note: A nationwide cohort of people living with HIV, so a patient cohort; the infection is the disease, not an exposure of uninfected people.

label: Study of Osteoporotic Fractures
quote: ParticipantsThe SOF is a NIH-funded prospective cohort study of older women initially designed to determine risk factors for fractures and falls but expanded to evaluate risk for other outcomes including all-cause and cause-specific mortality in older women.
note: A population-based cohort of community-dwelling women aged 65 or older set up to study risk factors for osteoporotic fractures, so a population study of one disease family; no environmental exposure is its design purpose.

label: Study of Twin Adults: Genes and Environment
quote: The 'Study of Twin Adults: Genes and Environment’ (STAGE) is a cohort of the Swedish Twin Registry at the Karolinska Institute in Stockholm, of approximately 32,000 twin individuals, born between 1959 and 1985.
note: A twin cohort of the Swedish Twin Registry recruited by birth year, not by any exposure or disease.

label: Sequenced Treatment Alternatives to Relieve Depression
quote: STAR*D is a multisite, prospective, randomized, multistep clinical trial of outpatients with nonpsychotic major depressive disorder.
note: A treatment trial of outpatients with nonpsychotic major depressive disorder; the only exposures are antidepressant treatments, which are out of scope.

label: Tyypin 1 Diabeteksen Genetiikka
quote: We analysed data from six cohorts, independent cases from the UK Genetic Resource Investigating Diabetes (GRID) cohort [2], the Northern Irish GRID (NI) cohort (used here for the first time), and the Finnish IDDMGEN (Tyypin 1 Diabetekseen Sairastuneita Perheenjäsenineen) and T1DGEN (Tyypin 1 Diabeteksen Genetiikka) cohorts [10]
note: A Finnish collection of type 1 diabetes cases used in ImmunoChip studies, contributing independent cases, so a patient cohort; no environmental exposure is involved.

label: Swedish Twin study of CHild and Adolescent Development
