quote: Participants were originally included in a population-based longitudinal twin study, the Twin Study of Child and Adolescent Development (TCHAD),34 comprising all twins born in Sweden between May 1985 and December 1986 (2960 children in total).
note: A population-based twin study of all Swedish twins born 1985-86, about how genes and environments shape development of health and behavioural problems; broad purpose, not selected by exposure or disease.

label: Transforming Research and Clinical Knowledge in Traumatic Brain Injury
quote: The Investigators are enrolling patients within 24 hours of injury who present to a TRACK-TBI site with a brain injury that meets ACRM criteria and receives a clinically indicated head CT.
note: A multicentre observational cohort of patients with acute traumatic brain injury (with orthopaedic trauma controls), so a patient cohort; no environmental exposure defines it.

label: Type 1 Diabetes TrialNet
quote: TrialNet actively screens relatives of individuals with type 1 diabetes, but other individuals who do not have a relative with the disease may join TN01 if they are found to have positive islet autoantibodies in an outside laboratory.
note: TrialNet screens relatives of people with type 1 diabetes and autoantibody-positive people for its natural-history study, and also runs trials in newly diagnosed patients; mainly an at-risk cohort for type 1 diabetes. No environmental exposure is involved.

label: UCI Breast Cancer Study
quote: All cases diagnosed in Orange County, California from 1994-1995; ascertained through the population-based Cancer Surveillance Program of Orange County California (CSPOC)
note: A population-based breast cancer case-control study whose cases are breast cancer patients from Orange County, so a patient cohort; no environmental exposure is its design purpose.

label: U.S. Radiologic Technologists Study
note: An occupational cohort of certified radiologic technologists followed for the health effects of low-dose occupational radiation, so an exposure cohort defined by occupation; its outcomes are cancer and other diseases broadly, so not a disease cohort.

label: Vanderbilt Atrial Fibrillation Ablation Registry
quote: The study population consists of patients at least 18 years of age who are scheduled for AF ablation at Vanderbilt University.
note: A clinical and genetic registry of adults scheduled for catheter ablation of atrial fibrillation, so a patient cohort; ablation is a procedure, not an environmental exposure.

label: Vietnam Era Twin Study of Aging
quote: VETSA began as a longitudinal behavioral genetic study of cognitive and brain aging, but as the participants have aged, its primary focus has shifted to early identification of risk for mild cognitive impairment (MCI) and Alzheimer’s disease (AD).
note: Twins drawn from a registry of men who served in the US military in the Vietnam era, so selected by military service (though most report no combat exposure and the study is about aging); its stated focus is now early risk of MCI and Alzheimer's disease.

label: VHIR-FMT-Barcelona
quote: VHIR-FMT-Barcelona The Barcelona cohort is a subset of Caucasian Ischemic stroke subjects that were enrolled as a part of the Genetic contribution to functional Outcome and Disability after Stroke (GODs) project.
note: A Barcelona case-control collection whose cases are ischaemic stroke patients, used in stroke GWAS; no environmental exposure defines it.

label: Virginia Twin Study of Adolescent Behavioral Development
quote: The Virginia Twin Study of Adolescent Behavioral Development is a cohort-longitudinal epidemiological study that uses the genetic twin design to study the development and maintenance of child psychiatric disorders.
note: A population-based, unselected sample of Virginia school twins whose stated purpose is the development of child psychiatric disorders (and later substance use), so a population study of one disease family; it is not selected or designed around an environmental exposure.

label: Vanderbilt Atrial Fibrillation Registry
quote: Patients with AF and family members are prospectively enrolled.
note: A clinical and genetic registry of patients with atrial fibrillation and their family members, so a patient cohort; no environmental exposure is involved.

label: WeGene cohort
quote: All participants were drawn from the customer base of WeGene, Inc., a consumer personal genetics company.
note: A research cohort of customers of a Chinese direct-to-consumer genetic testing company, not selected for any exposure or disease.

label: Wisconsin Sleep Cohort Study
quote: As the epidemiological project of the SCOR application from the University of Wisconsin, we proposed the Wisconsin Sleep Cohort Study (WSCS), a longitudinal epidemiology study designed to investigate the natural history of SDB by conducting overnight PSG, repeated at 4-year intervals, on a random sample of the general population.
note: A population sample of Wisconsin state employees, enriched for snorers, designed to study the natural history of sleep-disordered breathing, so a population study of one disease; the state-employee frame is a sampling frame, not an occupational exposure.

label: ZOE 2.0
quote: ZOE 2.0 is an observational, cross-sectional, community-based epidemiologic investigation of early childhood oral health with focus on ECC.
note: A community-based study of preschool children in North Carolina set up as a GWAS of early childhood caries, so a population study of one disease; no environmental exposure is its design purpose.

label: Protection Against Allergy: Study in Rural Environments
quote: The PASTURE study is a prospective birth cohort study started in 2002 and is conducted in children from rural areas of 5 European countries (Austria, Finland, France, Germany, and Switzerland).17 The study was designed to evaluate risk and preventive factors for atopic diseases.
note: A rural birth cohort whose farm group was selected for living on livestock farms, compared with non-farm rural children, to study farm exposures as protective factors; its stated purpose is asthma and atopic disease.

label: Project Viva
quote: We recruited pregnant women at their initial prenatal visit in eastern Massachusetts between 1999 and 2002.
note: A pre-birth cohort of pregnant women from a Massachusetts practice established to examine prenatal diet and other factors, so designed around a lifestyle exposure; its outcomes are broad maternal and child health, so not a disease cohort.

label: GERO cohort
quote: The objective of the GERO cohort is to analyze the rate of functional decline and progression to clinical dementia and their associated risk factors in a community-dwelling elderly with subjective cognitive complaint, through a population-based study.
note: Community-dwelling adults aged 70 or over without dementia but with subjective cognitive complaint, followed for progression to dementia, so selected for risk of dementia; no environmental exposure defines it.

label: Alzheimer's Genetics in Argentina–Alzheimer Argentina consortium
quote: We performed GWAS on sporadic Alzheimer's disease (AD) including 539 patients and 854 controls from Argentina and Chile.
note: A multisite Argentinian case-control study of sporadic Alzheimer's disease (its samples are the Argentinian ones in this GWAS), so its cases are patients; no environmental exposure is involved.

label: STORK study
quote: The STORK study is a prospective cohort study including 1031 healthy pregnant women of Scandinavian heritage with singleton pregnancies.
note: A cohort of healthy pregnant women in Oslo studying determinants of fetal growth and birthweight; pregnancy is not a disease and no environmental exposure defines it.

label: San Antonio Longitudinal Study of Aging
quote: The San Antonio Longitudinal Study of Aging (SALSA) is a community-based study of the disablement process in older Mexican Americans (MAs) and European Americans (EAs).
note: Community-based longitudinal study of the disablement process and frailty in older Mexican and European Americans randomly sampled from San Antonio neighbourhoods; an ageing study, not selected for an exposure or a disease.

label: Northern Ireland GRID Collection
quote: We analysed data from six cohorts, independent cases from the UK Genetic Resource Investigating Diabetes (GRID) cohort [2], the Northern Irish GRID (NI) cohort (used here for the first time)
note: A collection of type 1 diabetes cases from Northern Ireland used as independent cases in type 1 diabetes genetic studies; no exposure basis.

label: Genome-wide assessment of the gene variants associated with severe COVID-19 phenotype in Iran
quote: IrCovid - Genome-wide assessment of the gene variants associated with severe COVID-19 phenotype in Iran
note: Iranian genetic study of severe COVID-19 contributing to the COVID-19 HGI; the study name states it is about severe COVID-19, and that its participants are hospitalised patients rests on the definition only, since no fetched text describes its recruitment.

label: Northern Ireland Young Hearts Project
quote: The Young Hearts Project (YH) is an ongoing longitudinal study evaluating the prevalence of CVD risk factors in young people living in Northern Ireland.
note: Random school samples of Northern Irish adolescents followed into young adulthood; its stated purpose is cardiovascular disease risk factors, so it is a population study of cardiovascular disease. Diet and physical activity are measured but are not the design basis.

label: Active Life Expectancy, Ageing, and Disability Related to Obesity Study
quote: The ALEXANDROS cohort, designed to study disability and dementia associated with obesity in community dwelling people 60y and older, has already been described [66].
note: Community-dwelling older adults in Santiago, Chile, sampled from population sources; the cohort was designed to study disability and dementia associated with obesity, so it is a population study of those diseases, not a patient series.

label: Genetics of Glaucoma in People of African Descent Consortium
quote: A 2-stage GWAS with a discovery data set of 2320 individuals with primary open-angle glaucoma and 2121 control individuals without primary open-angle glaucoma.
note: Consortium of case-control collections of primary open-angle glaucoma in people of African ancestry; classified by what it collects: glaucoma cases and controls.

label: International Collaboration on Ovarian Neoplasms 7 trial
quote: ICON7 was conducted in advanced or high-risk early-stage ovarian cancer patients treated with carboplatin and paclitaxel with or without bevacizumab.
note: Phase 3 randomised trial of bevacizumab in women with newly diagnosed ovarian cancer; the only exposure is treatment, which is out of scope.

label: Genetics of Parkinson's in India – Young Onset Parkinson's Disease
quote: Specifically, we jointly profiled 674 PD subjects predominantly with earlier onset PD from the Parkinson’s Research Alliance of India (PRAI) cohort via genotype array and whole exome sequencing (WES)
note: Pan-India multicentre series of patients with juvenile-, young- and early-onset Parkinson's disease recruited at movement disorder centres.

label: SweCovid study
quote: The discovery set was taken from the Pronmed cohort that consists of 374 critically ill COVID-19 patients admitted to the intensive care unit (ICU) at Uppsala University Hospital, in Uppsala, Sweden between March 13, 2020 and June 30, 2021 (Fig. 2A).
note: Patients with critical COVID-19 admitted to the Uppsala University Hospital ICU and followed up after discharge; a disease cohort, not an exposure cohort.

label: COVID-19 Kohortenstudie am Klinikum München Rechts der Isar
quote: Hospitalized patients (ICU, n = 80 and non-ICU, n = 130) were prospectively included in the COVID-19 registry COMRI at the University Hospital rechts der Isar.
note: Prospective registry of SARS-CoV-2-positive patients at the Klinikum rechts der Isar, Munich; a patient cohort.

label: Placental Abruption Genetic Epidemiology study
quote: Participants of the Placental Abruption Genetic Epidemiology (PAGE) study, a population based case-control study of PA conducted in Lima, Peru, were genotyped using the Illumina HumanCore-24 BeadChip platform.
note: Case-control study of placental abruption (and preterm birth) among women delivering at Lima hospitals; environmental determinants are mentioned only generally, so it is not an exposure cohort.

label: STORK Groruddalen
quote: The STORK Groruddalen research programme: A population-based cohort study of gestational diabetes, physical activity, and obesity in pregnancy in a multiethnic population.
note: Population-based cohort of pregnant women in Groruddalen, Oslo, set up to identify predictors of gestational diabetes and fetal growth; physical activity is one of the three named subjects of the programme, which makes the exposure verdict borderline.

label: Mount Sinai COVID-19 Biobank
quote: In this study, 567 individuals (495 hospitalized with COVID-19 and 72 healthy and hospitalized controls) were enrolled in the Mount Sinai COVID-19 Biobank Study between April and June 2020 (Fig. 1).
note: Research biobank of patients hospitalised with COVID-19 in the Mount Sinai Health System, with a small group of controls.

label: Die Deutsche Diabetes Dialyse Studie
quote: Patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus, aged 18–80 years, who had received maintenance hemodialysis for less than 2 years were included by 178 dialysis centers in Germany into the 4 D study (Die Deutsche Diabetes Dialyse Studie/German Diabetes and Dialysis Study).
note: Randomised trial of atorvastatin in patients with type 2 diabetes on maintenance haemodialysis; the only exposure is a medication, which is out of scope.

label: African Descent and Glaucoma Evaluation Study
quote: The 3266 ADAGES III study participants in this report include 2146 AD POAG patients, 695 ED POAG patients, 198 AD controls and 227 ED controls.
note: Multicentre cohort of people with glaucoma, suspected glaucoma and controls of African and European descent; ADAGES III is mostly primary open-angle glaucoma patients.

label: ADMIxture and Risk of Acute Leukemia Study
quote: Children with a pathologically-verified diagnosis of B-ALL (ICD-O-3 histology 9811-9818, 9820, 9823, 9826, 9827, 9831-9837, 9940, 9948) at 0-25 years of age who identified as Black or African American from the ADMIRAL study were included.
note: Case-control study of B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukaemia in African American children and young adults, with matched newborn-blood-spot controls; genetic, not environmental, in design.

label: Amish Family Osteoporosis Study
quote: The Amish Family Osteoporosis Study (AFOS) study was designed to identify genetic determinants of osteoporosis in the Old Order Amish (OOA) population from Lancaster County, PA USA [49], [50].
note: Family study of the Old Order Amish ascertained through adults with osteoporosis, whose first-degree relatives and spouses were recruited; mostly relatives of patients, hence at risk.

label: Asian Genetic Epidemiology Network
quote: The East Asian type 2 diabetes (T2D) meta-analyses were performed with studies participating in the Asian Genetic Epidemiology Network (AGEN), a consortium of genetic epidemiology studies of T2D and related traits conducted in individuals of East Asian ancestry
note: Consortium of East Asian genetic epidemiology studies, mostly population, hospital or family cohorts, organised around type 2 diabetes and related traits; its working groups also cover blood pressure and kidney function.

label: AIDS Linked to the IntraVenous Experience
quote: The AIDS Linked to the IntraVenous Experience (ALIVE) study is a natural history study following the incidence and progression of HIV infection among intravenous drug users (IDUs) in Baltimore, MD.
note: Community cohort of current and former people who inject drugs in Baltimore, recruited for that behaviour and followed for HIV incidence and progression; injection drug use defines the cohort and makes it at risk of HIV (some participants are HIV-positive).

label: Australian Melanoma Family Study
quote: From 2001 to 2005, the authors recruited 1,164 probands including 629 cases with histopathologically confirmed, first-primary cutaneous melanoma diagnosed before age 40 years, 240 population-based controls frequency matched for age, and 295 spouse/friend controls.
note: Population-based case-control-family study of early-onset cutaneous melanoma in Australia; its design centres on genetic and environmental influences, with detailed lifetime sun exposure histories collected from probands and relatives.

label: Anxiety NeuroGenetics STudy
quote: Nine samples containing AD phenotypes from seven independent studies participating in the Anxiety NeuroGenetics STudy (ANGST) Consortium were included in the meta-analysis.
note: Consortium of seven studies (mostly population cohorts and a control sample) pooled for case-control and factor-score GWAS of interview-diagnosed anxiety disorders; classified by what it collects, anxiety disorder cases and controls.

label: Anglo-Australasian Osteoporosis Genetics Consortium
quote: To identify genes associated with osteoporosis, we have performed a genome-wide association study.
note: Postmenopausal women selected for extreme high or extreme low hip bone mineral density for a GWAS of osteoporosis; the low-BMD women are treated as cases, though the extreme-truncate design is trait-based.

label: Anakinra for Pustular Psoriasis: Response in a Controlled Trial
quote: To determine whether anakinra (an IL-1 receptor antagonist) delivers therapeutic benefit in PPP.
note: Randomised placebo-controlled trial of anakinra in adults with palmoplantar pustulosis; smoking is studied as a disease driver elsewhere but does not define this trial.

label: Assessment of Renal and Cervical Artery DysplasIA
quote: The ARCADIA registry includes women or men aged ≥18 years, with a diagnosis of renal, cervical, or intracranial artery FMD, who were prospectively recruited at 16 university hospitals in France and Belgium.
note: National French-Belgian registry of adults with fibromuscular dysplasia; a patient registry.

label: Anglo-Scandinavian Cardiac Outcomes Trial
quote: ASCOT was a prospective randomised controlled trial of two different blood pressure-lowering strategies in 19 342 hypertensive subjects with three additional risk factors for CV disease—ASCOT Blood Pressure-Lowering Arm (BPLA).
note: Randomised trial of antihypertensive and lipid-lowering treatment in hypertensive adults with further cardiovascular risk factors; participants have hypertension and are at risk of cardiovascular disease. The only exposures are medications.

label: The Ashkenazi Jewish Dataset
quote: Briefly, for the PD EPI and AJ study, PD cases were recruited from the Center for PD and Other Movement Disorders at Columbia University.
note: A Parkinson's disease case-control GWAS sample of Ashkenazi Jewish people from New York; cases have PD, and no environmental exposure defines it.

label: Assessment, Serial Evaluation, and Subsequent Sequelae of Acute Kidney Injury Study
quote: This prospective study will enroll a cohort of 1100 adult participants with a broad range of AKI and matched hospitalized participants without AKI at three Clinical Research Centers, as well as 100 children undergoing cardiac surgery at three Clinical Research Centers.
note: Hospitalised adults with acute kidney injury and matched non-AKI controls followed for kidney and cardiovascular outcomes; the 'exposure' is AKI itself, a disease, not an environmental agent.

label: Age-related diseases: Understanding Genetic and non-genetic influences - a study at the University of Regensburg
quote: The AugUR study (Age-related diseases: understanding genetic and non-genetic influences - a study at the University of Regensburg) is a prospective study from the general elderly population in and around the city of Regensburg.
note: A general-population cohort of the mobile elderly around Regensburg, set up as a platform for late-onset chronic diseases in general; broad purpose, no defining exposure.

label: Bambui (Brazil) Cohort Study of Ageing
quote: Participants were 1,450 (90.2% from total) individuals aged 60 years and over from the community-based Bambuí (Brazil) Cohort Study of Ageing.
note: A community-based census cohort of all residents aged 60+ of Bambuí, Brazil, studying health and ageing; neither exposure- nor disease-defined.

label: Biology, Affect, Stress, Imaging and Cognition study
quote: With the population-based, prospective Biology, Affect, Stress, Imaging and Cognition (BASIC) cohort, we aim to investigate the biopsychosocial aetiological processes involved in perinatal depression (PND) and to pinpoint its predictors in order to improve early detection.
note: A population-based cohort of pregnant women in Uppsala whose stated purpose is perinatal depression; no environmental exposure defines it.

label: Baltimore Breast Cancer Study
quote: The BBCS is a case control study of breast cancer designed to identify and characterize markers of disease aggressiveness and poor outcome.
note: A Baltimore breast cancer case-control study focused on markers of aggressiveness; cases have breast cancer, no environmental exposure focus.

label: Beaver Dam Eye Study
diseases: age-related macular degeneration | age-related eye disease
quote: The purpose of the BDES was to collect information on the prevalence, incidence, and potential causes or risk factors associated with AMD.
note: A population-based cohort of Beaver Dam residents aged 43-84 set up to study age-related eye disease, especially AMD; smoking is studied as a risk factor but does not define the cohort.

label: BioImage Study: A Clinical Study of Burden of Atherosclerotic Disease in an At-Risk Population
quote: The BioImage study (NCT00738725) is a multi-ethnic, observational study aimed at characterizing subclinical atherosclerosis in 6,699 US adults (55-80 years at baseline, 2008- 2009) at risk for, but without, clinical atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease.
note: Asymptomatic health-plan members selected for their risk of atherothrombotic events and imaged for subclinical atherosclerosis; no environmental exposure defines it.

label: Barbados National Cancer Study
quote: The Barbados National Cancer Study (BNCS) is a nationwide case-control study investigating environmental and genetic factors for breast cancer (BC) in a predominantly African-origin population with similar ancestry as African-Americans.
note: A nationwide case-control study of breast and prostate cancer in Barbados whose stated aim is environmental (including dietary, via a purpose-built FFQ) and genetic risk factors; the exposure verdict rests on that stated aim rather than a single defined agent.

label: Brigham and Women's Rheumatoid Arthritis Sequential Study
quote: The Brigham and Women’s Hospital Rheumatoid Arthritis Sequential Study (BRASS) is a single-center, prospective, observational cohort of over 1,300 RA patients [17].
note: A single-centre registry of rheumatoid arthritis patients in Boston; drug response is studied but medication is not an environmental exposure.

label: British Society for Surgery of the Hand Genetics of Dupuytren's Disease study
quote: The UK cohort consisted of a total of 5,408 case subjects from the BSSH-GODD Study and 9,961 population-based control subjects from the United Kingdom Household Longitudinal Study (UKHLS), which were divided into 4,891 control subjects for the discovery phase and 5,070 control subjects for the replication phase.
note: A UK collection of surgically treated Dupuytren's disease patients for genetic studies; the controls come from another study.

label: Cambridgeshire Parkinson's Incidence from GP to Neurologist
quote: The Cambridgeshire Parkinson's Incidence from GP to Neurologist (CamPaIGN) cohort comprises incident PD cases followed for up to 13 years (n = 141).
note: A population-representative incident cohort of newly diagnosed Parkinson's disease and parkinsonism in Cambridgeshire.

label: Canadian Spontaneous Coronary Artery Dissection Study
quote: We performed a multicentre, prospective, observational study of patients with non-atherosclerotic SCAD presenting acutely from 22 centres in North America.
note: A prospective cohort of patients presenting with acute spontaneous coronary artery dissection; emotional and physical stressors are recorded as precipitants but do not define the cohort.

label: Copenhagen City Heart Study
quote: The original purpose of the study was to focus on prevention of coronary heart disease and stroke.
note: An age-stratified random sample of the Copenhagen general population set up as a cardiovascular population study; other topics (including alcohol) were added later but no exposure defines it.

label: Chicago Cancer Prone Study
quote: Briefly, CCPS is a local registry of diverse high‐risk families at a hospital‐based preventive oncology clinic that has registered 5685 participants as of September 2024 since its establishment in 1992.
note: A registry of individuals and families at high risk of cancer at a Chicago preventive oncology clinic, also run as a hospital-based case-control study of breast cancer in young patients (so it includes patients too).

label: Comprehensive Sickle Cell Centers Collaborative Data Project
quote: Adult and pediatric patients with all forms of SCD at participating CSCC Centers and satellite sites were considered eligible for C-Data Project enrollment if seen within the last 24 months and were expected to return for care.
note: A multicentre observational cohort of children and adults with sickle cell disease treated at the NHLBI Comprehensive Sickle Cell Centers.

label: Cardiovascular Genome Center cohort
quote: All patients who visited the Division of Cardiology at a university hospital, for a health check-up or due to chest symptoms from January 2001 to August 2009 were included in the CGC cohort.
note: A hospital-based registry of cardiology patients at Severance Hospital, Seoul, for genetic research on coronary artery disease; some came only for check-ups, so the patient role follows from the clinic setting rather than a stated diagnosis requirement.

label: Cancer Genetic Markers of Susceptibility
quote: A new NCI initiative, Cancer Genetic Markers of Susceptibility (CGEMS), is a three-year study designed to identify common genetic variations associated with risk for prostate and breast cancer.
note: An NCI initiative running prostate and breast cancer GWAS in case-control sets drawn from existing cohorts and a case-control study; classified by the cancer cases it collects, with no exposure focus.

label: Canadian Cystic Fibrosis Gene Modifier Study
quote: The CGS patients were recruited from the Canadian population of CF patients.
note: A population-based Canadian study of people with cystic fibrosis (and their parents) to find genetic modifiers of CF lung disease and complications.

label: Center for HIV/AIDS Vaccine Immunology
quote: We analyzed PBMC values from CHAVI cohorts of acutely HIV-infected (n = 1125), chronically HIV-infected (n = 626) and HIV-negative (n = 297) participants and found that initial PBMC viabilities, yield, and processing time were equivalent (all p-values <0.001; data not shown) for all cohorts.
note: An NIAID HIV vaccine consortium whose clinical and host-genetics cohorts are mostly people with acute or chronic HIV-1 infection; it is defined by infection (disease), not by exposure among the uninfected.

label: Chinese Keratoconus Cohort Study
quote: The CKC cohort is hospital-based and dynamic and was established in Zhengzhou, China; KC patients (n = 1114) from a large geographical area were enrolled from January 2019 to June 2023, with a mean age of 22.23 years (6‒57 years).
note: A hospital-based cohort of keratoconus patients in Zhengzhou; its 'environment' factors are eye rubbing, atopy and BMI, which are not environmental agents in scope.

label: Chronic Kidney Disease in Children Study
quote: The CKiD Study is an ongoing cohort of children, adolescents, and young adults with a diagnosis of CKD in the United States and Canada with participants enrolled between ages 0.5 and 16 years starting in 2005.
note: A North American prospective cohort of children with chronic kidney disease followed for progression and its effects.

label: UCLA Consortium for Neuropsychiatric Phenomics
quote: The CNP sample additionally included smaller groups of people who had diagnoses of schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, and attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (following DSM-IV), to determine where these individuals’ scores would fall with respect to the distributions observed in healthy individuals.
note: A UCLA sample of mostly healthy community adults plus patient groups with schizophrenia, bipolar disorder and ADHD, studied dimensionally for links to these illnesses; the disease verdict rests on the recruited patient groups, though healthy volunteers are the majority.

label: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease in Dusty Areas
quote: The cohort was composed of subjects with airflow limitation and healthy volunteers who agreed to undergo examination.
note: Residents of cement-plant districts in South Korea, with COPD or airflow limitation and normal-spirometry volunteers, followed for COPD outcomes under cement dust exposure; residence near the plants defines the exposure.

label: Cohort in Lung Transplantation
diseases: chronic lung allograft dysfunction | chronic obstructive pulmonary disease
quote: The recipients were 48 years-old at transplantation on average, 45% women, and the main underlying disease was chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (45%).
note: A French-Belgian cohort of lung transplant candidates (with end-stage lung disease, mostly COPD) and their donors, set up to predict chronic lung allograft dysfunction; air pollution was studied in a sub-project only, so no exposure verdict.

label: Cooperative Study of Sickle Cell Disease
quote: The Cooperative Study of Sickle Cell Disease was initiated in 1977 to determine the natural history of sickle cell disease (SCD) from birth to death in order to identify those factors contributing to the morbidity and mortality of the disease.
note: A US multicentre natural-history study that enrolled patients with sickle cell disease, so a patient cohort; no environmental exposure defines or drives the design.

label: Dallas Heart Study
quote: Thus, the Dallas Heart Study provides a phenotypically well-characterized probability sample for multidisciplinary research that will be used to improve the mechanistic understanding and prevention of cardiovascular disease, especially in black Americans.
note: A population-based probability sample of Dallas County residents designed to study ethnic differences in cardiovascular health, so a population study of cardiovascular disease; exposures are not its design purpose.

label: Danish Testicular Cancer Late Treatment Effects Cohort
quote: The cohort was set up in order to analyze late effects in long-term testicular cancer survivors (TCS) and to contribute to the design of future follow-up programs addressing and potentially preventing late effects.
note: A nationwide Danish cohort of testicular cancer survivors studied for late treatment effects; the only exposure is cancer treatment, which is out of scope.

label: Drakenstein Child Health Study
quote: We describe a unique multidisciplinary South African birth cohort, the Drakenstein Child Health Study (DCHS), to investigate the incidence, risk factors, aetiology and long-term impact of early lower respiratory tract infection (LRTI) on child health.
note: A population-based South African birth cohort built to study early lower respiratory tract infection; environmental exposures (measured with home monitors) are one of seven risk-factor domains rather than the stated design purpose, so exposure is judged no, though it is borderline.

label: Dental Strategies Concentrating on Risk Evaluation
quote: The fourth cohort (Dental SCORE, n = 548) is a subset of a larger project, Heart SCORE, which is an ongoing cardiovascular disease study of 2,000 middle aged White and African Americans in the Pittsburgh region of Pennsylvania [17].
note: A dental-examination subgroup of Heart SCORE, a community-based cardiovascular disease study of Pittsburgh adults; participants were not selected for disease or exposure, so it is a population study of cardiovascular disease with dental phenotyping.

label: Diabetes Gene Discovery Group
quote: Stage 1: Inclusion criteria for cases were (i) T2DM according to 1997 American Diabetes Association (ADA) criteria1 ; (ii) family history of diabetes in first degree relatives; (iii) BMI < 30 kg/m².
note: A French type 2 diabetes case-control GWAS sample whose cases were selected for type 2 diabetes; no environmental exposure is involved.

label: Diabetes Multi-omic Investigation of Drug Response
quote: Patients in the discovery set were adult, African American participants from the Diabetes Multi-omic Investigation of Drug Response (DIAMOND), a cohort study of patients with T2D from a health system serving southeast Michigan.
note: A cohort of type 2 diabetes patients in a Michigan health system studied for drug response; medication response is not an environmental exposure.

label: Detroit Neighborhood Health Study
quote: The primary objective of the DNHS was to examine how biological variation, stressful and traumatic life experiences, and environmental factors contribute to the prediction of psychopathology and behavior.
note: A population-based Detroit cohort whose stated objective is psychopathology, chiefly PTSD and depression; the exposures studied are traumatic and stressful life experiences and social adversity rather than an environmental agent, so exposure is judged no.

label: Endometrial Cancer Association Consortium
quote: For the iCOGS genotyping stage, 4,330 women with a confirmed diagnosis of endometrial cancer and European ancestry were recruited via 11 studies in Western Europe, North America and Australia, collectively called the Endometrial Cancer Association Consortium (ECAC).
note: A consortium of endometrial cancer case-control studies, classified by its cases; no environmental exposure defines it.

label: European Challenge for Healthy Aging
quote: A total of 234 trios composed by one centenarian, his/her child and a child of his/her concordant or discordant sib were collected.
note: A European family study of longevity recruiting nonagenarians and centenarians with relatives; longevity is a trait, not a disease, and environmental factors are mentioned only in passing.

label: Pittsburgh Epidemiology of Diabetes Complications Study
quote: The EDC study is a prospective cohort study of 933 participants with childhood-onset (aged <17 years) type 1 diabetes diagnosed at Children's Hospital of Pittsburgh from 1950 to 1980.
note: A prospective cohort of people with childhood-onset type 1 diabetes followed for complications; no environmental exposure is involved.

label: Scottish AMD study
quote: The common functional polymorphism rs2230199 (Arg80Gly) in the C3 gene, corresponding to the electrophoretic variants C3S (slow) and C3F (fast), was strongly associated with age-related macular degeneration in both the English group (603 cases and 350 controls, P=5.9x10(-5)) and the Scottish group (244 cases and 351 controls, P=5.0x10(-5)).
note: A Scottish clinic-based case-control study of age-related macular degeneration, classified by its cases; no environmental exposure defines it.

label: Estudo Longitudinal de Saúde do Adulto
quote: Thus, the Brazilian Longitudinal Study of Adult Health (in Portuguese, ‘Estudo Longitudinal de Saúde do Adulto’, ELSA-Brasil) aims to investigate the development of chronic diseases, primarily diabetes and cardiovascular diseases, over a long-term follow-up.
note: A cohort of Brazilian university and research-institute employees whose stated aim is chronic disease, primarily diabetes and cardiovascular disease, so a population study of those diseases (borderline with a broad chronic-disease purpose); civil servants were not chosen for an environmental exposure.

label: Epidemiology of Burkitt Lymphoma in East African Children and Minors
quote: EMBLEM is a case control study of childhood Burkitt lymphoma (BL) designed to investigate risk factors of BL in malaria-endemic areas of Uganda, Tanzania, and Kenya.
note: A case-control study of childhood Burkitt lymphoma in malaria-endemic East Africa, classified by its cases; infections are studied as risk factors of the disease, but participants were selected by disease status, not by exposure.

label: Essen-Heidelberg
quote: Essen-Heidelberg, Germany Histologically confirmed cutaneous melanoma cases (N = 1,218) were genotyped using the Illumina HumanCytoSNP-12v1-0_D arrays (San Diego, CA, USA).
note: A German melanoma case-control GWAS sample of histologically confirmed cutaneous melanoma cases and healthy controls; no environmental exposure defines it.

label: FActeurs de RIsque et de récidives de la maladie thromboembolique Veineuse
quote: The French FARIVE study recruited patients with confirmed acute VTE, with controls recruited from hospital patients treated for non-VTE causes.
note: A French multicentre case-control study of first venous thromboembolism, classified by its cases; no environmental exposure defines it.

label: European/International Fibromuscular Dysplasia Registry and Initiative
quote: All patients diagnosed with FMD (string-of-beads or focal stenosis in at least one vascular bed) based on computed tomography angiography, magnetic resonance angiography, and/or catheter-based angiography were eligible.
note: A European/international registry of patients with fibromuscular dysplasia; no environmental exposure is involved.

label: FinDonor 10 000 study
quote: A total of 2584 blood donors (N = 8003 samples) were recruited into the study alongside standard donation at three donation sites in the capital region of Finland between 5/2015 and 12/2017.
note: A cohort of Finnish whole-blood donors set up to study iron status and iron stores; donors are healthy volunteers, iron status is a trait and blood donation is not an environmental exposure, so both verdicts are no.

label: National FinHealth 2017 Study
quote: The national FinHealth 2017 study comprises a random sample of adults in Finland, and it focuses on objective and perceived health, quality of life, lifestyle, prevalence, and risk factors for common health problems including sleep, insomnia, and alcohol consumption.
note: A national health examination survey of a random sample of Finnish adults with a broad health-monitoring purpose; neither an exposure nor a disease defines it.

label: FinnTwin12 Cohort
quote: The basic aim of the FT12 study design was to obtain information on individual, familial and school/neighborhood risks for substance use/abuse prior to the onset of regular tobacco and alcohol use and then track trajectories of use and abuse and their consequences into adulthood.
note: A population-based Finnish twin birth cohort whose stated basic aim is the risks and trajectories of tobacco, alcohol and other substance use and abuse, so its main subject is lifestyle exposure and it is a population study of substance abuse.

label: Finnish Twin Study on Aging
quote: The FITSA was set up to investigate genetic and environmental effects on the disablement process in older female twins.
note: A study of older female twin pairs from the Older Finnish Twin Cohort on the disablement process of ageing; ageing and physical functioning are not diseases and environmental effects are mentioned only generically.

label: Follow-up of Ovarian Cancer Genetic Association and Interaction Studies
quote: FOCI seeks to expand our understanding of epithelial ovarian cancer through a coordinated and comprehensive approach.
note: A post-GWAS programme pooling the ovarian cancer case-control studies of the Ovarian Cancer Association Consortium, classified by its cases; gene-environment interaction is one aim among many, not an exposure design.

label: Marburg-Münster Affective Disorders Cohort Study
diseases: major depressive disorder | bipolar disorder | schizoaffective disorder | schizophrenia
quote: A human cohort of MP patients, healthy subjects at genetic and/or environmental risk, and control subjects (N = 2500) has been established.
note: The FOR2107 cohort of patients with major psychoses (MDD, bipolar disorder, schizoaffective disorder, schizophrenia), at-risk subjects and controls; environmental risk is one of several selection criteria for a minority of healthy subjects and no specific environmental agent defines the cohort, so exposure is no.

label: Genes and Blood Clotting Study
quote: A total of 1189 healthy individuals (ages 14-35) representing 507 sibships (with 2-6 siblings per family) from the University of Michigan, Ann Arbor, were recruited between June 26, 2006, and January 30, 2009.
note: A family-based sample of healthy young University of Michigan students and their siblings recruited to study genetic variation in blood clotting proteins; healthy volunteers, no exposure or disease focus.

label: Genetic Analysis of Psoriasis Consortium
quote: We combined three existing GWAS datasets (hereafter referred to as Kiel3, CASP4 and WTCCC25) with two independent European-descent case-control datasets genotyped on the Immunochip: the Psoriasis Association Genetics Extension (PAGE: 3,580 cases and 5,902 controls) and the Genetic Analysis of Psoriasis Consortium (GAPC: 2,997 cases and 9,183 controls)
note: An international consortium pooling collections of people with psoriasis vulgaris with controls for genetic association studies, classified by its cases; no environmental exposure is involved.

label: Ghana Breast Health Study
quote: We therefore conducted a population-based case-control study in Accra and Kumasi, Ghana, enrolling 2,202 women with lesions suspicious for breast cancer and 2,161 population controls.
note: Population-based breast cancer case-control study in Ghana; cases are women with suspected or treated breast cancer. Exposures such as mosquito-control products were analysed later but are not the design basis.

label: GenomALC
quote: we are recruiting high-risk drinkers who are either cases (with alcoholic cirrhosis) or controls (drinking comparable amounts over similar time, but free of significant liver disease).
note: Case-control GWAS of alcohol-related cirrhosis in which every participant was recruited as a long-term heavy drinker; cases have alcoholic cirrhosis.

label: Melanoma Genetics Consortium
quote: Our discovery phase included 2,981 individuals with melanoma and 1,982 study-specific control individuals of European ancestry, as well as an additional 6,426 control subjects from French or British populations, all of whom were genotyped for 317,000 or 610,000 single-nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs).
note: Consortium of familial melanoma genetics groups pooling melanoma cases, melanoma-prone families (including unaffected CDKN2A carriers, at risk) and controls. Gene-UV interaction is one listed aim but the design centres on genetics, so exposure is no.

label: GENetics of SEPsis-induced ARDS Network
quote: GEN-SEP is a multicentre, observational study conducted in a Spanish network of ICUs comprising adult patients with all-cause sepsis of European ancestry recruited in two periods (in 2002-2015 and in 2016-2019) (Hernandez-Beeftink et al., 2022).
note: ICU cohort of adult sepsis patients followed for ARDS and survival; all participants have sepsis.

label: Genetics of Early Onset Stroke Study
quote: The Genetics of Early Onset Stroke Study is a population-based case-control study designed to identify genetic determinants of early-onset arterial ischemic stroke and to characterize interactions with environmental risk factors.
note: Population-based case-control study of first ischaemic stroke at ages 15-49 in the Baltimore-Washington area; environmental risk factors are secondary to the genetic aim.

label: Genetics of Osteoarthritis Consortium
quote: Here, we conduct a genome-wide association study meta-analysis across 826,690 individuals (177,517 with osteoarthritis) and identify 100 independently associated risk variants across 11 osteoarthritis phenotypes, 52 of which have not been associated with the disease before.
note: Consortium meta-analysing osteoarthritis case-control GWAS from its contributing cohorts and biobanks; it collects osteoarthritis cases.

label: Genetics of Childhood Cancer Treatment
diseases: childhood cancer | osteosarcoma | medulloblastoma | low-grade glioma
quote: The GO-CAT cohort is a multinational retrospective cohort of pediatric cancer patients, treated between 1975 and 2020.
note: Retrospective cohort of paediatric cancer patients for pharmacogenetics; the platinum chemotherapy is a treatment, not an environmental exposure.

label: Genetic Origin of Dupuytren Disease and Associated Fibromatosis study
quote: For the GODDAF study, case subjects were identified from plastic surgery clinics within the Netherlands, and DNA and phenotype data were obtained as previously described.
note: Dutch case collection of Dupuytren disease patients from surgery clinics for genetic studies.

label: Genetics of Impulsivity project
quote: Participants were 1252 young adults (62 % female) with low levels of addictive behavior, who were assessed in individual laboratory rooms at the University of Chicago and the University of Georgia.
note: Healthy young adults with low substance use studied for the genetics of impulsivity, a trait; neither exposure- nor disease-defined.

label: Genetics of Latinos Diabetic Retinopathy
quote: The GOLDR study is a family-based study assessing diabetes and diabetic complications in families (siblings and/or parents) of a proband, defined as having type 2 diabetes and either known DR or a diabetes duration of ≥10 years.
note: Family-based study of Latinos ascertained through probands with type 2 diabetes and diabetic retinopathy or long diabetes duration.

label: Global Parkinson's Genetics Program
quote: For the most part, GP2 will use existing or ongoing patient and cohort collections and will work with established PD consortia; however, in some instances GP2 will support the collection of additional patients, particularly from underserved communities.
note: Worldwide programme genotyping Parkinson's disease patients (with some controls) from existing and new collections; it collects Parkinson's disease cases.

label: Genomic Research on Asthma in the African Diaspora
quote: These subjects comprised the consortium for ‘Genomic Research on Asthma in the African Diaspora’ (GRAAD) and represent eight separate, NIH-funded studies of asthma in pediatric and adult African American populations, plus one study on healthy African Americans.
note: Asthma case-control collection of African Americans in the Baltimore-Washington area assembled from asthma studies.

label: Genomic Research in Alpha-1 Antitrypsin Deficiency and Sarcoidosis Study
quote: The Genomic Research in Alpha-1 Antitrypsin Deficiency and Sarcoidosis (GRADS) study is an observational cohort study designed to explore the role of the lung microbiome and genome in these two diseases.
note: Observational study enrolling adults with sarcoidosis and adults with PiZZ/PiMZ alpha-1 antitrypsin genotypes; the lung microbiome is studied as biology, not as an environmental exposure.

label: Genomics of Resistance to Immunodeficiency Virus
quote: The GRIV cohort was collected in France based on the LTNP phenotype, defined as documented infection for more than 8 years, maintaining a T lymphocyte count above 500/mm3, and no clinical symptoms (29).
note: DNA collection of HIV-1-infected long-term non-progressors and rapid progressors in France; the infection is the disease defining the cohort, so it is not an exposed-uninfected exposure cohort.

label: Guangzhou Twin Eye Study
quote: The primary aim of the Guangzhou Twin Eye Study (GTES) is to explore the impact that genes and environmental inﬂuences have on common eye diseases.
note: Longitudinal study of population-registry twins aged 7-15 whose stated primary aim is common eye diseases, particularly myopia; environmental influences are mentioned generically, not as a defined exposure.

label: Guangzhou cohort
quote: A genome-wide association study meta-analysis was conducted in totalling 2644 Chinese individuals from 3 cohorts: the Guangzhou cohort (GZ, 537 high myopes and 151 hyperopes), Wenzhou cohort (334 high myopes and 6 hyperopes) and Guangzhou Twin Eye Study (1051 participants with normally distributed AL).
note: Extreme-phenotype collection of high myopes and hyperopes in Guangzhou; participants were selected for refractive error.

label: Guangzhou Colorectal Cancer Study
quote: Cases were histopathologically confirmed patients with CRC recruited from Sun Yat-Sen University Cancer Center between January 2002 and January 2012 and controls were cancer-free men and women recruited from the physical examination centers of several large hospitals in Guangdong during the same time period.
note: Hospital-based colorectal cancer case-control study in Guangzhou genotyped for GWAS.

label: Hemophilia Growth and Development Study
quote: Sixty-nine percent (n = 333) of a population of males between the ages of 6 and 19 years with moderate to severe hemophilia participated in a comprehensive baseline examination.
note: Longitudinal study of boys with hemophilia, most HIV-infected through clotting factor concentrates, studying the impact of HIV; HIV acquired through treatment is a disease here, not an environmental exposure.

label: Hordaland Health Study
quote: The Hordaland Health Study (HUSK) is a community-based study in Western Norway conducted as a collaboration between the University of Bergen, the Norwegian Health Screening Service and the Municipal Health Service in Hordaland (https://husk-en.w.uib.no/)53.
note: Community-based health study of Hordaland residents invited by birth year, covering chronic diseases broadly; neither exposure- nor single-disease-defined.

label: Hong Kong Children Eye Study
diseases: eye disorders | refractive error | strabismus | amblyopia
quote: The HKCES was designed to determine the occurrence and development of eye disorders, including refractive errors, strabismus, amblyopia, and allergic disease, and to identify their environmental and genetic determinants11–13.
note: Population-based school-children cohort whose stated purpose is eye disorders; environmental determinants are named generically, not a defined exposure.

label: Hong Kong Diabetes Biobank
quote: NT-proBNP was measured in 1993 samples from the Hong Kong Diabetes Biobank, a multicentre prospective diabetes cohort and biobank.
note: Multicentre prospective cohort and biobank of adults with diabetes attending hospital diabetes centres in Hong Kong.

label: Healthy Zhejiang One Million People Cohort
quote: The HOPE Cohort is a newly established community-based prospective cohort enrolling participants from both urban and rural areas in Zhejiang Province, China.
note: New community-based prospective population cohort in Zhejiang; no exposure or disease basis stated.

label: Health and Prevention Enhancement
quote: The Health and Prevention Enhancement (H-PEACE) study was designed to investigate the association of diagnostic imaging results, biomarkers and the predisease stage of non-communicable diseases (NCDs), such as malignancies and metabolic diseases, in an average-risk population in Korea.
note: Retrospective cohort of health check-up examinees at a Seoul hospital, an average-risk population studied for non-communicable diseases broadly.

label: Initiative on Nephropathy, of relevance to public health, which is Chronic, possibly in its Initial stages, and carries a Potential risk of major clinical End-points
quote: INCIPE is a general, Caucasian-only population cohort that was enrolled in 2006 to determine the prevalence of chronic kidney disease (CKD) in North-Eastern Italy [10].
note: Random general-population sample of adults aged 40+ in Veneto set up to study chronic kidney disease prevalence and risk factors.

label: International Stuttering Project
quote: Formed in 2020, the ISP continues to collate global outbred populations of people who stutter, specifically to illuminate genetic etiology and broaden investigations of its diverse and variable phenotype.
note: Collection of clinically ascertained people with developmental stuttering, a speech disorder, for genetic studies.

label: INTERHEART study
quote: We established a standardised case-control study of acute myocardial infarction in 52 countries, representing every inhabited continent.
note: INTERHEART is a 52-country case-control study of first acute myocardial infarction whose cases are MI patients; its main subject is modifiable risk factors including smoking, diet, alcohol and physical activity, so it counts as designed to study lifestyle exposures, though these sit alongside clinical risk factors.

label: International Tuberculosis Host Genetics Consortium
quote: The ITHGC includes 12 case–control GWAS from nine countries in Europe, Africa, and Asia (total of 14,153 pulmonary TB cases and 19,536 healthy controls).
note: A consortium of tuberculosis case-control GWAS studying host genetic susceptibility; its members are defined by TB disease, not by exposure to the infection.

label: Indiana University-Purdue University Indianapolis cohort
quote: The IUPUI sample includes 3D images and genotypic data from individuals recruited in Indianapolis, IN and Twinsburg, OH (IUPUI IRB 1409306349).
note: Volunteers recruited for 3D facial imaging and genotyping to study normal facial variation and other visible traits; neither exposure- nor disease-defined.

label: International Warfarin Pharmacogenetics Consortium
quote: In particular, we have helped create the International Warfarin Pharmacogenetics Consortium (IWPC), which is devoted to pooling genotype and phenotype data relevant to the anticoagulant warfarin.
note: A pharmacogenetics consortium pooling data on warfarin-treated patients to model warfarin dose; the defining feature is a medication, which is out of scope for exposure, and the patients are not selected for one disease.

label: Karolinska Breast Cancer Study
quote: We included 3215 invasive breast cancer cases from two Swedish cohorts, KARMA (n = 2712) and KARBAC (n = 503), and controls without family history of breast cancer from KARMA (n = 5032) in the analysis.
note: A Stockholm breast cancer case-control study of inherited susceptibility whose cases are breast cancer patients; no exposure focus.

label: Korea National Cancer Center gastric cancer case-control study
quote: This case-control study was conducted at the Center for Gastric Cancer (CGC) and the Center for Cancer Prevention & Detection (CCPD) of the National Cancer Center (NCC) in Korea between March 2011 and December 2014.
note: A hospital-based gastric cancer case-control study at the Korean National Cancer Center; cases are gastric cancer patients, and the study collects food-frequency data used chiefly for diet-gene studies of gastric cancer, so diet is a main subject.

label: Korea-NCC (National Cancer Center) Colorectal Cancer Study
quote: Data from the Korean-National Cancer Center CRC Study (Korea validation set: a case-control study including 622 cases and 832 controls)
note: A hospital-based colorectal cancer case-control study at the Korean National Cancer Center; cases are CRC patients, and it collects food-frequency data used for diet-gene studies, though its genetic role in the Asia Colorectal Cancer Consortium is equally prominent, so the exposure verdict is medium.

label: Low Concentration Atropine for Myopia Progression Study
quote: children aged 4 to 12 years with a myopic refractive error of at least –1.0 diopter (D) in both eyes, astigmatism of <2.5 D, and documented myopic progression of ≥0.5 D in the previous year were enrolled in the LAMP trial.
note: A randomised trial of low-concentration atropine eye drops in children with progressing myopia; participants have myopia, and the intervention is a medication, not an environmental exposure.

label: Leipzig Childhood Obesity cohort
quote: In this study, we adopt a comprehensive approach to describe the transition of children and adolescents with overweight or obesity into adulthood from an obesity center in Germany.
note: A cohort of children and adolescents with overweight or obesity recruited through the Leipzig paediatric obesity clinic; obesity counts as a disease here.

label: Lung Oncology Research & Discovery
quote: LORD consists of a single site case-only cohort based on a 20-year data collection (1999–2021) of patients who underwent lung cancer surgery at IUCPQ-UL.
note: A case-only cohort of lung cancer surgery patients in Quebec City; smoking is analysed but the cohort is defined by disease, not exposure.

label: Multicenter AIDS Cohort Study
quote: The Multicenter AIDS Cohort Study was designed to elucidate the natural history of the infection causing acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS), identify risk factors for occurrence and clinical expression of the infection, and establish a repository of biologic specimens for future study.
note: A cohort of gay and bisexual men with and without HIV-1 infection, recruited as a risk group to study the natural history of HIV infection and AIDS; the mix of infected and at-risk men is recorded as at risk. HIV infection is a disease here, not an environmental exposure.

label: Manchester Lung Health Check
quote: In Manchester, we developed a community-based ‘Lung Health Check’ (LHC) approach to target high-risk smokers in deprived areas.
note: A community lung cancer screening programme that invites ever-smokers and screens those at high risk; smokers recruited as smokers make it an exposure cohort, and it is at risk for lung cancer.

label: Mayo Vascular Disease Biorepository
quote: The Vascular Disease Biorepository at Mayo Clinic was established to archive DNA, plasma, and serum from patients with suspected AVD.
note: An EMR-linked biorepository of Mayo Clinic patients referred for vascular evaluation with known or suspected atherosclerotic vascular disease; no exposure focus.

label: Manchester Cancer Research Centre Biobank
quote: The Biobank will collect tissue, blood and other samples from patients admitted to hospitals in the Greater Manchester area, who are undergoing an operation to remove tissue where cancer is a possible diagnosis.
note: A cancer research tissue bank collecting samples from surgical patients in whom cancer is a possible diagnosis; it serves cancer research and has no exposure focus.

label: MELARISK study
quote: The MELARISK study comprised of 1,244 European-ancestry melanoma cases who were recruited through a nationwide network of French Dermatology Departments and Oncogenetic clinics between 1992 and 2011.
note: A French collection of melanoma patients recruited for genetic susceptibility studies; risk-factor questionnaires are collected but exposure is not the design purpose.

label: Multicenter Hemophilia Cohort Studies
quote: The first Multicenter Hemophilia Cohort Study (MHCS-I) evaluated and prospectively followed patients with hemophilia or a related coagulation disorder.
note: NCI cohorts of people with hemophilia or related coagulation disorders followed for HIV, HCV and HBV infection; participants are selected for a disease, not for an environmental exposure.

label: Myeloma XI trial
quote: We aimed to assess lenalidomide maintenance versus observation in patients with newly diagnosed multiple myeloma, including cytogenetic risk and transplantation status subgroup analyses.
note: A UK phase 3 treatment trial for newly diagnosed multiple myeloma; participants are patients and the interventions are medications.

label: MRC Myeloma IX trial
quote: In the MRC Myeloma IX trial, adult patients of age 18 years or older who had newly diagnosed and histologically confirmed symptomatic multiple myeloma were enrolled from 120 centres in the UK.
note: A UK MRC randomised treatment trial for newly diagnosed multiple myeloma; participants are patients and the interventions are medications.

label: Mexican Genomic Database for Addiction Research
quote: A subsample of 1728 individuals from the Mexican Genomic Database for Addiction Research (MxGDAR/Encodat) was analyzed.
note: A genomic subsample of the Mexican national household survey on tobacco, alcohol and drug use, assembled for addiction research: a population sample whose main subject is substance use, hence an exposure cohort and a population study of addiction.

label: Nicotine Addiction Genetics Finland study
quote: To investigate the impact of common and low‐frequency variants on three distinct measures of nicotine addiction—smoking quantity, ND and NW—we conducted a GWAS in 1715 participants from the Finnish twin family study.
note: Finnish twin pairs concordant for ever-smoking, enriched for heavy smokers, and their relatives, recruited to study nicotine dependence: smokers recruited as smokers, and at risk of nicotine addiction.

label: Netherlands Study of Cognition, Environment and Genes
quote: Participants volunteered in the Netherlands Study of Cognition, Environment and Genes (NESCOG), which comprises a general population sample (sample 1) and a genetically informative, family-based sample (sample 2).
note: A Dutch general-population and twin-family sample of volunteers studying individual differences in cognition; environmental factors are only questionnaire items and the disorder focus is broad, so neither verdict applies.

label: UK Nephropathy Family Study and Oxford Regional Prospective Study
quote: Serially collected samples for A1C measurement were available for 1,232 subjects with childhood-onset type 1 diabetes recruited to the Oxford Regional Prospective Study and the Nephropathy Family Study.
note: A combined sample of two English cohorts of young people with childhood-onset type 1 diabetes, used for genetic studies of diabetic kidney disease; participants are patients.

label: Nephropathy Family Study
quote: The study population was composed of young people with type 1 diabetes and their parents recruited in the Nephropathy Family Study (NFS).
note: A longitudinal study of adolescents with type 1 diabetes and their parents, followed for the early pathogenesis of microalbuminuria; participants are patients, with no exposure focus.

label: Nigerian Breast Cancer Study
quote: The NBCS started enrolling women with breast cancer (hereafter cases) and women without breast cancer (hereafter controls) in Nigeria in 1998 and, in 2011, enrollment was extended to Cameroon and Uganda using the same questionnaire and protocol.
note: A breast cancer case-control study in Nigeria, later Cameroon and Uganda, whose cases are breast cancer patients; it studies general epidemiological and inherited risk factors without an exposure design focus.

label: National Joint Registry
quote: The DDH samples were identified from the National Joint Registry cohort, which at the time included 5 411 adult individuals living in England who had undergone a hip replacement surgery for DDH.
note: A national registry of joint replacement procedures and implants; patients enter because of a surgical procedure, which is out of scope for exposure, and the registry is not defined by one disease, although diseased subsets (e.g. DDH) have been drawn from it.

label: National Psoriasis Victor Henschel BioBank
quote: For the PsA GWAS, 1,526 PsA case subjects and 1,508 unaffected control subjects North American (American and Canadian population) were recruited by four collection centers—Michigan, Toronto, Newfoundland, and the National Psoriasis Foundation.
note: A National Psoriasis Foundation biobank of people with psoriasis or psoriatic arthritis and unaffected controls, used as cases in case-control GWAS; no environmental exposure defines it.

label: National Survey of Physical Traits
note: A population-based cohort of Han Chinese volunteers studied for physical traits (face, ear, fingerprints) and multi-omics; traits are out of scope and no disease or exposure defines it.

label: New York Genome Center ALS Consortium
quote: Here we present the full NYGC ALS Consortium dataset, comprising WGS on 4,746 donors and RNA-seq from 8 major brain and spinal cord tissues from a cohort of 695 individuals presenting with ALS, other neurological diseases, and non-neurological controls.
note: A consortium resource of blood and post-mortem tissue from ALS patients (with some other neurological disease and control donors); a disease cohort of patients.

label: NZ AAA Genetics Study
quote: NZ AAA Genetics Study: The Vascular Research Consortium of New Zealand recruited New Zealand men and women with a proven history of AAA (infra-renal aortic diameter ≥ 30 mm proven on ultrasound or CT scan).
note: A New Zealand case-control study of abdominal aortic aneurysm; cases are AAA patients.

label: Pancreatic Cancer Case-Control Consortium
quote: We analyzed data from 12 case-control studies within the International Pancreatic Cancer Case-Control Consortium (PanC4), including 6507 pancreatic cases and 12 890 controls.
note: A consortium of pancreatic cancer case-control studies, so a disease aggregation of patients; it analyses smoking and alcohol among other risk factors, but no exposure defines the consortium or its members.

label: UPenn Local TGCT Study
quote: Cases were 277 white, non-Hispanic men with pathologically defined TGCT seen at the University of Pennsylvania Health System (UPHS) or Fox Chase Cancer Center (FCCC) in Philadelphia, PA.
note: A Philadelphia case-control study of genetic susceptibility to testicular germ cell tumour; cases are TGCT patients.

label: Phenotype, Genotype & Biomarkers in ALS and Related Disorders
diseases: amyotrophic lateral sclerosis | primary lateral sclerosis | progressive muscular atrophy | hereditary spastic paraplegia
quote: The PGB study enrolled 705 patients with ALS (n = 472), primary lateral sclerosis (n = 47), progressive muscular atrophy (n = 20), hereditary spastic paraplegia (n = 162) and other related disorders (n = 4).
note: A CReATe Consortium longitudinal observational study of patients with ALS and related disorders (and some family members).

label: PLATelet inhibition and patient Outcomes
quote: The PLATO trial recruited 18 624 patients with acute coronary syndrome (with or without ST elevation) from 862 centres in 43 countries between October 2006 and July 2008.
note: A randomised trial of ticagrelor versus clopidogrel in patients with acute coronary syndrome; the only exposure is a medication, which is out of scope.

label: Pustular Psoriasis, Elucidating Underlying Mechanisms
quote: The UK dataset included 288 affected individuals of European descent, who were recruited in specialist dermatology centers as part of the APRICOT clinical trial4 and its sister study PLUM.
note: A UK mechanistic study recruiting people with pustular psoriasis (with disease controls, healthy volunteers and relatives); smoking is studied as a risk factor but does not define the cohort.

label: Primary Open-Angle African American Glaucoma Genetics Study
quote: Of the 2520 African Americans recruited to the POAAGG study to date, 2067 (82.0%), including 807 controls and 1260 POAG cases, met all inclusion criteria and completed the detailed clinical ocular examination.
note: A case-control genetic study of primary open-angle glaucoma in African Americans in Philadelphia; cases are glaucoma patients.

label: Project MinE
quote: Project MinE seeks to obtain sequencing data in 15,000 ALS patients and 7,500 matched controls with the aim of identifying new loci associated to ALS risk, fine-map known and novel loci, and provide a publicly-available summary-level dataset that will enable further genetic research of this and other diseases.
note: An international whole-genome sequencing consortium of ALS patients and matched controls; a disease aggregation of patients.

label: Pulmonary Hypertension and the Hypoxic Response in Sickle Cell Disease
quote: A prospective multicenter study of 310 patients aged 3-20 years old with sickle cell disease under basal conditions and 54 matched controls was conducted.
note: A multicentre observational study of children and adolescents with sickle cell disease (with matched controls), designed to find predictors of pulmonary hypertension and other cardiopulmonary complications.

label: Queen Square Brain Bank for Neurological Disorders
diseases: neurodegenerative disease | Parkinson's disease | progressive supranuclear palsy | multiple system atrophy
quote: The Queen Square Brain Bank for Neurological Disorders (QSBB) is an archive of brains and tissue from individuals with neurodegenerative disease and neurologically normal controls.
note: A UK brain bank of donors with neurological, mostly neurodegenerative, diseases plus normal controls; a tissue bank of patients.

label: Genome-Wide Association Study on Calcific Aortic Valve Stenosis in Quebec
quote: The GWAS includes 1009 severe cases of tricuspid CAVS confirmed at surgery and 1017 ethnically matched controls with normal aortic valve that underwent cardiac surgery (QUEBEC-CAVS cohort).
note: A Quebec case-control study of calcific aortic valve stenosis in patients undergoing valve replacement, with surgical controls.

label: REDS-III Brazil Sickle Cell Disease Cohort
quote: The Brazil programme is the only programme within REDS-III to establish a SCD cohort in order to characterize health outcomes (including transfusion outcomes) in patients with SCD.
note: A multi-centre Brazilian cohort of children and adults with sickle cell disease within REDS-III; transfusion is a treatment, not an environmental exposure.

label: Raine Eye Health Study
quote: The Raine Eye Health Study (REHS) was conceived to determine the prevalence of and risk factors for eye disease in young adults, and to characterize ocular biometric parameters in a young adult cohort.
note: The 20-year eye follow-up of the Raine birth cohort, an unselected population sample whose stated purpose is one disease family, eye disease (with ocular biometry).

label: Racial Variability in Genotypic Determinants of Breast Cancer Risk Study
quote: RVGBC is a hospital-based case-control study conducted in Philadelphia and Detroit metropolitan areas from 1999 to 2003.
note: A hospital-based breast cancer case-control study in Philadelphia and Detroit, member of the ROOT consortium; cases are breast cancer patients.

label: Genome-Wide Association Study of Adiposity in Samoans
quote: The research goal of this study is to identify genetic variation that increases susceptibility to obesity and cardiometabolic phenotypes among adult Samoans using genome-wide association (GWAS) methods.
note: A population-based cross-sectional sample of Samoan adults whose stated purpose is genetic susceptibility to obesity and cardiometabolic phenotypes; diet and activity are measured but are not the design purpose.

label: Sanford Biobank
quote: The biobank cohort includes participants aged ≥18 years from the Sanford Health system who elected to provide a specimen to the Sanford Biobank for research purposes, starting in 2011.
note: A hospital-based biobank of adult Sanford Health patients who volunteered specimens, not selected for a disease or exposure; used for studies such as coronary artery disease.

label: Salvador-SCAALA study
quote: Study designs used include surveys and case-control studies making possible the comparison of prevalence and risk factors for asthma and other allergic diseases between urban and rural environments (the Ecuador study) and a longitudinal study of the effects of early life exposures of an urban population on asthma and other allergic diseases (the Salvador study).
note: A cohort of children from poor areas of Salvador, originally enrolled to evaluate a sanitation programme, followed to study the effects of early-life environmental and infectious exposures on asthma and allergic diseases; its stated purpose is one disease family and its design centres on exposures.

label: San Francisco City Clinic Cohort
quote: Cohort included 6705 homosexual and bisexual men originally recruited from 1978 to 1980 for studies of sexually transmitted hepatitis B.
note: Homosexual and bisexual men recruited at a San Francisco STD clinic for studies of sexually transmitted hepatitis B, later followed for HIV infection and AIDS; they were selected as a high-risk group, and sexual behaviour is not an environmental exposure in scope.

label: Silent Cerebral Infarct Multi-Center Clinical Trial
diseases: sickle cell anemia | silent cerebral infarct
quote: In the multicenter, single-blind clinical trial for children with sickle cell anemia, each participant was randomly allocated to receive regular blood transfusion therapy (transfusion group) or standard care (observation group) in 29 centers in the United States, Canada, France, and the United Kingdom.
note: A randomised trial of transfusion in children with sickle cell anaemia and silent cerebral infarcts; transfusion is a treatment, not an environmental exposure.

label: Swiss Kidney Project on Genes in Hypertension
quote: SKIPOGH (Swiss Kidney Project on Genes in Hypertension) is a family and population-based cross-sectional study that examines the genetic determinants of BP.
note: A Swiss family- and population-based study of randomly drawn adults and their relatives focused on the genetics of blood pressure and hypertension (and kidney function); environmental determinants are mentioned only alongside genetic ones.

label: SLOVENIA study
quote: Patients with mild-to-moderate persistent asthma from the SLOVENIA study were included in the GWAS of change in lung function after ICS treatment.
note: A clinical study of Slovenian children and young people with persistent asthma, studied for response to inhaled corticosteroids (a medication, out of scope as an exposure).

label: Santiago Longitudinal Study
quote: 1412 participants from a randomised iron-deficiency anaemia preventive trial in healthy infants.
note: A Chilean infancy cohort of healthy full-term infants recruited for an iron-supplementation trial, begun to study the effects of nutrition on children's health and listed in the Global Exposome Cohort Catalogue; later follow-ups have broad aims (development, substance use, cardiometabolic risk), so it is not a disease cohort.

label: Shanghai Women's and Men's Health Studies
quote: We conducted this study using data from Shanghai Men's Health Study (SMHS) and Shanghai Women's Health Study (SWHS), two population-based prospective cohorts of middle-aged and elderly Chinese adults in urban Shanghai, China.
note: Two population-based prospective cohorts of middle-aged and elderly adults in urban Shanghai, analysed jointly; the bundle states no single disease or exposure as the design purpose, so no on both counts.

label: Swedish National Myeloma Biobank
quote: The Swedish/Norwegian GWAS5 was based on 1,668 and 157 MM patients from the Swedish National Myeloma Biobank (Skåne University Hospital, Lund, Sweden) and the Norwegian Biobank for Myeloma (Trondheim, Norway), respectively.
note: National biobank of samples from multiple myeloma patients in Sweden; a patient biobank for one disease, no environmental exposure.

label: Seoul National University Hospital Diabetes Study
quote: The Seoul National University Hospital (SNUH) case-control samples were consisted of 761 T2D patients of the Diabetes Clinic of SNUH and 632 nondiabetic control subjects.
note: Case-control study of type 2 diabetes patients from the SNUH Diabetes Clinic with nondiabetic controls; disease cohort (cases), no exposure.

label: Hispanic Community Children's Health Study/Study of Latino Youth
quote: Participants are children aged 8-16 years whose parents/legal guardians participated in the Hispanic Community Health Study/Study of Latinos, a large community-based cohort study of Hispanic/Latino adults living in the United States.
note: Children of HCHS/SOL participants, not selected for disease or exposure; aims concern lifestyle behaviours and cardiometabolic risk factors in relation to acculturation and family factors, not a single disease or an environmental exposure.

label: Sao Paulo Heart Failure Cohort
quote: Only patients older than 18 years and with symptomatic heart failure (stage C) were enrolled.
note: Outpatients with symptomatic (stage C) heart failure at the São Paulo Heart Institute; patient cohort, no exposure.

label: Singapore Preconception Study of Long-Term Maternal and Child Outcomes
quote: Between February 2015 and October 2017, the S-PRESTO study recruited 1039 Chinese, Malay or Indian (or any combinations thereof) women aged 18-45 years and who intended to get pregnant and deliver in Singapore
note: Preconception mother-offspring cohort of women intending to conceive; its stated aim centres on preconception and pregnancy nutrition and lifestyle exposures and their effects on offspring, so exposure yes (diet); participants not selected for disease.

label: Swiss Pediatric Sepsis Study
quote: Using samples and clinical data from 650 children enrolled in the Swiss Pediatric Sepsis Study, a national multicentre cohort for culture-proven bacterial sepsis
note: Nationwide cohort of children with blood culture-proven bacterial sepsis; defined by the disease (infection as illness, not exposure-uninfected), so disease yes, exposure no.

label: Systematic Treatment Enhancement Program for Bipolar Disorder
quote: Data were drawn from the Systematic Treatment Enhancement Program for Bipolar Disorder (STEP-BD), a naturalistic study of 4360 outpatients 15 years or older with BD.
note: Multicentre treatment study of outpatients with bipolar disorder; patient cohort, and the only exposures are treatments.

label: Simultaneous Study of Gemcitabine-Docetaxel Combination adjuvant treatment, as well as Extended Bisphosphonate and Surveillance-Trial
quote: The SUCCESS-A trial (NCT02181101) examined the addition of gemcitabine to a standard chemotherapy regimen in high-risk early breast cancer patients.
note: Randomised phase III adjuvant chemotherapy trial in patients with high-risk early breast cancer; trial of patients, exposure is only treatment.

label: Seoul National University Prospectively Enrolled Registry for Renal Cell Carcinoma-Nephrectomy
quote: We included the cases of 1,120 patients with RCC who were registered in the Seoul National University Prospectively Enrolled Registry for RCC-Nephrectomy (SUPER-RCC-Nx) and had their blood stored in the human biobank [21].
note: Hospital registry of patients with renal cell carcinoma undergoing surgery; patient cohort, no environmental exposure focus.

label: Triple A Barcelona Study
quote: We present the Triple-A Barcelona Study (TABS), a new hospital-based longitudinal study recruiting consecutive individuals with AAAs in Barcelona.
note: Hospital-based longitudinal registry of consecutive patients with abdominal aortic aneurysm; patient cohort, no exposure.

label: Trans-National Asthma Genetic Consortium
