quote: To generate larger sample sizes for GWAS meta-analysis of asthma enabling the discovery of common novel risk loci, we established the Trans-National Asthma Genetic Consortium (TAGC) across worldwide groups of investigators with genome-wide data available in >142,000 individuals of diverse ancestries.
note: Consortium pooling asthma case-control GWAS; classified by what it collects (asthma cases and controls), no exposure design.

label: LITMUS Metacohort
quote: This was a comparative diagnostic accuracy study in people with biopsy-confirmed NAFLD from 13 countries across Europe, recruited between Jan 6, 2010, and Dec 29, 2017, from the LITMUS metacohort of the prospective European NAFLD Registry.
note: Part of the European NAFLD Registry made up of patients with biopsy-characterised NAFLD; patient cohort, and excessive alcohol consumption is an exclusion, not an exposure focus.

label: Brain Bank for Aging Research
quote: We have established a brain bank for the prevention and treatment of aging-related movement and cognitive disturbances, as a joint project between a rural care hospital and a research institute.
note: Brain bank of consecutive autopsies of older hospital patients, not selected for disease, whose stated purpose is ageing-related neurodegenerative movement and cognitive disorders; hence population study of disease, no exposure.

label: Tasmanian Ophthalmic Biobank
quote: The Tasmanian Ophthalmic Biobank (TOB) is an initiative between the Royal Hobart Hospital and the University of Tasmania, set up to investigate eye disease.
note: Biobank of Tasmanian patients with a range of eye diseases, plus community controls, set up to investigate eye disease; patient biobank, no exposure.

label: Transcriptomic Analysis of Left Ventricular Gene Expression
quote: A large cohort of patients (n = 140) undergoing elective cardiac surgery for aortic valve replacement were enrolled in this study.
note: Patients undergoing elective aortic valve replacement (mostly severe aortic stenosis per the paper's table), sampled for cardiac gene expression; a patient cohort defined by valve disease requiring surgery, no environmental exposure.

label: Trondheim Parkinson's Disease Study
quote: The Trondheim PD cohort is a prospective longitudinal study of PD patients at the Department of Neurology at St. Olav’s Hospital in Trondheim, Norway59.
note: Prospective longitudinal cohort of Parkinson's disease patients referred to St. Olav's Hospital; patient cohort, no exposure.

label: Taiwan Super Control Study
note: Random population-based sample of healthy Han Chinese controls from the Taiwan Han Chinese Cell and Genome Bank (per the definition); no disease or exposure selection. The bundle has no sentence describing its recruitment, so no quote.

label: Taizhou Longitudinal Study
quote: The sample size of the cohort will be at least 100,000 adults aged 30-80 years drawn from the general residents of the districts of Hailin, Gaogang, and Taixing (sample frame, 1.8 million) of Taizhou.
note: Population-based cohort of general residents of Taizhou whose design paper states its focus as environmental and lifestyle (diet, occupational) exposures and genes in chronic disease; exposure yes but borderline, as it is also a general population cohort; disease no because the purpose covers common non-communicable diseases broadly.

label: UK Aneurysm Growth Study
quote: Participants were identified through the United Kingdom Aneurysm Growth Study (UKAGS), a nationwide prospective cohort study of men with an AAA of less than 55 mm diagnosed through voluntary participation in screening.
note: Men with small abdominal aortic aneurysms found at NHS screening (with screened controls), followed for aneurysm growth; patient cohort, no exposure.

label: Danish T2D Case-Control Study
quote: Danish T2D Case-Control Study (UCPH) was undertaken by the Novo Nordisk Foundation Center for Basic Metabolic Research
note: Type 2 diabetes case-control sample assembled from Danish studies; disease yes as cases (quote gives only the study's name and design), no exposure.

label: CoFAR Eosinophilic Esophagitis Registry
quote: This was a multisite single visit registry enrolling subjects aged 6 months to 65 years with EoE.
note: Multisite registry of children and adults with eosinophilic esophagitis; patient registry, no exposure.

label: Vanderbilt Online Musicality Study
note: Online study of adult volunteers on musicality traits (rhythm perception, music engagement); a trait cohort, not selected for disease or exposure. No quote in the bundle shows the recruitment basis.

label: Viva la Familia Study
quote: The Viva la Familia cohort consisted of 1030 children from 319 families selected based on an overweight proband between the ages of 4 and 19 y.
note: Family study of Hispanic children ascertained through an overweight proband, with siblings and parents, to map childhood obesity; disease cohort (patients and their relatives), exposure no as diet and activity are measured traits, not a design exposure.

label: Western Australian Melanoma Health Study
quote: The Western Australian Melanoma Health Study (WAMHS) is a population-based case-collection and biospecimen resource established to investigate the genetic epidemiology of melanoma.
note: Population-based collection of melanoma cases from the Western Australian Cancer Registry; patient cohort; sun exposure is recorded by questionnaire but is not the design focus.

label: Warfarin Anticoagulation in Patients in sub-Saharan Africa
quote: NIHR Global Health Research Group on warfarin anticoagulation in patients with cardiovascular disease in Sub-Saharan Africa (War-PATH) The WarPATH NIHR Global Research Group is a study between the University of Liverpool, Infectious Diseases Institute, Uganda and University of Cape Town, South Africa.
note: Observational pharmacogenomic study of patients with cardiovascular disease (VTE, AF, valvular disease) on warfarin in Uganda and South Africa; the only exposure is a medication, so not an exposure cohort.

label: Women's Environmental Cancer and Radiation Epidemiology Study
quote: The population-based WECARE Study included 1521 cases with CBC and 2212 age- and year of first diagnosis-matched controls with unilateral breast cancer recruited during two phases in the USA, Canada, and Denmark.
note: Case-control study of contralateral breast cancer among breast cancer patients, designed around ionising radiation dose and genetic susceptibility; note the radiation is scatter dose from radiotherapy, i.e. a medical treatment, so the exposure verdict may need review.

label: Wills Eye Hospital GWAS
quote: We recruited 409 UM cases via the UPenn Genetic Diagnostic Laboratory from patients receiving treatment at the Wills Eye Hospital (Philadelphia, PA, USA).
note: Case-control GWAS of uveal melanoma with cases treated at Wills Eye Hospital; no environmental exposure design.

label: WOBASZ II
quote: The epidemiologic assessment of prevalence, control and treatment of CVD risk factors, and monitoring of healthy behaviour and morbidity due to diseases like coronary artery disease, hypertension and diabetes is very important for health policy planning.
note: Random national sample of Polish adults, coordinated by the Institute of Cardiology's CVD prevention department, surveying prevalence and control of cardiovascular diseases and their risk factors; population study of cardiovascular disease, not an exposure cohort.

label: Oxford Regional Prospective Study of Childhood Diabetes
quote: Between 1985 and 1996, 514 children (279 male) who developed type 1 diabetes before the age of 16 years (91% of those eligible from a region where ascertainment of new cases is 95%) were recruited for a longitudinal study with central annual assessment of HbAlc and albumin excretion (three urine samples).
note: Population-based inception cohort of children with type 1 diabetes followed for diabetic nephropathy; no exposure design.

label: Study of Underlying Genetic Determinants of Vitamin D and Highly Related Traits
note: Consortium of epidemiological cohorts meta-analysing GWAS of circulating 25-hydroxyvitamin D, a biomarker trait; neither an exposure nor a disease cohort.

label: International Cannabis Consortium
note: GWAS consortium on lifetime cannabis use, a lifestyle substance exposure that is its main subject (analogous to a smoking-behaviour consortium); lifetime use is not a disorder, so not a disease cohort.

label: Center for Oral Health Research in Appalachia cohort 1
quote: An initial aim of COHRA is to determine the contributions of individual, family, and community factors to oral diseases in Appalachian children.
note: Population-ascertained family study in Appalachia set up to study the aetiology of oral diseases, chiefly dental caries; not an exposure cohort.

label: Shikamachi health improvement practice genome cohort study
quote: In brief, the SHIKA study is a population-based observational study conducted to investigate approaches that prevent lifestyle-related diseases.
note: Community-based cohort of Shika Town residents with a broad purpose (lifestyle-related diseases); neither an exposure nor a single-disease cohort.

label: Bicuspid aoRtic vAlVe gEnetic research
quote: The population of our study were participants of the University of Leicester Bicuspid aoRtic vAlVe gEnetic research (BRAVE)—an ongoing, multicentre recruitment of patients with BAV disease.
note: Multicentre genetic study recruiting patients with bicuspid aortic valve disease and their relatives; no exposure design.

label: Defining the Basis of Fibromuscular Dysplasia
diseases: fibromuscular dysplasia | spontaneous coronary artery dissection | cervical artery dissection
quote: DEFINE-FMD purpose was to establish a library of fibroblasts, DNA, plasma and serum from patients with FMD and unaffected healthy control subjects.
note: Case-control study of fibromuscular dysplasia (later also SCAD and cervical artery dissection) with matched healthy controls; no exposure design.

label: Center for Oral Health Research in Appalachia cohort 2
quote: In response to these findings, a second major study (COHRA2, 2011–present) was initiated to investigate oral health in pregnant women and their babies, specifically the factors predisposing a relatively high proportion of very young Northern Appalachian children to dental caries.
note: Mother-child cohort of healthy pregnant women and their babies set up to study the factors behind early childhood dental caries; environmental factors are among many studied, so not an exposure cohort.

label: Genetic Analysis of Idiopathic Thrombophilia 2 Project
quote: Families were selected through a proband with idiopathic thrombophilia, which was defined as recurrent thrombotic events (at least one of which was spontaneous), a single spontaneous thrombotic episode plus a first-degree relative also affected, or onset of thrombosis before age 45.
note: Extended Spanish families ascertained through a proband with idiopathic thrombophilia (relatives at risk, probands affected); no exposure design.

label: Human Reproductive Behaviour Consortium
note: Consortium of cohorts meta-analysing GWAS of reproductive behaviour (age at first sex and birth, number of children); a behavioural trait, neither an exposure nor a disease cohort.

label: SerGenCovid-19
quote: The samples used in this study are part of the SerGenCovid-19 project (https://sergencovid19.d4science.org), an initiative of the Italian National Research Council (Consiglio Nazionale delle Ricerche, CNR) aimed at identifying the genetic and serological factors involved in response to vaccination against COVID-19 and susceptibility to SARS-CoV-2 infection.
note: General-population Italian cohort set up to study susceptibility to SARS-CoV-2 infection and COVID-19 vaccine response; not defined by exposure to the virus, and vaccination is a medical intervention.

label: CALGB 40502
quote: Cancer and Leukemia Group B 40502 was a randomized trial of first-line taxane-based chemotherapy for patients with metastatic breast cancer.
note: Phase III chemotherapy trial in patients with locally recurrent or metastatic breast cancer; treatment is not an environmental exposure.

label: Asklepios Study
quote: The Asklepios Study is a longitudinal population study focusing on the interplay between ageing, cardiovascular haemodynamics and inflammation in (preclinical) cardiovascular disease.
note: Random population sample of middle-aged Belgians free of overt CVD, studied for preclinical cardiovascular disease; a population study of cardiovascular disease, not an exposure cohort.

label: CORtisol NETwork consortium
quote: The CORNET consortium extended its genome-wide association meta-analysis for morning plasma cortisol from 12,597 to 25,314 subjects and from ~2.2M to ~7M SNPs, in 17 population-based cohorts of European ancestries.
note: Consortium of population-based cohorts meta-analysing GWAS of morning plasma cortisol, a trait; neither an exposure nor a disease cohort.

label: Amsterdam Born Children and their Development
note: General multi-ethnic birth cohort of Amsterdam pregnancies about early-life determinants of health and health inequalities; although listed in the Global Exposome Cohort Catalogue, exposure is not its stated design centre, and it has no single disease focus.

label: 100-plus Study
quote: The 100-plus Study is an on-going prospective cohort study of Dutch centenarians who self-reported to be cognitively healthy, their first-degree family members and their respective partners.
note: Cohort of cognitively healthy centenarians and their families, defined by a trait (extreme longevity with preserved cognition) rather than a disease; not an exposure cohort.

label: Two Sister Study
quote: We conducted the Two Sister Study, a sister-matched case-control study, by enrolling 1422 women between September 2008 and December 2010, who were younger than age 50 years at diagnosis with breast cancer and were enrolled within 4 years of diagnosis, and 1669 breast cancer-free control sisters from the Sister Study.
note: Sister-matched case-control study of young-onset breast cancer; environmental causes are mentioned only generically alongside genetic ones, so not an exposure cohort.

label: Women's Health Study: From Adolescence to Adulthood
quote: Reproductive-aged women with laparoscopically-confirmed endometriosis (n = 282) and controls (n = 293) who participated in The Women’s Health Study: From Adolescence to Adulthood (A2A), a cohort of adolescents and young women enrolled from 2012–2018, were included in this cross-sectional analysis.
note: Longitudinal cohort of surgically confirmed endometriosis cases and controls; no exposure design.

label: African Ancestry Breast Cancer Genetic Consortium
quote: In this study, we used genetic data from the AABCG, a consortium for a genetic study of breast cancer for females of African ancestry, including genetic data from over 20 studies conducted in the U.S. and Africa.
note: Consortium of breast cancer case-control studies in women of African ancestry; no exposure design.

label: Australian Asthma Genetics Consortium
quote: We did a genome-wide association study (GWAS) in 2669 physician-diagnosed asthmatics and 4528 controls from Australia.
note: Australian consortium pooling physician-diagnosed asthma cases and controls for GWAS; no exposure design.

label: Aarhus Prostate Cancer Study
quote: Patients treated for prostate adenocarcinoma at Department of Urology, Aarhus University Hospital, Skejby (Aarhus, Denmark)
note: Hospital-based case-control study of prostate cancer in the PRACTICAL consortium; no exposure design.

label: Amsterdam Breast Cancer Study
quote: Amsterdam Breast Cancer Study Netherlands Pre-iCOGS: All breast cancer patients (with operable, invasive mammacarcinoma) aged <50 years and diagnosed from 1970-1994 in four Dutch hospitals.
note: Hospital-based breast cancer case-control study whose cases are breast cancer patients; no environmental exposure defines it.

label: Amsterdam Breast Cancer Study – Familial
quote: The samples included in this study were from two Dutch breast cancer case-control studies: RBCS and ABCS-F.
note: Familial arm of ABCS: a breast cancer case-control study of non-BRCA1/2 familial breast cancer patients and blood-bank controls.

label: Australian Breast Cancer Tissue Bank
quote: Fresh frozen tumors and matching blood samples were accessed from the Brisbane Breast Bank (BBB) at the University of Queensland Centre for Clinical Research (UQCCR) and from the Australian Breast Cancer Tissue Bank (ABCTB) based at the Westmead Institute for Medical Research.
note: A breast cancer tumour bank collecting tissue and blood from breast cancer patients; not an exposure cohort.

label: Anonymous Blood Donor Cohort
quote: The healthy controls subjects were recruited among 15,000 blood-donors from the Danish Blood Donor Corps in the Copenhagen area.
note: Anonymous Danish blood donors used as population controls (height and BMI in GIANT); unselected healthy donors, so no on both counts.

label: Adelaide Blood Pools
quote: Two population-based cohorts were studied in the case-control pool design.
note: Population-based Adelaide sample selected on extremes of central corneal thickness, a quantitative trait rather than a disease; no exposure focus.

label: Aneurysm Consortium
quote: Aneurysm Consortium (AC), cases of AAA together with available DNA recruited in eight centers in the UK, Australia, and New Zealand and also samples from the United Kingdom Small Aneurysm Trial from inpatient populations, outpatient clinics, or population screening programs in the participating centers.
note: Consortium pooling abdominal aortic aneurysm cases for a GWAS against WTCCC2 controls; disease patients, no exposure design.

label: Autism Case-Control cohort
quote: To boost power for identifying these associations, we examined an Autism Case-Control cohort (ACC cohort, Table 1), comprising 1,453 subjects with ASDs from several US sites, and 7,070 control subjects without ASDs from the Children's Hospital of Philadelphia, who were also genotyped on the same platform.
note: Case-control collection of people with autism spectrum disorders and CHOP controls for GWAS.

label: Action to Control Cardiovascular Risk in Diabetes
quote: A total of 10,251 participants with type 2 diabetes were recruited from seven clinical networks in the U.S. and Canada between 2001 and 2005 and randomized in a 1:1 ratio to receive intensive glucose-lowering treatment, aiming for an HbA1c level below 6%, or to standard treatment, aiming for an HbA1c level between 7.0% and 7.9%.
note: Randomised trial of treatment strategies in people with type 2 diabetes at high cardiovascular risk; the interventions are treatments, not environmental exposures.

label: Anglo-Cardiff Collaborative Trial
quote: Subjects were drawn from the ACCT (Anglo‐Cardiff Collaborative Trial) population, which consists of >12 000 individuals, selected at random from local general practice lists and open‐access Cardiovascular Risk Assessment Clinics across East Anglia and Wales.
note: Randomly selected adults from GP lists and risk-assessment clinics studied for normal vascular ageing and arterial stiffness; ageing is not a disease and no exposure is its design focus.

label: Alcoholic Cirrhosis GWAS
quote: We performed a genome-wide association study for alcohol-related cirrhosis in individuals of European descent (712 cases and 1,426 controls) with subsequent validation in two independent European cohorts (1,148 cases and 922 controls).
note: GWAS of alcohol-related cirrhosis comparing cirrhosis patients with alcohol-misusing controls; disease patients, and both arms are selected for heavy alcohol use.

label: University of Manchester Longitudinal Study of Cognition in Normal Healthy Old Age
quote: All five cohorts comprise non-clinical samples of relatively healthy people from middle to older adulthood with detailed, though not identical, cognitive phenotypes.
note: Longitudinal cohort of healthy community-dwelling older volunteers studying normal cognitive ageing; neither disease- nor exposure-defined.

label: St. Göran Bipolar Project
quote: The St. Göran Bipolar Project (SBP) is a longitudinal outpatient study investigation aimed at identifying predictive factors associated with long-term outcomes in individuals with bipolar disorder.
note: Longitudinal cohort of bipolar disorder outpatients with population controls.

label: Alzheimer's Disease Cardiff Cohort
quote: Sporadic AD and control plasma samples [n = 504 control, 912 EOAD (onset < 65 years), 492 LOAD (onset > 65 years)] were a subset of the AD Cardiff Cohort, collected between 2004 and 2020 from individuals recruited from UK community and hospital settings using MRC, Moondance Foundation, and Health and Care Research Wales (HCRW) funding (Table 1).
note: Case-control cohort of early- and late-onset Alzheimer's disease patients and screened elderly controls.

label: Analyse des DEterminants génétiques et environnementaux de la Leucoaraiose dans une population de sujets Agés Hypertendus présentant des troubles cognitifs DEbutants
quote: Inclusion criteria for ADELAHYDE were age 60–85 years with arterial hypertension (>1 year from diagnosis, receiving antihypertensive treatment for at least one month), presenting with low-grade subjective memory complaints (SMCs) defined as a McNair scale >15 (revised validated French version of 26 items).
note: Cohort of older treated hypertensive patients with memory complaints studied for leukoaraiosis and cognitive decline; 'environmental' determinants appear in the name only, not as a measured exposure design.

label: Evolution de la Rigidité Artérielle
quote: Participants were from a Parisian cohort that had been followed at the Centre d’Investigations Préventives et Cliniques.
note: Paris health-check cohort (normotensive and treated hypertensive adults) followed for determinants of arterial ageing; ageing is not a disease focus and no exposure defines it.

label: ADHD-VHIR study
quote: All patients were adults of Caucasian origin, recruited and evaluated at the Hospital Universitari Vall d’Hebron located in Barcelona (Spain), and met Diagnostic and Statistical Manual for Mental Disorders-IV (DSM-IV) criteria for ADHD.
note: Case-control collection of adults with ADHD and screened blood-donor controls.

label: Action in Diabetes and Vascular disease: Preterax and Diamicron-MR Controlled Evaluation
quote: ADVANCE is designed to provide reliable evidence on the balance of benefits and risks conferred by blood pressure lowering therapy and intensive glucose control therapy in high-risk diabetic patients, regardless of initial blood pressure or glucose concentrations.
note: Randomised trial in people with type 2 diabetes; the interventions are treatments, not environmental exposures.

label: Aneurysm-Express Biobank Study
quote: The Aneurysm-Express study (which is a derivative of the previously mentioned Athero-Express study) is a longitudinal biobank study that includes aneurysm tissue from all patients undergoing open surgical abdominal aortic aneurysm (AAA) repair in two Dutch hospitals.
note: Biobank of patients undergoing open surgical aneurysm repair.

label: Atrial Fibrillation Biobank LMU
quote: Third, while the AFLMU data set is rather large for an AF ablation cohort with biomarkers, further studies in independent patient data sets, ideally assessing atrial PITX2 and plasma BMP10 concentrations in the same patients, are warranted to confirm our findings.
note: Biobank and registry of atrial fibrillation patients undergoing ablation at LMU Munich.

label: Early Treatment of Atrial Fibrillation for Stroke Prevention Trial
quote: The randomized Early Treatment of Atrial Fibrillation for Stroke Prevention Trial found that early rhythm control reduces cardiovascular events in patients with recently diagnosed atrial fibrillation (AF) compared with usual care.
note: Randomised trial of early rhythm control in patients with recently diagnosed atrial fibrillation; the intervention is a treatment.

label: AFTER EU
quote: Single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) in candidate genes were tested for association with overt diabetic nephropathy (persistent albuminuria >300 mg/24 h) in a large (n=2499) Type 1 diabetes case/control study.
note: Danish part of EURAGEDIC: type 1 diabetes patients with diabetic nephropathy (cases) or normoalbuminuria (controls); the quote describes EURAGEDIC as a whole.

label: Autism Genome Project
quote: The AGP is a large-scale, collaborative genetics research project drawing on very large patient cohorts from around the globe to garner sufficient statistical power to tease out the multiple underlying genetic roots of this disorder.
note: International consortium pooling families with autism spectrum disorder for genetic studies.

label: Autism Genetic Resource Exchange
quote: Our study sample comprised individuals from the Autism Genetic Resource Exchange (AGRE), a volunteer research repository of families from across the United States in which typically two or more siblings have a diagnosis of ASD (multiplex families).
note: Repository of mostly multiplex families with autism spectrum disorder.

label: San Francisco Bay Area Adult Glioma Study
quote: The UCSF adult glioma case–control study (SFAGS–GWAS) included participants of the San Francisco Bay Area Adult Glioma Study (AGS).
note: Population- and clinic-based case-control study of adult glioma; it examines diet and other risk factors among many variables, but no exposure defines its design.

label: Aichi Colorectal Cancer Study
quote: The Aichi CRC Study: This study had two case-control collections (Aichi-1 and Aichi-2) with a total of 640 cases and 1,414 controls
note: Hospital-based colorectal cancer case-control study at Aichi Cancer Center within HERPACC.

label: African American Breast Cancer Epidemiology and Risk Consortium
quote: We combined samples and data from four large epidemiologic studies of breast cancer in AA women, two cohort and two case-control, creating the African American Breast Cancer Epidemiology and Risk consortium.
note: Consortium pooling two case-control studies and two cohorts of breast cancer in African American women; classified as a breast cancer patient collection. Oral contraceptive use is an analysed risk factor, not an environmental exposure design.

label: Acute Myocardial Infarction Gene Study
quote: Between 2004 and 2006, we enrolled a cohort of 809 consecutive men younger than 65 and suffering from non-ST-segment elevation MI or ST- segment elevation MI with an onset of symptoms less than 24 hours before admission.
note: German case-control study whose cases are consecutive men with acute myocardial infarction from a multicentre registry, with population controls from the Dortmund Health Study.

label: Amsterdam UMC COVID-19 Biobank
quote: The Amsterdam UMC COVID-19 biobank is a prospective cohort study containing clinical data and archive material from adult patients admitted with COVID-19 in two academic hospitals of Amsterdam UMC.
note: Prospective biobank of patients hospitalised with COVID-19; a disease cohort, not defined by exposure to the infectious agent among the uninfected.

label: Australian National Endometrial Cancer Study
quote: ANECS was a population-based case-control study conducted from 2005 to 2007, in which 1,399 women with newly diagnosed histologically confirmed primary endometrial cancer and 740 control women provided risk factor information via telephone interview.
note: Population-based case-control study of endometrial cancer in Australia; risk factors such as talc use are analysed but exposure is not the design purpose.

label: Lübeck Registry of Structural Heart Disease
diseases: structural heart disease | coronary artery disease | myocardial infarction | dilated cardiomyopathy
quote: Consecutive patients referred for coronary angiography, classified as CAD/MI cases based on the coronary angiogram
note: Hospital registry of patients with heart disease in Lübeck whose angiography sample provides coronary artery disease cases; also supplied dilated cardiomyopathy cases.

label: Australia and New Zealand Multiple Sclerosis Genetics Consortium
quote: Following quality control as outlined in the ANZgene GWAS [28], this dataset consisted of 1618 MS cases of European ancestry from Australia and New Zealand, and 3413 healthy controls of European ancestry from Australia, the UK and the US.
note: Multiple sclerosis case-control collection for genome-wide association studies in Australia and New Zealand.

label: Australian & New Zealand Registry of Advanced Glaucoma
quote: The Australian and New Zealand Registry of Advanced Glaucoma is a prospective study that aims to develop a large cohort of glaucoma cases with severe visual field loss to identify novel genetic risk factors for glaucoma blindness.
note: Disease registry of people with advanced (and other) glaucoma in Australia and New Zealand.

label: Alberta Ovarian Tumor Types Study
quote: Patients were sampled from an ongoing study of ovarian histological types comprising approximately 1,000 women with ovarian carcinomas (300 endometrioid, 300 clear cell, 300 mucinous, and 100 high-grade serous).
note: Population-based retrospective study of women with ovarian carcinoma from the Alberta Cancer Registry, sampled by histological type.

label: Australian Prostate Cancer BioResource
quote: This retrospective study was an assessment of 114 men with prostate cancer who provided radical prostatectomy samples to the Australian Prostate Cancer Bioresource between 2006 and 2014.
note: National tissue bank of men with prostate cancer, recruited through urologists at diagnosis or before surgery.

label: Aberdeen Prospective Osteoporosis Screening Study
quote: Subjects are women from the Aberdeen Prospective Osteoporosis Screening Study (APOSS) cohort, a population-based screening program for assessing osteoporotic fracture risk, which initially recruited 5119 women aged 45–54 years between 1990 and 1994 using random selection from Community Health Index [15].
note: Randomly selected population sample of Aberdeen women set up as an osteoporosis screening study, so a population study of osteoporosis; diet is analysed but is not the design purpose.

label: Apixaban for Reduction in Stroke and Other Thromboembolic Events in Atrial Fibrillation
quote: In this randomized, double-blind trial, we compared apixaban (at a dose of 5 mg twice daily) with warfarin (target international normalized ratio, 2.0 to 3.0) in 18,201 patients with atrial fibrillation and at least one additional risk factor for stroke.
note: Randomised trial of apixaban versus warfarin in patients with atrial fibrillation; the only exposure is a medication, which is out of scope.

label: Aarhus Osteoporosis Study
quote: AROS (Aarhus Osteoporosis Study) is a case–control study, including 462 osteoporotic patients (vertebral fracture and T-score < −2.5) and 336 controls.
note: Hospital-based case-control study of osteoporotic patients with vertebral fractures and normal controls in Aarhus.

label: Amsterdam Resuscitation Studies
quote: To our knowledge, ARREST is the first prospective population-based registry of patients with OHCA aimed at identifying genetic, clinical, pharmacological and environmental determinants of OHCA with documented VT/VF.
note: Community-based registry of out-of-hospital cardiac arrest patients; environmental determinants are one of several listed aims, not the design focus, so exposure is no.

label: Alzheimer's Research Trust Collaboration
quote: All case samples were diagnosed as either definite (post mortem confirmed) or probable Alzheimer’s disease (AD) according to National Institute of Neurological and Communicative Disorders and Stroke and the Alzheimer’s Disease and Related Disorders Association (NINCDS-ADRDA), and the Consortium to Establish a Registry for Alzheimer’s Disease (CERAD) guidelines.
note: UK collaboration pooling DNA from Alzheimer's disease cases and elderly controls into a shared DNA bank; the quoted sentence describes the ART Collaboration samples.

label: Arsenic Health Risk Assessment and Molecular Epidemiology
diseases: basal cell carcinoma | bladder cancer | kidney cancer
quote: The study comprised 1,392 participants of whom 852 were cancer cases (529 basal cell carcinoma of skin, BCC; 214 bladder; 109 kidney) and 540 were controls.
note: Case-control study of skin, bladder and kidney cancer built to study low-level arsenic in drinking water in arsenic-affected areas of Hungary, Romania and Slovakia.

label: Athens Study of Psychosis Proneness and Incidence of Schizophrenia
quote: Briefly, the Athens Study of Psychosis Proneness and Incidence of Schizophrenia (ASPIS) examined 2243 randomly selected young male conscripts aged 18 to 24 years from the Greek Air Force in their first 2 weeks of admission to the National Basic Air Force Training Center.
note: Randomly selected healthy young conscripts studied for psychosis proneness and schizophrenia incidence; military service is the sampling frame, not a studied exposure. Disease role follows from the study's stated focus on psychosis.

label: Australian Twin Eye Study
quote: The Australian Twin Eye Study comprised participants examined as part of the Twins Eye Study in Tasmania or the Brisbane Adolescent Twins Study.
note: Twin study of quantitative eye traits (refraction, intraocular pressure) combining two Australian twin studies; neither disease-selected nor exposure-based.

label: AtheroGene Registry
quote: The AtheroGene study is a prospective, multicenter, clinical cohort study including patients with known CAD (at least one stenosis over 30%) as diagnosed by coronary angiography.
note: Prospective clinical cohort of angiographically confirmed coronary artery disease patients in Mainz and Koblenz.

label: Australian Twin Migraine
quote: The Australian Twin Migraine GWA study (N = 6350) included 2825 migraine cases and 3525 controls, 805 of whom met the diagnostic criteria for MDD.
note: Migraine case-control sample drawn from QIMR twins and relatives for genome-wide association.

label: Asthma UK Genetics of Severe Asthma
quote: A genome-wide association study was undertaken in 933 European ancestry individuals with severe asthma based on Global Initiative for Asthma (GINA) criteria 3 or above and 3346 clean controls.
note: UK collection of people with severe asthma compared with controls in a genome-wide association study.

label: Amsterdam UMC dilated cardiomyopathy GWAS cohort
quote: The Amsterdam cohort comprised DCM patients referred for genetic testing at Amsterdam UMC, who underwent chart review for DCM diagnosis and had evidence of hypocontractility on imaging; 978 DCM cases passed all genotype quality-control criteria, of which 783 homogeneous cases of patients of European ancestry were included in GWAS (Supplementary Note and Supplementary Table 3).
note: Case-control GWAS dataset of dilated cardiomyopathy patients referred for genetic testing at Amsterdam UMC.

label: Austrian Diabetic Nephropathy Study
quote: The GWAS meta-analysis included up to 19,406 patients with type 1 diabetes and of European origin from 17 cohorts: The Austrian Diabetic Nephropathy Study (AusDiane)
note: Clinic-based cohort of type 1 diabetes patients in Salzburg studied for diabetic nephropathy and other complications.

label: Bipolar Affective Case Control Study
quote: The aim of our study is to explore the association of DTNBP1 with BD and with a sub phenotype, presence/absence of psychotic symptoms, in a sample of 515 patients with BD (ICD10/DSMIV) and 1,316 ethnically matched control subjects recruited from the UK.
note: UK case-control genetic association study of bipolar disorder.

label: Arizona Study of Aging and Neurodegenerative Disorders and Brain and Body Donation Program
diseases: Alzheimer's disease | Parkinson's disease | neurodegenerative disorders
quote: The BBDP is a longitudinal clinicopathological study of AD, PD and normal aging.
note: Brain and body donation programme of mostly cognitively normal older volunteers plus recruited Alzheimer's and Parkinson's patients, whose stated purpose is neurodegenerative disease; role chosen as population study of disease since most donors are unselected volunteers.

label: BARCODE1
quote: The BARCODE1 study (NCT03857477) is enrolling men of European ancestry from the community via their GPs to undergo a germline genetic profile test utilising 130 PCa risk SNPs.
note: Community-based prostate cancer screening study of men invited through GPs, with the highest polygenic-risk men offered MRI and biopsy; its purpose is one disease.

label: Therapeutic Trial collection
quote: a validation set of 1340 individuals with MS and 1109 controls taken from several MS therapeutic trials (TT cohort)

note: Follow-up of a randomised trial of milk supplementation in pregnancy and childhood, later used to study infant nutrition and adult outcomes; diet is its defining subject, while no disease defines it.

label: Bangladesh Vitamin E and Selenium Trial
quote: Bangladesh Vitamin E and Selenium Trial is a 2 × 2 full factorial, double-blind, randomized controlled trial of 7000 adults having manifest arsenical skin lesions evaluating the efficacy of 6-year supplementation with alpha-tocopherol (100 mg daily) and L-selenomethionine (200 μg daily) for the prevention of nonmelanoma skin cancer.

label: Human genetic determinants of severe malaria in Malawi

quote: BRCA-gene mutations and breast cancer in South African women

quote: We next performed whole-genome sequencing in 500 individuals recruited in Dhaka, Bangladesh, as part of the Bangladesh Risk of Acute Vascular Events (BRAVE) study, a case-control study of first-onset acute myocardial infarction.
note: Case-control study of first-onset myocardial infarction in Bangladesh; environmental factors are one of several determinant groups (with genetic, lifestyle, biochemical), not the design centre.

note: Yearly random population sample of Geneva adults covering risk factors for cardiovascular and other lifestyle-related chronic diseases; a broad population survey.

quote: Clinic-based study of control individuals and patients with osteoporosis living in Cantabria, a region in Northern Spain

quote: The CaPS was set up to study the influence of CVD risk factors in the development of coronary heart disease (CHD) [12], and recruited an initial 2512 men, aged 45 to 59 years living in the town of Caerphilly and five adjacent villages, South Wales, UK (response rate 89%).

quote: Subjects in the Tokyo district were selected from participants in the Hospital-based Cohort Study at the National Center for Global Health and Medicine (NCGM), Tokyo, to investigate lifestyle factors and genetic susceptibility for lifestyle-related diseases.
note: Hospital-based cohort of NCGM clinic and check-up participants studying lifestyle and genetic factors in lifestyle-related diseases generally (cardiovascular disease, cancer, diabetes); a broad purpose with no defining exposure or single disease.

quote: This post-hoc analysis of a five-year double-blind, placebo-controlled randomised trial of calcium supplements for primary fracture prevention evaluated the long-term risk for dementia in older women, randomised to either calcium supplements or placebo.
note: Randomised trial of calcium supplements for fracture prevention in unselected older women from the general population; the supplement is an intervention, not an environmental exposure, and the trial's stated purpose is osteoporotic fracture prevention.

quote: Replication of the strongest signal, rs2736100 was performed in the remaining subjects of the GELAC study [13] as well as six studies of never-smoking Asian women with lung adenocarcinoma in East Asia.

label: Carotid Atherosclerosis Progression Study
quote: In the Carotid Atherosclerosis Progression Study (CAPS; n=5056; age range 19 to 90 years; mean age 50.1 years), common carotid artery (CCA) IMT, bifurcation IMT, internal carotid artery IMT and vascular risk factors were evaluated at baseline.

quote: In brief, CARDS was a multicentre, randomised, placebo-controlled trial in 2,838 patients with type 2 diabetes aged 40–75 years carried out in 132 centres in the UK and Ireland.
note: Statin trial for primary prevention of cardiovascular disease in patients with type 2 diabetes; the intervention is a medication, not an environmental exposure.

label: Cholesterol and Recurrent Events
quote: CARE was a secondary-prevention trial that investigated the clinical benefit of pravastatin 40 mg daily versus placebo in individuals with prior MI who had total cholesterol ≤240 mg/dL and LDL cholesterol between 115 and 174 mg/dL.
note: Secondary-prevention pravastatin trial in patients who had had a myocardial infarction; a medication trial, not an exposure cohort.

label: Childhood Asthma Research and Education Network
quote: In order to promote innovative research in asthma therapies, the National Heart, Lung and Blood Institute created the Childhood Asthma Research and Education Network in 1999.
note: NHLBI paediatric asthma clinical trial network whose trials enrol children with (or at risk of) asthma to test therapies; treatment trials, not exposure cohorts.

label: Carotene and Retinol Efficacy Trial
quote: CARET is a multicenter, two-armed, double-masked randomized chemoprevention trial in Seattle, Portland, San Francisco, Baltimore, Connecticut, and Irvine, to test whether oral administration of beta-carotene (30 mg/day) plus retinyl palmitate (25,000 IU/day) can decrease the incidence of lung cancer in high risk populations, namely, heavy smokers and asbestos-exposed workers.
note: Lung cancer chemoprevention trial in heavy smokers and asbestos-exposed workers, selected for those exposures and hence at high risk of lung cancer.

label: Clinical Antipsychotic Trials of Intervention Effectiveness
quote: We applied TRRIP criteria to 1334 participants with chronic schizophrenia enrolled in the Clinical Antipsychotic Trials of Intervention Effectiveness (CATIE) study.
note: Antipsychotic effectiveness trial in adults with chronic schizophrenia; a drug trial, not an exposure cohort.

label: Comorbidity and Trauma Study
quote: The sample of the Comorbidity and Trauma Study, a genetic association study of heroin dependence, consists of Australian heroin dependent cases ascertained from opioid replacement therapy clinics and controls ascertained in nearby economically disadvantaged neighborhoods.
note: Case-control study of heroin dependence with cases from opioid replacement therapy clinics in Sydney; addiction is the disease, and no environmental agent defines recruitment.

label: Croatian Colorectal Cancer Genetic Study
quote: Finally, a case–control CRC study from Croatia consisting of 764 cases and 460 population-based controls was also included in the analysis.
note: Croatian colorectal cancer case-control study with hospital cases and population controls, used for genetic association; no defining exposure.

quote: The Cambridgeshire case-control study is a population-based study of T2D cases, aged 45–76 y, and age- and sex-matched controls.

quote: The Cleveland Clinic GeneBank study is a single‐site sample repository generated from consecutive patients undergoing elective diagnostic coronary angiography or elective cardiac computed tomographic angiography with extensive clinical and laboratory characterization and longitudinal observation.

quote: CCHS has been a population-based investigation of risk factors for cardiovascular diseases in China since 2006.
note: Population-based study of cardiovascular disease risk factors in Chinese adults run by Fuwai Hospital; its stated purpose is one disease family, with no defining environmental exposure.

label: Cross Cancer Institute Prostate Brachytherapy Cohort
quote: Genomic DNA from 296 men treated with (125)I prostate brachytherapy monotherapy was extracted from saliva samples for this study.

quote: We obtained data from Connecticut Endometrial Cancer Study (CECS) [68], a population-based case-control study on 668 incident cases with type I endometrial cancer and 674 population controls.

note: Hospital-based case-control study of renal cell carcinoma in Central and Eastern Europe. Smoking, diet and occupational history were collected among many variables but exposure was not a selection criterion, so exposure is no.

quote: Genotyping 211,155 SNPs in 495 cases and 640 controls of Chinese ancestry identified several new suggestive Chinese prostate cancer predisposition loci.

label: ChooseWell 365

quote: The Children's Health Study (CHS) is a continuing series of longitudinal studies that first began in 1993 and has focused on demonstrating the chronic impacts of air pollution on respiratory illnesses from early childhood through adolescence.

quote: Among the 20,434 subjects attending the lipid clinic, we identified and included 725 individuals who carried an FH causing mutation in this retrospective cohort study.

quote: Two hundred thirty-five Gullah African Americans with type 2 diabetes were included.

label: Danish National Patient Register
quote: The DNPR provides nationwide longitudinal registration of detailed administrative and clinical data.

quote: The Duke Neurogenetics Study (DNS) data were collected from high-functioning young adult university students in the United States, so that it would be premature to assume that the same findings would be replicated in samples drawn from the general population.

label: Dubbo Osteoporosis Epidemiology Study
quote: This longitudinal population-based study documents the incidence of all symptomatic fractures from 1989 to 1992 in an elderly, predominantly Caucasian population of males and females (> or = 60 years as at 1 January 1989) living in the geographically isolated region of the city of Dubbo, NSW, Australia.

label: Danish Osteoporosis Prevention Study
quote: In 1990 we initiated a 20 year, partly randomised study (Danish Osteoporosis Prevention Study, DOPS) in order to (a) evaluate clinical, biochemical and osteodensitometric variables as predictors of low bone mass and future osteoporotic fractures, and (b) test the hypothesis, that hormone replacement therapy (HRT) initiated shortly after menopause reduces the risk of later osteoporotic fractures.

quote: DOVE is a population-based ovarian cancer case-control study that enrolled 1502 ovarian cancer cases ages 35–74 years from 13 counties in Western Washington State between 2002 and 2009 [19].

label: International Consortium on Lithium Genetics
quote: The discovery analysis consisted of ConLi+Gen data obtained from 2,367 bipolar patients of European ancestry who had undergone lithium treatment for at least six months.

label: Cohort of Norway
quote: The CONOR database has several strengths: it is population based including populations from various parts of Norway, both rural and urban.

quote: BRCA1 and BRCA2 mutation carriers of the Consortium of Investigators of Modifiers of BRCA1/2 (CIMBA)

quote: Cases were diagnosed histologically from 2012 and onwards with treatable lung cancer.

quote: The Korean osteoporosis study at Asan Medical Center (KorAMC) study is a hospital registered, cross-sectional study of postmenopausal Korean women in Seoul.

label: Mayo-Perlegen Linked Efforts to Accelerate Parkinson's Solutions Collaboration
quote: We performed a two-tiered, whole-genome association study of Parkinson disease (PD).
